WITH s AS (
  SELECT pr.sitetie, pr.snapts,
         (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric AS pnow,
         (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric AS ploss
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
  WHERE ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w' IS NOT NULL
    AND ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w' IS NOT NULL
), l AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sitetie) sitetie, pnow, ploss
  FROM s
  WHERE pnow + ploss <> 0
  ORDER BY sitetie, snapts DESC
)
SELECT p.sitelabel,
       ROUND(l.pnow * (1 - l.ploss / (l.pnow + l.ploss)), 2) AS effective_power_output
FROM l
JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = l.sitetie
ORDER BY effective_power_output DESC;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric   AS dens,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric     AS cov,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric       AS lap,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric      AS noise
  FROM pointcloud p
  JOIN scans s ON s.crewref = p.crewref AND s.arcref = p.arcref
), q AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         (log(res * 1000) / log(dens)) * 5          AS sri,
         cov * (1 + lap / 100 * (1 - cov / 100))     AS sce,
         noise
  FROM m
)
SELECT st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel,
       AVG(power(10 / q.sri, 1.5) * (q.sce / 100) * power(1 - q.noise / 30, 2)) AS avg_sqs
FROM q
JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = q.zoneref
GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC;

WITH buyer_ratio AS (
  SELECT b."AcqCode",
         split_part(b.buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio', ' ', 1)::numeric AS rdr
  FROM buyers b
), grp AS (
  SELECT "AcqCode", NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY rdr) AS rdr_tier
  FROM buyer_ratio
), tx AS (
  SELECT g.rdr_tier, g."AcqCode", t."CrossBorder", c."AnonLevel"::numeric AS anon
  FROM grp g
  JOIN transactions t ON t."AcqLink" = g."AcqCode"
  LEFT JOIN connection_security c ON c."TxnPointer" = t."EventCode"
)
SELECT rdr_tier,
       COUNT(DISTINCT "AcqCode") AS buyer_count,
       ROUND(AVG("CrossBorder")::numeric, 4) AS cross_border_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN anon >= 7 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS high_anon_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN anon >= 4 AND anon < 7 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS medium_anon_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN anon < 4 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS low_anon_rate
FROM tx
GROUP BY rdr_tier
ORDER BY rdr_tier;

WITH scan_m AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::float AS res,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::float AS pdens,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::float AS cov,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::float AS lap,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::float AS noise,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::float AS acc,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::float AS err
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = sc.arcref AND pc.crewref = sc.crewref
  JOIN registration r ON r.arcref = sc.arcref AND r.crewref = sc.crewref
), scan_c AS (
  SELECT *, log(res*1000)/log(pdens)*5 AS sri,
         cov*(1 + lap/100*(1 - cov/100)) AS sce,
         res/(acc*sqrt(1 + err/acc)) AS rar
  FROM scan_m
), scan_q AS (
  SELECT *, power(10/sri, 1.5)*(sce/100)*power(1 - noise/30, 2) AS sqs FROM scan_c
), mesh_m AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::float AS faces,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::float AS verts,
         (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::float AS mres,
         (mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::float AS tex,
         (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::float AS geom
  FROM mesh
), mesh_q AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
         (faces/(verts*mres*mres)*1000)
         * ((tex/(sqrt(faces)*mres)*0.01)/10)
         * (1 + exp(-geom)) AS mfs
  FROM mesh_m
), dpq AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
         0.3*(0.4*s.sqs + 0.4*m.mfs + 0.2*s.sce - 5*sqrt(s.noise/10))
         + 0.3*m.mfs + 0.2*s.rar + 0.2*s.sce
         - 2*sqrt(s.err/s.res) AS dpq
  FROM scan_q s JOIN mesh_q m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneref
)
SELECT st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel, AVG(d.dpq) AS dpq
FROM sites st JOIN dpq d ON d.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel
ORDER BY dpq DESC;

WITH conv AS (
  SELECT member_fan_pivot AS fan,
         (CURRENT_DATE - memb_days) AS sub_date
  FROM membershipandspending
  WHERE memb_kind <> 'Free' AND memb_days IS NOT NULL
), first_int AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fan, MIN(time_mark) AS first_ts
  FROM interactions
  GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
), journey AS (
  SELECT c.fan,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.sub_date::timestamp - f.first_ts)) / 86400.0 AS days_to_conversion,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interactions i
           WHERE i.interact_fan_pivot = c.fan
             AND i.time_mark < c.sub_date) AS interactions_before_conversion
  FROM conv c
  JOIN first_int f ON f.fan = c.fan
  WHERE c.sub_date > f.first_ts
)
SELECT AVG(days_to_conversion) AS avg_days_to_conversion,
       AVG(interactions_before_conversion) AS avg_interactions_before_conversion
FROM journey;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tm.recip_ref_reg, tm.org_spec
  FROM transplant_matching tm
), w AS (
  SELECT p.recip_ref_reg,
         p.org_spec,
         CAST(substring(c.wait_time FROM '(\d+)') AS int) AS wait_days,
         ri.pra_score,
         CASE WHEN c.comorbid_detail IS NULL OR btrim(c.comorbid_detail) = '' THEN 0
              ELSE cardinality(string_to_array(c.comorbid_detail, ',')) END AS comorbidity_count
  FROM p
  JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = p.recip_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = p.recip_ref_reg
), r AS (
  SELECT w.*,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY org_spec ORDER BY wait_days DESC) AS pr
  FROM w
)
SELECT recip_ref_reg, org_spec, wait_days, pra_score, comorbidity_count
FROM r
WHERE pr <= 0.02
ORDER BY org_spec, wait_days DESC;

WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT d.physicalstats->>'Ethnicity' AS donor_ethnicity,
         r.ethn_grp AS recipient_ethnicity,
         regexp_replace(split_part(d.blood_class, ' ', 1), '[+-]', '', 'g') AS donor_abo,
         regexp_replace(r.blood_class, '[+-]', '', 'g') AS recip_abo,
         cm.hla_mis_count,
         1 - abs((d.physicalstats->>'Bmi_Value')::numeric / NULLIF(r.bmi_val::numeric, 0) - 1) AS size_score
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN recipients_demographics r ON r.recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
), optimal AS (
  SELECT * FROM pairs
  WHERE (recip_abo = 'AB' OR donor_abo = 'O' OR donor_abo = recip_abo)
    AND hla_mis_count = 0
    AND size_score BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.1
)
SELECT donor_ethnicity,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'African')   AS "African",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Asian')     AS "Asian",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Caucasian') AS "Caucasian",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Hispanic')  AS "Hispanic",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Other')     AS "Other"
FROM optimal
GROUP BY donor_ethnicity
ORDER BY donor_ethnicity;

WITH enc AS (
  SELECT e.enc_key, e.pat_ref, e.clin_id, e.fac_id, e.miss_appt
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN facilities f ON f.fac_key = e.fac_id
  WHERE f.com_res IN ('Adequate', 'Comprehensive', 'Extensive')
),
crisis AS (
  SELECT enc_ref, SUM(crisis_int) AS ci
  FROM treatmentbasics
  GROUP BY enc_ref
),
agg AS (
  SELECT enc.clin_id, enc.fac_id,
         SUM(COALESCE(c.ci, 0))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT enc.pat_ref), 0) AS cif,
         SUM(COALESCE(enc.miss_appt, 0))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT enc.pat_ref), 0) AS mar
  FROM enc
  LEFT JOIN crisis c ON c.enc_ref = enc.enc_key
  GROUP BY enc.clin_id, enc.fac_id
),
psm AS (
  SELECT clin_id, fac_id, 1.0 / (1 + cif + mar) AS psm
  FROM agg
)
SELECT clin_id, fac_id, psm,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fac_id ORDER BY psm DESC) AS psm_rank
FROM psm
ORDER BY fac_id, psm_rank
LIMIT 100;

WITH hp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT asd.prim_dx, e.clin_id, e.pat_ref
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON asr.asr_key = e.ab_ref
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref

    AND (asr.phq9_scr > 19 OR asr.gad7_scr > 14)
)
SELECT prim_dx,
       clin_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref) AS patient_count,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY prim_dx ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref) DESC) AS clinician_rank
FROM hp

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.actrecref AS botcode,
         r.modelseriesval,
         o.apptypeval,
         a.payloadwval / NULLIF(r.payloadcapkg, 0) AS payload_utilization_ratio,
         60.0 / NULLIF(o.cycletimesecval, 0) AS throughput_rate
  FROM actuation_data a
  JOIN operation o ON a.actoperref = o.operreg
  JOIN robot_details r ON r.botdetreg = a.actrecref
  WHERE o.cycletimesecval IS NOT NULL AND o.cycletimesecval > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY apptypeval ORDER BY throughput_rate DESC) AS throughput_quintile
  FROM base
)
SELECT botcode, modelseriesval, payload_utilization_ratio, throughput_rate
FROM ranked
WHERE throughput_quintile = 1
  AND payload_utilization_ratio > 0.8
ORDER BY payload_utilization_ratio DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT o.operrecref AS robot,
         CASE WHEN o.apptypeval IN ('Welding','Grinding','Deburring','Palletizing','Machine Tending')
              THEN 'High-Wear Applications' ELSE 'Other Applications' END AS application_group,
         o.totopshrval / NULLIF(ps.emergencystopcount, 0) AS mtbs
  FROM operation o
  JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actoperref = o.operreg
  JOIN performance_and_safety ps ON ps.effectivenessactuation = a.actreg
)
SELECT application_group,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT robot) FILTER (WHERE mtbs < 500) / COUNT(DISTINCT robot), 2) AS high_reliability_risk_pct
FROM base
GROUP BY application_group
ORDER BY application_group;

WITH b AS (
  SELECT h.hr_ops_ref,
         (h.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical')::numeric
           / NULLIF(COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric, 0)
                  + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0), 0) AS msr,
         CASE e.health_environment_profile->'health'->>'disease_risk'
              WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS disease_risk_score,
         100 - (e.health_environment_profile->'environment'->>'sanitation_coverage')::numeric AS sanitation_risk,
         100 - replace(e.health_environment_profile->'environment'->>'water_quality_index', ' WQI', '')::numeric AS water_quality_risk
  FROM humanresources h
  JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = h.hrdistref
  JOIN environmentandhealth e ON e.env_dist_ref = d.distregistry
), s AS (
  SELECT hr_ops_ref,
         ((1 - msr) * 40) + (disease_risk_score * 10) + (sanitation_risk * 0.15) + (water_quality_risk * 0.15) AS phrs
  FROM b
)
SELECT hr_ops_ref AS opsregistry, ROUND(phrs, 2) AS public_health_risk_score
FROM s
WHERE phrs > 70
ORDER BY phrs DESC;

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW v_inflated_giants_report AS
SELECT s.hostplname || ' ' || p.completter AS planet_name,
       s.hostplname AS host_star,
       pp.massjup,
       pp.radjup,
       pp.densvalue,
       ROUND(((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value')::numeric
         * SQRT(((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric * 0.00465047)
                / (2 * o.semimajor::numeric)))) AS equilibrium_temp_k
FROM planets p
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
JOIN orbital_characteristics o ON o.bodylink = p.planetref
WHERE pp.massjup > 0.1
  AND pp.densvalue < 0.5
  AND s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value' IS NOT NULL
  AND s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value' IS NOT NULL
  AND o.semimajor IS NOT NULL AND o.semimajor > 0;

  SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "HIST_sign") AS hist_p90,
         percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric) AS cult_p90
  FROM "ArtifactRatings"
)

       s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light' AS light_sensitivity,
       s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature' AS temperature_sensitivity,
       s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' AS humidity_sensitivity
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
CROSS JOIN thr
WHERE a."MatKind" IN ('Wood','Textile','Paper')
  AND s."ENVsense" = 'High'
  AND r."HIST_sign" >= thr.hist_p90
  AND (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric >= thr.cult_p90;

WITH h AS (
  SELECT "Hall_ID",
    (security_visitor_overview->'visitor_statistics'->>'avg_daily_visitors')::numeric AS visitors,
    CASE security_visitor_overview->'visitor_statistics'->>'visitor_flow'
         WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'High' THEN 5 END AS flow,
    (security_visitor_overview->'visitor_statistics'->>'avg_dwell_minutes')::numeric AS dwell,
      COALESCE(CASE security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'cctv_coverage'    WHEN 'Full'   THEN 3 WHEN 'Partial' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited'     THEN 1 END, 0)
    + COALESCE(CASE security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'motion_detection' WHEN 'Active' THEN 3 WHEN 'Partial' THEN 2 WHEN 'Maintenance' THEN 1 END, 0)
    + COALESCE(CASE security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'alarm_status'     WHEN 'Armed'  THEN 3 WHEN 'Partial' THEN 2 WHEN 'Maintenance' THEN 1 END, 0)
    + COALESCE(CASE security_visitor_overview->'security'->>'access_control'   WHEN 'Active' THEN 3 WHEN 'Partial' THEN 2 WHEN 'Maintenance' THEN 1 END, 0) AS security_score
  FROM "ExhibitionHalls"
), s AS (
  SELECT "Hall_ID", visitors * flow * dwell / 1000.0 AS visitor_impact_risk, security_score
  FROM h
)
SELECT "Hall_ID", visitor_impact_risk, security_score
FROM s
WHERE visitor_impact_risk > 15 AND security_score < 8
ORDER BY visitor_impact_risk DESC;

  AND r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'threat_level' = 'Critical'
  AND 0.4 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::numeric
    + 0.3 * (1 - (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score')::numeric)
    + 0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::numeric > 0.8
  AND a."StateFlag" IS DISTINCT FROM 'Suspended';

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.acct_ref,
         p."PLT_KIND",
         0.4 * (1 - (c.content_metrics #>> '{content_quality,content_uniqueness}')::numeric)
       + 0.3 * (c.content_metrics #>> '{link_media,media_reuse_rate}')::numeric
       + 0.3 * (1 - (c.content_metrics #>> '{content_quality,content_uniqueness}')::numeric) AS cms,
         0.3 * (r.risk_profile #>> '{violation_history,abuse_count}')::numeric / 1000
       + 0.4 * (r.risk_profile #>> '{risk_scores,impact_score}')::numeric
       + 0.3 * (r.risk_profile #>> '{risk_scores,risk_value}')::numeric AS mps,
         n."ConnQual"::numeric AS connqual,
         n."IntDiv"::numeric   AS intdiv
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN platforms p           ON p."PLT_CODE" = a.plt_key
  JOIN content_activity c    ON c.acct_slot = a.acct_ref
  JOIN risk_and_moderation r ON r.acct_risk = a.acct_ref
  JOIN network_metrics n     ON n.acct_node = a.acct_ref
),
netinfl AS (
  SELECT ac.acct_bridge, AVG(ca."NetInfl"::numeric) AS netinfl
  FROM account_clusters ac
  JOIN cluster_analysis ca ON ca."CLSTR_PIN" = ac.clu_ref
  GROUP BY ac.acct_bridge
)
SELECT b."PLT_KIND",
       AVG(b.cms * b.mps * (0.4 * b.connqual + 0.3 * ni.netinfl + 0.3 * b.intdiv)) AS avg_cis
FROM base b
JOIN netinfl ni ON ni.acct_bridge = b.acct_ref
GROUP BY b."PLT_KIND"
ORDER BY b."PLT_KIND";

SELECT ROUND((o.mttrh / NULLIF(o.mtbfh + o.mttrh, 0))::numeric, 4) AS system_unavailability
FROM plants p
JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.sitetie = p.sitekey
JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = pr.snapkey
WHERE lower(p.sitelabel) = 'solar plant west davidport';

SELECT r.snapkey,
 ROUND(((ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric
   / (1 - ((e.env_snapshot->'temperatures'->>'cell_temp_c')::numeric - 25) * ABS(pm.tempcoeff::numeric) / 100)), 2) AS temp_corrected_power_w
FROM plant_record r
JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
JOIN environmental_conditions e ON e.snapref = r.snapkey
JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = r.snapkey
WHERE r.snapkey = 'PV945724';

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT p.sitekey,
         (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'cumulative_deg_pct')::numeric AS cum_deg_pct,
         (CURRENT_DATE - p.goliveon) / 365.25 AS age_years,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.sitekey ORDER BY r.snapts DESC) AS rn
  FROM plants p
  JOIN plant_record r ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
  JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
  WHERE lower(p.warrstate) = 'claimed'
    AND p.warrclaims >= 3
    AND p.goliveon IS NOT NULL
    AND e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'cumulative_deg_pct' IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM((cum_deg_pct / age_years) / 100.0 * 500000 * 0.12 * 15), 2) AS total_lifetime_revenue_loss
FROM latest
WHERE rn = 1 AND age_years > 0;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT pr.sitetie,
         (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric AS pl,
         (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric  AS pn,
         om.mtbfh::numeric AS mtbf,
         om.mttrh::numeric AS mttr
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
  JOIN operational_metrics  om ON om.snapops  = pr.snapkey
  WHERE ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w' IS NOT NULL
    AND ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w'  IS NOT NULL
    AND om.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND om.mtbfh <> 'NaN'
    AND om.mttrh IS NOT NULL AND om.mttrh <> 'NaN'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sitetie) AS lemon_plant_count
FROM m
WHERE pl / NULLIF(pn + pl, 0) > 0.25
  AND mttr / NULLIF(mtbf + mttr, 0) > 0.05;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(
         (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'fill_factor_initial')::numeric
       - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'fill_factor_now')::numeric
       ), 3) AS avg_fill_factor_degradation
FROM mechanical_condition m
JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = m.snapmk
WHERE LOWER(m.mech_health_snapshot->'module_surface'->>'busbar_corrosion') = 'severe'
  AND e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'fill_factor_initial' IS NOT NULL
  AND e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'fill_factor_now' IS NOT NULL;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT snapkey, sitetie,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sitetie ORDER BY snapts DESC) AS rn
  FROM plant_record
  WHERE snapts IS NOT NULL
), calc AS (
  SELECT l.sitetie,
         (om.maintcost + om.cleancost + om.replcost) / p.cap_mw AS oei,
         (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric AS p_out,
         (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric AS p_loss
  FROM latest l
  JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = l.sitetie
  JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = l.snapkey
  JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = l.snapkey
  WHERE l.rn = 1
    AND p.cap_mw IS NOT NULL AND p.cap_mw <> 'NaN' AND p.cap_mw > 0
    AND om.maintcost IS NOT NULL AND om.maintcost <> 'NaN'
    AND om.cleancost IS NOT NULL AND om.cleancost <> 'NaN'
    AND om.replcost IS NOT NULL AND om.replcost <> 'NaN'
    AND jsonb_typeof(ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->'power_now_w') = 'number'
    AND jsonb_typeof(ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->'power_loss_w') = 'number'
)
SELECT sitetie, ROUND(p_loss / (p_out + p_loss), 4) AS system_power_loss_ratio
FROM calc
WHERE p_out + p_loss <> 0
ORDER BY oei DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.maintcost / (17520.0 / o.mtbfh))::numeric, 0) AS mean_repair_cost
FROM plants p
JOIN panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook
JOIN plant_record r ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
WHERE m.pnlkind ILIKE 'hjt'
  AND o.mtbfh IS NOT NULL
  AND o.mtbfh > 0;

SELECT SUM(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(om.revloss), '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric) AS total_revenue_loss
FROM operational_metrics om
JOIN mechanical_condition mc ON mc.snapmk = om.snapops
WHERE mc.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'grounding_status' = 'Failed'
   OR mc.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'bypass_diode_status' <> 'Normal';

WITH snap AS (
    SELECT
        o.mttrh,
        (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'cumulative_deg_pct')::numeric
            / NULLIF((CURRENT_DATE - p.goliveon) / 365.25, 0) AS adr
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p                  ON p.sitekey  = pr.sitetie
    JOIN electrical_performance e  ON e.snaplink = pr.snapkey
    JOIN operational_metrics o     ON o.snapops  = pr.snapkey
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(mttrh)::numeric, 2) AS avg_mttr_hours
FROM snap
WHERE adr > 0.5;

SELECT MAX((ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::numeric) AS max_soil_loss_pct
FROM plants p
JOIN plant_record r ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = r.snapkey
WHERE p.envtag = 'High';

SELECT LOWER(pm.pnlkind) AS panel_type,
       AVG(((ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric
            - (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v')::numeric)
           / (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric) AS avg_voltage_degradation_factor
FROM electrical_performance ep
JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = ep.snaplink
JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
WHERE ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v' IS NOT NULL
  AND ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v' IS NOT NULL
  AND (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric <> 0
GROUP BY LOWER(pm.pnlkind)
ORDER BY avg_voltage_degradation_factor DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.sitetie) AS plant_count
FROM mechanical_condition mc
JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = mc.snapmk
WHERE LOWER(mc.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'grounding_status') = 'failed'
   OR LOWER(mc.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'bypass_diode_status') <> 'normal';

WITH base AS (
  SELECT o.snapops,
         o.maintcost,
         o.mtbfh,
         o.mttrh,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.snapts - p.goliveon::timestamp)) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
  FROM operational_metrics o
  JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = o.snapops
  JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
  WHERE o.mtbfh > 0
)
SELECT AVG(maintcost / (total_hours / mtbfh)) AS avg_mean_repair_cost
FROM base
WHERE total_hours > 0
  AND mttrh / (mtbfh + mttrh) > 1.0 / 20;

SELECT (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric
       * (1 - (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric
              / ((ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric
                 + (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric)) AS effective_power_output_w
FROM electrical_performance ep
WHERE UPPER(ep.snaplink) = UPPER('pv945724');

SELECT AVG(
         ((ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'imp_initial_a')::numeric
          - (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'imp_now_a')::numeric)
         / (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'imp_initial_a')::numeric
       ) AS avg_current_degradation_factor
FROM electrical_performance ep
JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = ep.snaplink
JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
WHERE LOWER(pm.makertag) = 'longi'
  AND (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'imp_initial_a')::numeric > 0;

CREATE VIEW v_plant_performance_overview AS
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT pr.snapkey, pr.sitetie, pr.snapts,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.sitetie ORDER BY pr.snapts DESC) AS rn
  FROM plant_record pr
)
SELECT p.sitelabel,
       l.snapts,
       (ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::real AS power_now_w,
       (ec.env_snapshot->'irradiance'->>'poa_irr_w_m2')::real AS poa_irr_w_m2,

LEFT JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = l.snapkey
LEFT JOIN environmental_conditions ec ON ec.snapref = l.snapkey

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_yearly_plant_yield AS
SELECT p.sitelabel,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.snapts) AS year,
       SUM((ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::numeric) AS total_yield_kwh

WHERE ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh' IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE panel_cleaning_schedule (
  schedule_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  sitekey TEXT,
  last_clean_date DATE,
  next_due_date DATE
);

INSERT INTO panel_cleaning_schedule (sitekey, last_clean_date, next_due_date)
SELECT sitetie, last_clean, last_clean + cycle_days
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pr.sitetie)
         pr.sitetie,
         (mc.mech_health_snapshot->'mount_cleaning'->>'last_clean_date')::date AS last_clean,
         (mc.mech_health_snapshot->'mount_cleaning'->>'cleaning_cycle_days')::int AS cycle_days
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN mechanical_condition mc ON mc.snapmk = pr.snapkey
  ORDER BY pr.sitetie, pr.snapts DESC
) t;

CREATE VIEW v_environmental_extremes AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT pr.sitetie, pr.snapts,
         (ec.env_snapshot->'temperatures'->>'ambient_temp_c')::numeric AS ambient_temp_c,
         (ec.env_snapshot->'wind_rain_snow'->>'wind_speed_m_s')::numeric AS wind_speed_m_s,
         (ec.env_snapshot->'atmospheric'->>'uv_index')::numeric AS uv_index
  FROM environmental_conditions ec
  JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = ec.snapref
),
records AS (
  SELECT 'Highest Ambient Temperature' AS record_type, sitetie, ambient_temp_c AS record_value, snapts,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ambient_temp_c DESC) AS rnk
  FROM base WHERE ambient_temp_c IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Strongest Wind Speed', sitetie, wind_speed_m_s, snapts,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wind_speed_m_s DESC)
  FROM base WHERE wind_speed_m_s IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Most Intense UV Index', sitetie, uv_index, snapts,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY uv_index DESC)
  FROM base WHERE uv_index IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT record_type, sitetie, record_value, snapts
FROM records
WHERE rnk = 1;

SELECT "PlatCode",
       ROUND(((0.4 * (platform_compliance->>'vuln_inst_count')::numeric
             + 0.3 * (platform_compliance->>'sec_event_count')::numeric
             + 0.3 * NULLIF(regexp_replace("RepScore", '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric) / 100), 4) AS mrs
FROM markets
ORDER BY mrs DESC NULLS LAST, "PlatCode";

UPDATE vendors

WHERE ("InvestigationFlag" = 'Active' OR "LE_Interest" = 'High')
  AND "ComplianceRisk" IS DISTINCT FROM 'High'
RETURNING "SellerKey";

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS secure_platforms;

SELECT "PlatCode",
       (0.4 * (platform_compliance->>'vuln_inst_count')::numeric
      + 0.3 * (platform_compliance->>'sec_event_count')::numeric
      + 0.3 * NULLIF(regexp_replace("RepScore", '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric) / 100 AS mrs
FROM markets
WHERE (platform_compliance->>'vuln_inst_count')::numeric < 10
  AND (platform_compliance->>'protection_meas_count')::numeric > 15;

INSERT INTO alerts ("EventTag", "ReviewFreq", "NextReviewDt", "AnnotationCount")
SELECT ra."TxnLink", 'Daily', CURRENT_DATE + 1, 0
FROM risk_analytics ra
WHERE ra."FraudProb" > 70
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alerts a WHERE a."EventTag" = ra."TxnLink")
ON CONFLICT ("EventTag") DO NOTHING;

WITH vp AS (
  SELECT "SellerPointer", AVG((product_availability->>'price_amt')::numeric) AS avg_price
  FROM products
  GROUP BY "SellerPointer"
), plr AS (
  SELECT v."SellerKey",
         v."CompletedTxns" * vp.avg_price / NULLIF(v."DaysActive", 0) AS plr
  FROM vendors v
  JOIN vp ON vp."SellerPointer" = v."SellerKey"
)
SELECT p."SellerKey", p.plr, t."RouteComplex"
FROM plr p
JOIN transactions t ON t."VendorLink" = p."SellerKey"
GROUP BY p."SellerKey", p.plr, t."RouteComplex"
ORDER BY p.plr DESC NULLS LAST, p."SellerKey", t."RouteComplex";

SELECT cs."TxnPointer",
       split_part(cs."Threat_handle_rate", ' ', 1)::numeric AS threat_handle_rate,
       b."AuthLevel"
FROM connection_security cs
JOIN transactions t ON t."EventCode" = cs."TxnPointer"
JOIN buyers b ON b."AcqCode" = t."AcqLink"
ORDER BY cs."TxnPointer";

SELECT "EventLink",
       ROUND((communication_details->>'keyword_match_count')::numeric
             / NULLIF((communication_details->>'msg_count_total')::numeric, 0), 3) AS ssd
FROM communications
WHERE communication_details->>'comm_channel_type' IN ('External', 'Internal')
ORDER BY ssd DESC NULLS LAST;
ANALYZE vendors;

SELECT "RouteComplex", COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions
GROUP BY "RouteComplex"
ORDER BY CASE "RouteComplex" WHEN 'Complex' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Simple' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;

SELECT m."PlatCode",
       m."OperStatus",
       COUNT(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'escalation_tier_stat' = 'Level3') AS tier3_case_count,
       CASE MAX(CASE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat'
                  WHEN 'Critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END)
            WHEN 4 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 3 THEN 'High' WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium' WHEN 1 THEN 'Low' END AS max_alert_severity
FROM markets m
LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t."PlatformKey" = m."PlatCode"
LEFT JOIN alerts a ON a."EventTag" = t."EventCode"
WHERE (m.platform_compliance->>'vuln_inst_count')::int < 10
  AND (m.platform_compliance->>'protection_meas_count')::int > 15
GROUP BY m."PlatCode", m."OperStatus"
ORDER BY tier3_case_count DESC, m."PlatCode";
CREATE INDEX idx_transactions_crossborder ON transactions ("CrossBorder");

WITH live AS (
  SELECT "ProdCat", "Subcategory", "ListingAge", "SellerPointer"
  FROM products
  WHERE (product_availability->>'qty_avail')::numeric > 0
), sus_buyers AS (
  SELECT "AcqCode"
  FROM buyers
  WHERE (buyer_risk_profile->>'behavior_consistency_scr')::numeric < 50
    AND split_part(buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio', ' ', 1)::numeric > 0.1
), lt AS (
  SELECT l.*, t."AcqLink", c.communication_details->>'lang_pattern_type' AS lp
  FROM live l
  LEFT JOIN transaction_products tp USING ("ProdCat", "Subcategory", "ListingAge", "SellerPointer")
  LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t."EventCode" = tp."EventLink"
  LEFT JOIN communications c ON c."EventLink" = t."EventCode"
)
SELECT "ProdCat",
       COUNT(DISTINCT ("Subcategory", "ListingAge", "SellerPointer")) AS live_listings,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ("Subcategory", "ListingAge", "SellerPointer")) FILTER (WHERE lp = 'Suspicious') AS suspicious_description_listings,
       COUNT(DISTINCT "AcqLink") FILTER (WHERE "AcqLink" IN (SELECT "AcqCode" FROM sus_buyers)) AS suspicious_buyers
FROM lt
GROUP BY "ProdCat"
ORDER BY "ProdCat";

WITH s AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN "AnonLevel"::numeric < 4 THEN 'Low'
              WHEN "AnonLevel"::numeric < 7 THEN 'Medium'
              ELSE 'High' END AS anon_level,
         (connection_security_metrics->>'session_sec_rating_scr')::numeric AS sec
  FROM connection_security
)
SELECT anon_level,
       ROUND(AVG(sec), 2) AS avg_session_security_rating
FROM s
GROUP BY anon_level
ORDER BY CASE anon_level WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

SELECT communication_details->>'comm_channel_type' AS comm_channel_type,
       ROUND(AVG((communication_details->>'keyword_match_count')::numeric
                 / NULLIF((communication_details->>'msg_count_total')::numeric, 0)), 3) AS avg_ssd
FROM communications
GROUP BY communication_details->>'comm_channel_type'
ORDER BY avg_ssd DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_transactions
FROM transactions t
JOIN risk_analytics r ON r."TxnLink" = t."EventCode"
WHERE r."FraudProb" > 70
  AND t."CrossBorder" = 1;

CREATE TABLE suspicious_buyers_cap AS
SELECT "AcqCode",
       (buyer_risk_profile->>'behavior_consistency_scr')::numeric AS behavior_consistency_scr,
       split_part(buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio',' ',1)::numeric AS risk_dollar_ratio,
       (buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_metric_scr')::numeric
         / NULLIF(split_part(buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio',' ',1)::numeric,0) AS total_spending_usd
FROM buyers
WHERE (buyer_risk_profile->>'behavior_consistency_scr')::numeric < 50
  AND split_part(buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio',' ',1)::numeric > 0.1

         / NULLIF(split_part(buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio',' ',1)::numeric,0) >= 10;

-- 1) Breakdown by key groups
SELECT assigned_team,
       priority_level,
       COUNT(time_to_first_response_mins) AS workflow_count,
       ROUND(AVG(time_to_first_response_mins), 2) AS avg_first_response_mins,
       ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_first_response_mins)::numeric, 2) AS p90_first_response_mins,
       MAX(time_to_first_response_mins) AS max_first_response_mins
FROM "AlertResponseWorkflow"

GROUP BY assigned_team, priority_level
ORDER BY avg_first_response_mins DESC;

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_first_response_mins) AS p50_mins,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_first_response_mins) AS p90_mins,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_first_response_mins) AS p95_mins,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_first_response_mins) AS p99_mins,
       MAX(time_to_first_response_mins) AS max_mins
FROM "AlertResponseWorkflow"
WHERE time_to_first_response_mins IS NOT NULL;

ORDER BY time_to_first_response_mins DESC, "ARW_id"

       (platform_compliance->>'protection_meas_count')::bigint AS protection_meas_count

SELECT ROUND(

         / COUNT(*), 2) AS escrow_ratio
