SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel,
       AVG(100
           - 2.5 * ABS((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20)
           - POWER(ABS(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50) / 2), 1.5)
           - 600 / ((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100)) AS avg_esi
FROM environment e
JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC;

SELECT s.zoneregistry,
       s.zonelabel,
       c.structstate,
       s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' AS pres_stat,
       CASE WHEN (s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Poor%' OR s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Critical%')
                 AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%'
            THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone' ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' END AS risk_zone_category
FROM sites s
JOIN conservation c ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
WHERE (s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Poor%' OR s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Critical%')
  AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%'
ORDER BY s.zoneregistry;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.logregistry, r.arcref,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS log_accu_mm,
         (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err_val_mm,
         r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' AS log_method,
         (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS scan_resol_mm
  FROM registration r
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = r.arcref AND p.crewref = r.crewref
), calc AS (
  SELECT *, scan_resol_mm / (log_accu_mm * sqrt(1 + err_val_mm / log_accu_mm)) AS rar
  FROM base
)
SELECT logregistry, arcref, log_accu_mm, err_val_mm, rar,
       CASE WHEN rar > 1.5 AND log_method ILIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence'
            WHEN rar BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence'
            ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS confidence_category
FROM calc
ORDER BY rar DESC;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric
      / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * power((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr,
    (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS res,
    (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geom
  FROM mesh
), agg AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel,
    count(m.zoneref) AS total_meshes,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.mcr > 5.0 AND m.res < 1.0 AND m.geom < 0.5) AS high_fidelity_meshes,
    avg(m.mcr) AS avg_mcr,
    avg(m.res) AS avg_resolution_mm,
    avg(m.geom) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry, zonelabel, total_meshes, high_fidelity_meshes,
  CASE WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN high_fidelity_meshes * 100.0 / total_meshes END AS high_fidelity_percentage,
  avg_mcr, avg_resolution_mm, avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
  CASE WHEN high_fidelity_meshes > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes'
       WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN 'Standard Mesh Quality'
       ELSE 'No Mesh Data' END AS mesh_quality_category
FROM agg
ORDER BY high_fidelity_percentage DESC NULLS LAST, high_fidelity_meshes DESC, avg_mcr DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH e AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    (ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric AS temp,
    (ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric AS hum,
    (ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric AS lux,
    100 - 2.5*abs((ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20)
        - power(abs(((ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50)/2), 1.5)
        - 600/((ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100) AS esi
  FROM environment
), s AS (
  SELECT st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel,
    avg(e.temp) AS avg_temp, avg(e.hum) AS avg_hum, avg(e.lux) AS avg_lux, avg(e.esi) AS avg_esi
  FROM sites st JOIN e ON e.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry, zonelabel,
  avg_temp AS avg_temperature, avg_hum AS avg_humidity, avg_lux AS avg_illumination,
  avg_esi AS esi,
  ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_esi DESC) AS esi_quartile,
  CASE WHEN avg_esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
       WHEN avg_esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
       WHEN avg_esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
       ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_condition
FROM s
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS total_pts,
         (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric AS cloud_dense,
         (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::numeric AS area_m2,
         (f.feature_analysis->>'Trait_Count')::numeric AS trait_count,
         (f.feature_analysis->>'Arti_Count')::numeric AS arti_count
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN scans sc ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  LEFT JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = sc.arcref AND pc.crewref = sc.crewref
  LEFT JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = sc.arcref AND sp.crewref = sc.crewref
  LEFT JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
), calc AS (
  SELECT zoneregistry,
         total_pts / NULLIF(cloud_dense * area_m2, 0) AS pcdr,
         trait_count, arti_count, cloud_dense
  FROM base
)
SELECT zoneregistry,
       AVG(pcdr) AS avg_pcdr,
       AVG((trait_count + arti_count) / NULLIF(pcdr * SQRT(cloud_dense), 0) * 1000) AS avg_fee
FROM calc
GROUP BY zoneregistry
ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH rec AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry,
         (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS flow_hrs,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
         ((p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric
            * ((p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric + (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric) / 2)
         / NULLIF(split_part(s.size, ' ', 1)::numeric * 10
                  * log(10, (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric + 10000), 0) AS pru
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN processing p ON p.equipref = e.equipregistry
  LEFT JOIN scans s      ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN mesh m       ON m.zoneref = p.zoneref AND m.equipref = p.equipref
), agg AS (
  SELECT equipregistry,
         AVG(pru)      AS pru,
         AVG(flow_hrs) AS avg_processing_hours,
         AVG(cpu)      AS cpu_usage,
         AVG(gpu)      AS gpu_usage
  FROM rec
  GROUP BY equipregistry
)
SELECT agg.equipregistry,
       ROUND(agg.pru, 2) AS pru,
       agg.avg_processing_hours,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY agg.pru ASC NULLS LAST) AS efficiency_rank,
       CASE WHEN agg.pru < 5   THEN 'Optimized'
            WHEN agg.pru <= 10 THEN 'Acceptable'
            WHEN agg.pru > 10  THEN 'Needs Optimization'
            ELSE 'Insufficient Data' END AS workflow_status,
       jsonb_build_object('cpu_usage', agg.cpu_usage,
                          'gpu_usage', agg.gpu_usage,
                          'processing_hours', agg.avg_processing_hours) AS resource_details
FROM agg
ORDER BY agg.pru ASC NULLS LAST, agg.equipregistry;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.flowregistry,
         CASE
           WHEN lower(regexp_replace(p.flowsoft,'[^A-Za-z]','','g')) IN ('agi','agisoft','agisoftmetashape','metashape') THEN 'Agisoft'
           WHEN lower(regexp_replace(p.flowsoft,'[^A-Za-z]','','g')) IN ('cc','cloudcompare','cloudcomp') THEN 'CloudCompare'
           WHEN lower(regexp_replace(p.flowsoft,'[^A-Za-z]','','g')) IN ('geo','geomagic','geomagicstudio') THEN 'Geomagic'
           WHEN lower(regexp_replace(p.flowsoft,'[^A-Za-z]','','g')) IN ('rc','realitycapture') THEN 'RealityCapture'
           ELSE p.flowsoft
         END AS software,
         p.flowstage AS stage,
         (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS flow_hrs,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
         (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(s.size,'[^0-9.]','','g'),'')::numeric AS size_gb,
         (c.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS total_pts
  FROM processing p
  JOIN scans s ON s.zoneref = p.zoneref
  JOIN pointcloud c ON c.arcref = s.arcref AND c.crewref = s.crewref
), per AS (
  SELECT *,
         (size_gb * log(10, total_pts)) / NULLIF(flow_hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 200.0, 0) AS per_val
  FROM base
)
SELECT software,
       stage,
       AVG(flow_hrs) AS avg_processing_hours,
       AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu_usage,
       AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu_usage,
       AVG(size_gb) AS avg_data_size_gb,
       AVG(per_val) AS avg_per,
       CASE WHEN AVG(per_val) < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status,
       COUNT(DISTINCT flowregistry) AS workflow_count
FROM per
GROUP BY software, stage
ORDER BY efficiency_status, avg_per;

CREATE TABLE high_fidelity_meshes AS
SELECT m.facetregistry, m.zoneref, m.equipref,
       (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::bigint AS facet_verts,
       (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::bigint AS facet_faces,
       (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::real AS facet_res_mm,
       (m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::real AS geom_delta_mm,
       (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric
         / NULLIF((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * power((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2), 0) * 1000 AS mcr
FROM mesh m
WHERE (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric
        / NULLIF((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * power((m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2), 0) * 1000 > 5.0
  AND (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric < 1.0
  AND (m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric < 0.5;

CREATE VIEW view_premium_quality_scans AS
SELECT s.questregistry, s.arcref, s.zoneref, s.chronotag,
  (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::real AS scan_resol_mm,
  (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::bigint AS point_dense,
  (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::real AS cover_pct,
  (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::real AS lap_pct,
  (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::real AS noise_db
FROM scans s
JOIN pointcloud p ON s.arcref = p.arcref AND s.crewref = p.crewref
WHERE (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::real <= 1.0
  AND (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::bigint >= 1000
  AND (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::real >= 95
  AND (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::real >= 30
  AND (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::real < 1.5;

CREATE VIEW site_esi AS
SELECT zoneref,
       ROUND((100
         - 2.5 * ABS((ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20)
         - POWER(ABS(((ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50) / 2), 1.5)
         - 600 / ((ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100))::numeric, 2) AS esi
FROM environment;

SELECT df."RecordRegistry",
       ROUND((rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric, 2) AS risk_score,
       ROUND((dp.vol_gb * CASE dp."dataSense" WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)::numeric, 2) AS dsi
FROM "DataFlow" df
JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON rm.flow_link = df."RecordRegistry"
JOIN "DataProfile" dp ON dp."Flow_Sign" = df."RecordRegistry"
WHERE (rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric > 0.7
  AND dp.vol_gb * CASE dp."dataSense" WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END > 100
ORDER BY dsi DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH v AS (
  SELECT "Vendor_Trace",
    (CASE "vendSecRate" WHEN 'A' THEN 4 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 END)
    * (CASE WHEN "contrState" = 'Active' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.5 END) AS vri
  FROM "VendorManagement"
), t AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN vri < 2 THEN 'High Risk'
              WHEN vri < 3 THEN 'Medium Risk'
              ELSE 'Low Risk' END AS risk_tier
  FROM v
)
SELECT risk_tier,
       COUNT(*) AS vendor_count,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage
FROM t
GROUP BY risk_tier
ORDER BY vendor_count DESC;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT "RecordRegistry" AS flow_id,
         (flow_overview->'performance'->>'bandwidth_util_pct')::numeric
           * ((flow_overview->'performance'->>'data_size_mb')::numeric
              / NULLIF((flow_overview->'performance'->>'duration_min')::numeric, 0)) AS bsi,
         (flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric
           / ((flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1) AS dte
  FROM "DataFlow"
)
SELECT flow_id, ROUND(bsi, 2) AS bsi, ROUND(dte, 2) AS dte
FROM m
WHERE bsi > 50 AND dte < 1.0
ORDER BY bsi DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH x AS (
  SELECT dp."profileTrace",
         dp.vol_gb * CASE dp."dataSense" WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS dsi,
         CASE WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' AND sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 3
              WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' OR sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 2
              ELSE 1 END AS srs
  FROM "DataProfile" dp
  JOIN "SecurityProfile" sp ON sp.profile_key = dp."profileTrace"
)
SELECT "profileTrace", ROUND(dsi::numeric, 2) AS dsi, srs
FROM x
WHERE dsi > 100 AND srs < 2
ORDER BY dsi DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH audit_sev AS (
  SELECT to_char("REMED_DUE", 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
         "critFindNum"::numeric / ("FINDTALLY" + 1) AS afs
  FROM "AuditAndCompliance"
  WHERE "REMED_DUE" IS NOT NULL
    AND "critFindNum" IS NOT NULL
    AND "FINDTALLY" IS NOT NULL
), monthly AS (
  SELECT month, AVG(afs) AS avg_sev
  FROM audit_sev
  WHERE afs > 0.5
  GROUP BY month
), ranked AS (
  SELECT month,
         ROUND(avg_sev, 2) AS avg_severity,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_sev DESC) AS severity_rank
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, avg_severity, severity_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE severity_rank <= 3
ORDER BY month;

SELECT c."complianceTrace", c."gdprComp", c.loc_law_comp,
       (df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country') || ' -> ' || (df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country') AS transfer_path
FROM "Compliance" c
JOIN "DataFlow" df ON df."RecordRegistry" = c."recordRegistry"
WHERE ((df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country') IS DISTINCT FROM (df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country')
       OR df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' IS NULL
       OR df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' IS NULL)
  AND (c."gdprComp" = 'Non-compliant' OR c.loc_law_comp = 'Non-compliant')
ORDER BY c."complianceTrace"
LIMIT 10;

SELECT "AUDIT_TRACE",
  ROUND((("AccReqNum" + "DEL_REQ_NUM" + rect_req_num + "PORTREQNUM") * resp_time_day)::numeric, 2) AS dsrp,
  jsonb_build_object('access', "AccReqNum", 'deletion', "DEL_REQ_NUM", 'rectification', rect_req_num, 'portability', "PORTREQNUM") AS request_breakdown
FROM "AuditAndCompliance"
WHERE ("AccReqNum" + "DEL_REQ_NUM" + rect_req_num + "PORTREQNUM") * resp_time_day > 50
ORDER BY dsrp DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH b AS (
  SELECT df."RecordRegistry" AS flow_id,
         (rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric *
         CASE WHEN df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' <> df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS cbrf,
         dp.vol_gb::numeric AS vol
  FROM "DataFlow" df
  JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON rm.flow_link = df."RecordRegistry"
  JOIN "DataProfile" dp ON dp."Flow_Sign" = df."RecordRegistry"
  WHERE df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' <> df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country'
), c AS (
  SELECT flow_id, cbrf, cbrf * vol AS cdvr FROM b
)
SELECT flow_id,
       ROUND(cbrf, 2) AS cbrf,
       ROUND(cdvr, 2) AS cdvr,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cdvr DESC) AS risk_rank
FROM c
WHERE cdvr > 1000
ORDER BY cdvr DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT "profileTrace",
  (CASE WHEN "Int_check" = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN "CSUMVERIFY" = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS integrity_failure_count,
  CONCAT_WS(', ',
    CASE WHEN "Int_check" = 'Failed' THEN 'Integrity Check' END,
    CASE WHEN "CSUMVERIFY" = 'Failed' THEN 'Checksum Verification' END) AS failure_types
FROM "DataProfile"
WHERE "Int_check" = 'Failed' OR "CSUMVERIFY" = 'Failed'
ORDER BY integrity_failure_count DESC, "profileTrace"
LIMIT 10;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.record_registry AS flow_id,
         a."critFindNum"::numeric / (a."FINDTALLY" + 1) AS afs,
         (a."AccReqNum" + a."DEL_REQ_NUM" + a.rect_req_num + a."PORTREQNUM") AS dsrl,
         DATE '2025-04-01' - a."REMED_DUE" AS days_overdue,
         f.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' AS oc,
         f.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' AS dc
  FROM "AuditAndCompliance" a
  JOIN "DataFlow" f ON f."RecordRegistry" = a.record_registry
)
SELECT flow_id,
       ROUND(afs * dsrl * afs, 2) AS audit_compliance_pressure,
       days_overdue
FROM base
WHERE oc <> dc
  AND afs * dsrl * afs > 5
  AND days_overdue > 0
  AND days_overdue BETWEEN 0 AND 5
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, audit_compliance_pressure DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT f."RecordRegistry",
       f.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' AS origin_country,
       f.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' AS destination_country,
       v."Vendor_Trace"
FROM "Compliance" c
JOIN "DataFlow" f ON f."RecordRegistry" = c."recordRegistry"
LEFT JOIN "VendorManagement" v ON v."Vendor_Trace" = c."vendorTie"
WHERE (c."gdprComp" = 'Non-compliant' OR c.loc_law_comp = 'Non-compliant')
  AND f.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' <> f.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country'
ORDER BY f."RecordRegistry";

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_flow_metrics (
  recordregistry TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  last_success_pct REAL,
  last_error_count BIGINT,
  last_updated TIMESTAMP
);

WITH flow_dte AS (
  SELECT "RecordRegistry" AS recordregistry,
         (flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::real AS success_pct,
         (flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::bigint AS error_count,
         (flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::real
           / ((flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::bigint + 1) AS dte
  FROM "DataFlow"
)
INSERT INTO data_flow_metrics (recordregistry, last_success_pct, last_error_count, last_updated)
SELECT recordregistry, success_pct, error_count, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM flow_dte
ON CONFLICT (recordregistry) DO UPDATE
SET last_success_pct = EXCLUDED.last_success_pct,
    last_error_count = EXCLUDED.last_error_count,
    last_updated     = EXCLUDED.last_updated;

WITH x AS (
  SELECT d."profileTrace",
         d.vol_gb * CASE d."dataSense"
                      WHEN 'Critical' THEN 3
                      WHEN 'High'     THEN 3
                      WHEN 'Medium'   THEN 2
                      ELSE 1
                    END AS dsi,
         CASE WHEN s.enc_state = 'Full' AND s.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 3
              WHEN s.enc_state = 'Full' OR  s.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 2
              ELSE 1
         END AS srs,
         s.enc_state,
         s.acl_state
  FROM "DataProfile" d
  JOIN "SecurityProfile" s ON s.profile_key = d."profileTrace"
)
SELECT "profileTrace",
       CASE WHEN dsi > 100 AND srs < 2 THEN 'Review Required' ELSE 'No Action' END AS review_flag,
       dsi,
       srs,
       enc_state,
       acl_state
FROM x
ORDER BY "profileTrace";

UPDATE "AuditAndCompliance"
SET "AudtrailState" = 'Overdue'
WHERE "critFindNum"::numeric / ("FINDTALLY" + 1) > 0.5
  AND CURRENT_DATE - "REMED_DUE" > 0
  AND "AudtrailState" NOT IN ('Complete', 'Overdue');

WITH base AS (
  SELECT df."RecordRegistry" AS flow_id,
         (a."critFindNum"::numeric / (a."FINDTALLY" + 1))
           * (a."AccReqNum" + a."DEL_REQ_NUM" + a.rect_req_num + a."PORTREQNUM") AS arl,
         (rm.risk_management_profile->'financial_impact'->>'cost_usd')::numeric
           / ((rm.risk_management_profile->'financial_impact'->>'penalties_usd')::numeric + 1) AS ccr
  FROM "DataFlow" df
  JOIN "AuditAndCompliance" a ON a.record_registry = df."RecordRegistry"
  JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON rm.flow_link = df."RecordRegistry"
)
SELECT flow_id,
       ROUND(arl, 2) AS audit_remediation_load,
       ROUND(ccr, 2) AS compliance_cost_ratio
FROM base
WHERE arl > 10 AND ccr > 0.8
ORDER BY audit_remediation_load DESC;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT df."RecordRegistry",
         (rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric
           * (1.0 / NULLIF((rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct')::numeric, 0)) AS res,
         ((df.flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric
            / ((df.flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1))
           * (1 - (df.flow_overview->'performance'->>'retry_count')::numeric
                  / ((df.flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1)) AS dfrs
  FROM "DataFlow" df
  JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON rm.flow_link = df."RecordRegistry"
)
SELECT "RecordRegistry", res, dfrs
FROM m
WHERE res > 0.7 AND dfrs < 0.5
ORDER BY res DESC;

SELECT df."RecordRegistry",
       df.flow_overview->'classification'->>'flow_tag' AS flow_tag,
       df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' AS origin_country,
       df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' AS destination_country,
       c."gdprComp",
       c.loc_law_comp,
       v."Vendor_Trace"
FROM "DataFlow" df
JOIN "Compliance" c ON c."recordRegistry" = df."RecordRegistry"
JOIN "VendorManagement" v ON v."Vendor_Trace" = c."vendorTie"
WHERE (c."gdprComp" = 'Non-compliant' OR c.loc_law_comp = 'Non-compliant')
  AND df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' <> df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country'
ORDER BY df."RecordRegistry";

SELECT MAX(vol_gb::numeric * CASE "dataSense"
                               WHEN 'High' THEN 3
                               WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                               ELSE 1
                             END) AS max_dsi
FROM "DataProfile";

SELECT f."RecordRegistry",
       p.vol_gb * CASE WHEN p."dataSense" = 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END AS dsi,
       f.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' AS destination_country
FROM "DataFlow" f
JOIN "DataProfile" p ON p."Flow_Sign" = f."RecordRegistry"
WHERE p.vol_gb * CASE WHEN p."dataSense" = 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END > 100
ORDER BY dsi DESC;

SELECT "AUDIT_TRACE",
       (COALESCE("AccReqNum",0) + COALESCE("DEL_REQ_NUM",0) + COALESCE(rect_req_num,0) + COALESCE("PORTREQNUM",0)) * resp_time_day AS dsrp
FROM "AuditAndCompliance"
ORDER BY dsrp DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

WITH v AS (
  SELECT vm."Vendor_Trace",
         CASE vm."vendSecRate" WHEN 'A' THEN 4 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS security_score,
         ac."critFindNum"::numeric / (ac."FINDTALLY" + 1) AS afs
  FROM "VendorManagement" vm
  LEFT JOIN "AuditAndCompliance" ac ON ac."VendJoin" = vm."Vendor_Trace"
)
SELECT "Vendor_Trace", afs * (5 - security_score) AS vcb, security_score
FROM v
WHERE afs * (5 - security_score) > 1.5
ORDER BY vcb DESC;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT df."RecordRegistry",
         df."FLOWSTAMP",
         df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_actor'        AS origin_actor,
         df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' AS destination_country,
         df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'protocol'            AS protocol,
         (rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric
           / NULLIF((rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct')::numeric, 0) AS res,
         dp.vol_gb * CASE dp."dataSense" WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS dsi
  FROM "DataFlow" df
  LEFT JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON rm.flow_link = df."RecordRegistry"
  LEFT JOIN "DataProfile"   dp ON dp."Flow_Sign" = df."RecordRegistry"
)
SELECT "RecordRegistry", "FLOWSTAMP", origin_actor, destination_country, protocol, res, dsi
FROM m
WHERE res > 0.7 AND dsi > 100
ORDER BY res DESC, dsi DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' AS origin_country,
         dp.vol_gb * CASE dp."dataSense" WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS dsi,
         CASE WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' AND sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 3
              WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' OR sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 2
              ELSE 1 END AS srs,
         dp.ret_days
  FROM "DataProfile" dp
  JOIN "DataFlow" df ON df."RecordRegistry" = dp."Flow_Sign"
  JOIN "SecurityProfile" sp ON sp.profile_key = dp."profileTrace"
)
SELECT origin_country,
       COUNT(*)           AS profile_count,
       AVG(dsi)           AS avg_dsi,
       AVG(srs)           AS avg_srs,
       AVG(srs * dsi)     AS avg_ecr,
       AVG(ret_days)      AS avg_retention_days
FROM base
GROUP BY origin_country
HAVING AVG(dsi) > 100 AND AVG(srs * dsi) < 2
ORDER BY avg_ecr ASC, avg_dsi DESC
LIMIT 20;

DELETE FROM "DataFlow" df
USING "RiskManagement" rm, "Compliance" c
WHERE rm.flow_link = df."RecordRegistry"
  AND c.risk_tie = rm."RISKTRACE"
  AND (df.flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric < 50
  AND df.flow_overview->'classification'->>'sensitivity_level' = 'Low'
  AND (rm.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric < 20
  AND c."gdprComp" = 'Non-compliant';

WITH base AS (
  SELECT e."EquipType", e."EQUIP_CODE",
    ((t.type_indices->>'performance_score')::numeric + e."RELIAB_IDX"::numeric)/2
      * (1 - (t.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx')::numeric/100) AS eer,
    (t.type_indices->>'safety_idx')::numeric AS safety_idx
  FROM "Equipment" e
  JOIN "EquipmentType" t ON t."EquipType" = e."EquipType"
), scored AS (
  SELECT "EquipType", "EQUIP_CODE", eer,
         safety_idx/100 * eer * 0.8 AS ospi
  FROM base
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "EquipType" ORDER BY eer DESC)  AS efficiency_rank,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "EquipType" ORDER BY ospi DESC) AS safety_rank
  FROM scored
)
SELECT "EquipType", "EQUIP_CODE", eer, ospi,
       efficiency_rank, safety_rank,
       ABS(efficiency_rank - safety_rank) AS rank_gap
FROM ranked
ORDER BY "EquipType", eer DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE",
         e."EquipType",
         ce.cabin_env_snapshot->'hvac'->>'heater_state' AS heater_status,
         t."insulationStat"                           AS insulation_status,
         ls."emerLightStat"                           AS emergency_light_status,
         ((100 - ws."structLoadPct") / 100.0) *
           CASE WHEN ws."snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR ws."windSpeed_ms" > 20 THEN 0.5
                WHEN ws."snowLoad_kgm2" > 50  OR ws."windSpeed_ms" > 10 THEN 0.8
                ELSE 1.0 END                          AS ssf
  FROM "Equipment" e
  JOIN "CabinEnvironment" ce        ON ce."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
  JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls       ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
  JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om    ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
  JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" ws     ON ws.opmaint_link = om."OP_MAINT_ID"
  JOIN "Communication" c            ON c."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
  JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t  ON t.comm_link = c."COMM_ID"
)
SELECT "EQUIP_CODE",
       "EquipType",
       heater_status,
       insulation_status,
       emergency_light_status,
       ssf,
       CASE WHEN ssf > 0.7
             AND heater_status <> 'Off'
             AND insulation_status <> 'Good'
             AND emergency_light_status IN ('On', 'Testing')
            THEN 'Extreme Weather Ready'
            ELSE 'Not Ready' END AS ewr_status
FROM base
ORDER BY ewr_status, ssf DESC;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT l."locType",
         l."STATION_name",
         COUNT(DISTINCT c."equipRef") AS equipment_count,
         SUM(COALESCE(t."solarOutput_w", 0)::float8)    AS solar_w,
         SUM(COALESCE(t."windOutput_w", 0)::float8)     AS wind_w,
         SUM(COALESCE(t."fuelCellOutput_w", 0)::float8) AS fuelcell_w
  FROM "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t
  JOIN "Communication" c ON c."COMM_ID" = t.comm_link
  JOIN "Location" l      ON l."STATION_name" = c.loc_link
  WHERE t."solarOutput_w" IS NOT NULL OR t."windOutput_w" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY l."locType", l."STATION_name"
),
r AS (
  SELECT *,
         (solar_w + wind_w) / NULLIF(solar_w + wind_w + fuelcell_w, 0) * 100 AS rec_pct
  FROM s
)
SELECT "locType",
       "STATION_name",
       equipment_count,
       rec_pct,
       solar_w + wind_w AS renewable_output_w,
       CASE WHEN rec_pct > 70 THEN 'Energy-Sustainable'
            WHEN rec_pct > 50 THEN 'Moderately Sustainable'
            ELSE 'Low Sustainability' END AS sustainability_class
FROM r
ORDER BY rec_pct DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT "OP_MAINT_ID",
       "OPER_hours",
       "maintCycleHrs",
       "OPER_status",
       CASE WHEN "OPER_status" = 'Active'  THEN 10 * (1 - "OPER_hours" / NULLIF("maintCycleHrs", 0))
            WHEN "OPER_status" = 'Standby' THEN 5  * (1 - "OPER_hours" / NULLIF("maintCycleHrs", 0))
            ELSE 0 END AS ors
FROM "OperationMaintenance"
ORDER BY "OP_MAINT_ID";

WITH w AS (
  SELECT l."STATION_name", l."locType", ww."waterQualityIdx",
         (ww."waterLevelPct"/100.0) * (ww."waterQualityIdx"/100.0) * (1 - ww."wasteTankPct"/100.0) AS wrmi
  FROM "WaterAndWaste" ww
  JOIN "CabinEnvironment" c ON c."equipRef" = ww."equipRef"
  JOIN "Location" l ON l."STATION_name" = c.loc_link
), s AS (
  SELECT "STATION_name", "locType",
         AVG("waterQualityIdx") AS avg_water_quality_index,
         AVG(wrmi) AS avg_wrmi,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wrmi < 0.5) AS conservation_needed_count
  FROM w
  GROUP BY "STATION_name", "locType"
)
SELECT "STATION_name", "locType", avg_water_quality_index, avg_wrmi, conservation_needed_count,
  CASE WHEN avg_water_quality_index >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality'
       WHEN avg_water_quality_index >= 71 THEN 'Good'
       WHEN avg_water_quality_index >= 51 THEN 'Moderate'
       WHEN avg_water_quality_index >= 26 THEN 'Poor'
       ELSE 'Unsafe' END AS water_quality_classification,
  CASE WHEN avg_wrmi < 0.5 THEN 'Conservation Needed'
       WHEN avg_wrmi < 0.7 THEN 'Monitoring Advised'
       ELSE 'Sustainable Management' END AS water_management_status
FROM s
ORDER BY avg_wrmi DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE", e."EquipType", ls."lifeSupportStat",
    CASE WHEN om."OPER_status" = 'Active'  THEN 10 * (1 - om."OPER_hours" / NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs", 0))
         WHEN om."OPER_status" = 'Standby' THEN 5  * (1 - om."OPER_hours" / NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs", 0))
         ELSE 0 END AS ors,
    CASE t."insulationStat" WHEN 'Good' THEN 0.9 - t."heatLoss_kwh" / 10
                            WHEN 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - t."heatLoss_kwh" / 10
                            WHEN 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - t."heatLoss_kwh" / 10 END AS tie,
    ls."O2SupplyStat", ls."medEquipStat", ls."safetySysStat"
  FROM "Equipment" e
  JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
  JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
  JOIN "PowerBattery" pb ON pb.equip_ref = e."EQUIP_CODE"
  JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t ON t.batt_link = pb."PWR_BATT_ID"
  WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Safety'
), s AS (
  SELECT *, 0.7 * ors + 0.3 * tie AS lssr FROM base
)
SELECT "EQUIP_CODE", "EquipType", "lifeSupportStat", lssr,
  CASE WHEN lssr >= 0.8 THEN 'High Reliability'
       WHEN lssr >= 0.6 THEN 'Moderate Reliability'
       WHEN lssr <  0.6 THEN 'Low Reliability' END AS reliability_class,
  jsonb_build_object('oxygen_status', "O2SupplyStat",
                     'medical_status', "medEquipStat",
                     'safety_system_status', "safetySysStat") AS system_status
FROM s
ORDER BY lssr DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT "COMM_ID",
         antenna_stat,
         "radioSignal_dBm"::numeric AS radio,
         "netLatency_ms"::numeric  AS lat,
         (CASE antenna_stat WHEN 'Error' THEN 0 WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5 WHEN 'Normal' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END)
           * (1 - "netLatency_ms"::numeric / 1000) AS cri
  FROM "Communication"
  WHERE antenna_stat IS NOT NULL
    AND "netLatency_ms" IS NOT NULL
    AND "radioSignal_dBm" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT "COMM_ID",
       antenna_stat,
       ROUND(radio, 2) AS radio_signal_dbm,
       ROUND(lat, 2)   AS network_latency_ms,
       ROUND(cri, 2)   AS cri,
       ROUND(cri * (1 + 0.2 * radio / 100) * (1 - 0.01 * (1000 - lat)), 2) AS bscsi
FROM c
ORDER BY bscsi DESC, "COMM_ID";

WITH scores AS (
    SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE",
           ((et.type_indices->>'performance_score')::numeric + e."RELIAB_IDX"::numeric) / 2
             * (1 - (et.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx')::numeric / 100) AS eer,
           (et.type_indices->>'safety_idx')::numeric AS safety_idx
    FROM "Equipment" e
    JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON e."EquipType" = et."EquipType"
)
SELECT "EQUIP_CODE",
       eer,
       safety_idx / 100 * eer * 0.8 AS ospi
FROM scores
WHERE safety_idx / 100 * eer * 0.8 > 0.75
ORDER BY ospi DESC;

SELECT c."CHASSIS_ID",
       (1 - ((c.ground_vehicle_status->'brake_system'->>'pad_wear_pct')::numeric
             + (c.ground_vehicle_status->'tracks'->>'wear_pct')::numeric) / 200)
       * (substring(c.ground_vehicle_status->'vehicle_motion'->>'speed_kmh' from '[-0-9.]+')::numeric * 3.6 / 50)
       * ((e.engine_fluids_snapshot->'engine_core'->>'load_pct')::numeric / 100) AS vpc
FROM "ChassisAndVehicle" c
LEFT JOIN "EngineAndFluids" e ON e."ENGINE_ID" = c.engine_link
ORDER BY c."CHASSIS_ID";

WITH s AS (
  SELECT sc."measureAccPct" * CASE sc."calibrStat"
                                WHEN 'Valid'   THEN 1.0
                                WHEN 'Due'     THEN 0.7
                                WHEN 'Expired' THEN 0.3
                              END AS ser,
         CASE c.antenna_stat
           WHEN 'Normal'  THEN 10
           WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5
           ELSE 0
         END * (1 - c."netLatency_ms" / 1000.0) AS cri
  FROM "Scientific" sc
  JOIN "Communication" c ON c."equipRef" = sc."equipRef"
  JOIN "Location" l ON l."STATION_name" = c.loc_link
  WHERE l."locType" = 'Arctic'
)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(ser * (0.8 + 0.2 * cri / 10))::numeric, 2) AS max_smsp
FROM s;

SELECT ROUND(MAX(
         ((t.type_indices->>'safety_idx')::numeric / 100)
         * (((t.type_indices->>'performance_score')::numeric + e."RELIAB_IDX"::numeric) / 2
            * (1 - (t.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx')::numeric / 100))
         * 0.8
       ), 2) AS max_ospi
FROM "Equipment" e
JOIN "EquipmentType" t ON e."EquipType" = t."EquipType"
WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Vehicle';

WITH shelter_check AS (
    SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE",
           ((100 - w."structLoadPct") / 100.0) *
           CASE WHEN w."snowLoad_kgm2" > 100 OR w."windSpeed_ms" > 20 THEN 0.5
                WHEN w."snowLoad_kgm2" > 50  OR w."windSpeed_ms" > 10 THEN 0.8
                ELSE 1.0 END                                   AS ssf,
           ce.cabin_env_snapshot -> 'hvac' ->> 'heater_state'  AS heater_state,
           t."insulationStat"                                  AS insulation_status,
           ls."emerLightStat"                                  AS emergency_light_status
    FROM "Equipment" e
    LEFT JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om   ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
    LEFT JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" w     ON w.opmaint_link = om."OP_MAINT_ID"
    LEFT JOIN "CabinEnvironment" ce       ON ce."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
    LEFT JOIN "Communication" c           ON c."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
    LEFT JOIN "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t ON t.comm_link = c."COMM_ID"
    LEFT JOIN "LightingAndSafety" ls      ON ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
    WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Shelter'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "EQUIP_CODE") AS ready_shelter_count
FROM shelter_check
WHERE ssf > 0.7
  AND heater_state <> 'Off'
  AND insulation_status <> 'Good'
  AND emergency_light_status IN ('On', 'Testing');

WITH b AS (
  SELECT antenna_stat,
         (CASE antenna_stat WHEN 'Normal' THEN 10 WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END)
           * (1 - "netLatency_ms" / 1000.0) AS cri,
         "radioSignal_dBm" AS rs,
         "netLatency_ms" AS lat
  FROM "Communication"
  WHERE antenna_stat IS NOT NULL
    AND "netLatency_ms" IS NOT NULL
    AND "radioSignal_dBm" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT antenna_stat,
       AVG(cri * (1 + 0.2 * rs / 100.0) * (1 - 0.01 * (1000 - lat))) AS avg_bscsi,
       COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM b
GROUP BY antenna_stat
ORDER BY avg_bscsi DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE", e."EquipType",
    ((et.type_indices->>'performance_score')::numeric + e."RELIAB_IDX"::numeric)/2
      * (1 - (et.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx')::numeric/100) AS eer,
    CASE WHEN om."OPER_status"='Active'  THEN 10*(1 - om."OPER_hours"::numeric/NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs",0)::numeric)
         WHEN om."OPER_status"='Standby' THEN 5*(1 - om."OPER_hours"::numeric/NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs",0)::numeric)
         ELSE 0 END AS ors,
    om."OPER_hours"::numeric AS oh
  FROM "Equipment" e
  JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON et."EquipType" = e."EquipType"
  JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
), s AS (
  SELECT "EQUIP_CODE", "EquipType", 0.5*eer + 0.5*ors*(1 - oh/20000) AS loss
  FROM base
), r AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "EquipType" ORDER BY loss DESC) AS rd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "EquipType" ORDER BY loss ASC)  AS ra
  FROM s
  WHERE loss IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT "EQUIP_CODE", "EquipType", loss AS stability_score
FROM r
WHERE rd <= 5 OR ra <= 5
ORDER BY "EquipType", loss DESC;

WITH b AS (
  SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE",
         ((et.type_indices->>'performance_score')::numeric + e."RELIAB_IDX"::numeric) / 2
           * (1 - (et.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx')::numeric / 100) AS eer,
         10 * (1 - om."OPER_hours"::numeric / NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs"::numeric, 0)) AS ors,
         CASE c.antenna_stat WHEN 'Normal' THEN 10 WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END
           * (1 - c."netLatency_ms"::numeric / 1000) AS cri
  FROM "OperationMaintenance" om
  JOIN "Equipment" e ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = om."equipRef"
  JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON et."EquipType" = e."EquipType"
  LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON c."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
  WHERE om."OPER_status" = 'Active'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(0.4 * eer + 0.4 * ors + 0.2 * cri), 2) AS avg_cori
FROM b;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE",
         CASE WHEN w."extTempC" < -40 THEN 'Extreme Cold'
              WHEN w."extTempC" < -20 THEN 'Standard Cold'
              ELSE 'Mild Cold' END AS temperature_zone,
         (pb.battery_telemetry->'battery_pack'->>'health_pct')::numeric AS health_pct
  FROM "WeatherAndStructure" w
  JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."OP_MAINT_ID" = w.opmaint_link
  JOIN "Equipment" e ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = om."equipRef"
  JOIN "PowerBattery" pb ON pb.equip_ref = e."EQUIP_CODE"
)
SELECT temperature_zone,
       COUNT(DISTINCT "EQUIP_CODE") AS equipment_count,
       AVG(health_pct) AS avg_battery_health
FROM t
GROUP BY temperature_zone
ORDER BY temperature_zone;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT c."equipRef" AS equip_code,
    (1 - ((c.ground_vehicle_status->'brake_system'->>'pad_wear_pct')::numeric
          + (c.ground_vehicle_status->'tracks'->>'wear_pct')::numeric) / 200)
    * (substring(c.ground_vehicle_status->'vehicle_motion'->>'speed_kmh' from '[-]?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?')::numeric / 50)
    * ((ef.engine_fluids_snapshot->'engine_core'->>'load_pct')::numeric / 100) AS vpc,
    (pb.battery_telemetry->'power_state'->>'conversion_eff_pct')::numeric *
    CASE WHEN pb.battery_telemetry->'power_state'->>'primary_source' IN ('Solar','Wind','Hybrid') THEN 1.5
         WHEN pb.battery_telemetry->'power_state'->>'primary_source' = 'Battery' THEN 1.0
         WHEN pb.battery_telemetry->'power_state'->>'primary_source' = 'Diesel' THEN 0.7
         ELSE 0 END AS esi
  FROM "ChassisAndVehicle" c
  JOIN "Equipment" e ON e."EQUIP_CODE" = c."equipRef"
  JOIN "EngineAndFluids" ef ON ef."ENGINE_ID" = c.engine_link
  JOIN "PowerBattery" pb ON pb.equip_ref = c."equipRef"
  WHERE e."EquipType" = 'Vehicle'
)
SELECT equip_code, vpc, esi, vpc * (0.6 + 0.4 * esi / 100) AS ptec
FROM base
WHERE vpc IS NOT NULL AND esi IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ptec DESC
LIMIT 100;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_esi(efficiency NUMERIC, power_source TEXT)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN efficiency * CASE
    WHEN power_source IN ('Solar', 'Wind', 'Hybrid') THEN 1.5
    WHEN power_source = 'Battery' THEN 1.0
    WHEN power_source = 'Diesel' THEN 0.7
    ELSE 0
  END;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

SELECT l."STATION_name",
       w."waterQualityIdx",
       w."waterLevelPct",
       CASE WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality'
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 71 THEN 'Good'
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 51 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN w."waterQualityIdx" >= 26 THEN 'Poor'
            ELSE 'Unsafe'
       END AS water_quality_category
FROM "Location" l
LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON c.loc_link = l."STATION_name"
LEFT JOIN "WaterAndWaste" w ON w."equipRef" = c."equipRef"
ORDER BY l."STATION_name";

WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.loc_link AS station_name,
         c."equipRef",
         (CASE c.antenna_stat
            WHEN 'Error'   THEN 0
            WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5
            WHEN 'Normal'  THEN 10
            ELSE 0
          END) * (1 - c."netLatency_ms" / 1000.0) AS cri,
         c."radioSignal_dBm" AS radio_signal,
         c."netLatency_ms"   AS latency
  FROM "Communication" c
  WHERE c.antenna_stat IS NOT NULL
    AND c."netLatency_ms" IS NOT NULL
    AND c."radioSignal_dBm" IS NOT NULL
), metrics AS (
  SELECT station_name,
         "equipRef",
         cri,
         cri * (1 + 0.2 * radio_signal / 100.0) * (1 - 0.01 * (1000 - latency)) AS bscsi
  FROM base
), station_stats AS (
  SELECT station_name,
         AVG(cri)   AS avg_cri,
         AVG(bscsi) AS avg_bscsi,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "equipRef", ', ' ORDER BY "equipRef") AS equipment_list
  FROM metrics
  GROUP BY station_name
)
SELECT station_name,
       ROUND(avg_cri::numeric, 2)   AS avg_cri,
       ROUND(avg_bscsi::numeric, 2) AS avg_bscsi,
       equipment_list
FROM station_stats
WHERE NOT (avg_cri > 0.8 AND avg_bscsi > 0.85)
  AND NOT (avg_cri > 0.6 AND avg_bscsi > 0.7)
ORDER BY avg_cri ASC, avg_bscsi ASC;

CREATE INDEX idx_scientific_reliability ON "Scientific" ((
    "measureAccPct" * CASE
        WHEN "calibrStat" = 'Valid'   THEN 1.0
        WHEN "calibrStat" = 'Due'     THEN 0.7
        WHEN "calibrStat" = 'Expired' THEN 0.3
    END
));

CREATE VIEW water_management_view AS
SELECT w."equipRef",
       (w."waterLevelPct"/100.0) * (w."waterQualityIdx"/100.0) * (1 - w."wasteTankPct"/100.0) AS wrmi,
       CASE WHEN (w."waterLevelPct"/100.0) * (w."waterQualityIdx"/100.0) * (1 - w."wasteTankPct"/100.0) < 0.5 THEN 'Conservation Needed'
            WHEN (w."waterLevelPct"/100.0) * (w."waterQualityIdx"/100.0) * (1 - w."wasteTankPct"/100.0) < 0.7 THEN 'Monitoring Advised'
            ELSE 'Sustainable Management' END AS water_management_status
FROM "WaterAndWaste" w
WHERE w."waterLevelPct" IS NOT NULL;

UPDATE "Equipment" e
SET "RELIAB_IDX" = e."RELIAB_IDX" * 1.15
WHERE e."EQUIP_CODE" IN (
  SELECT c."equipRef"
  FROM "CabinEnvironment" c
  WHERE (c.cabin_env_snapshot->'air_metrics'->>'temperature_c')::real BETWEEN 18 AND 24
    AND (c.cabin_env_snapshot->'air_metrics'->>'o2_pct')::real > 19.5
    AND (c.cabin_env_snapshot->'air_metrics'->>'co2_ppm')::real < 1000
    AND c.cabin_env_snapshot->'hvac'->>'vent_state' <> 'Off'
    AND c.cabin_env_snapshot->'hvac'->>'heater_state' <> 'Off'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "EquipmentReviewLog" (
  log_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  equip_code TEXT,
  review_reason TEXT,
  logged_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

INSERT INTO "EquipmentReviewLog" (equip_code, review_reason)
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE", e."EquipType", om."MAINT_COST_usd" AS maint_cost,
         (((et.type_indices->>'performance_score')::numeric + e."RELIAB_IDX"::numeric) / 2)
           * (1 - (et.type_indices->>'environmental_impact_idx')::numeric / 100) AS eer
  FROM "Equipment" e
  JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON et."EquipType" = e."EquipType"
  JOIN "OperationMaintenance" om ON om."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
), avgc AS (
  SELECT "EquipType", AVG(maint_cost) AS avg_cost
  FROM eq
  GROUP BY "EquipType"
)
SELECT eq."EQUIP_CODE", 'Low EER (< 40) and maintenance cost above equipment type average'
FROM eq
JOIN avgc USING ("EquipType")
WHERE eq.eer < 40
  AND eq.maint_cost > avgc.avg_cost;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_lssr(p_equip_code TEXT)
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    v_ors  NUMERIC;
    v_tie  NUMERIC;
    v_lssr NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE om."OPER_status"
             WHEN 'Active'  THEN 10 * (1 - om."OPER_hours"::numeric / NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs", 0)::numeric)
             WHEN 'Standby' THEN 5  * (1 - om."OPER_hours"::numeric / NULLIF(om."maintCycleHrs", 0)::numeric)
             ELSE 0
           END
      INTO v_ors
      FROM "OperationMaintenance" om
     WHERE om."equipRef" = p_equip_code
     LIMIT 1;

    SELECT CASE t."insulationStat"
             WHEN 'Good' THEN 0.9 - t."heatLoss_kwh"::numeric / 10
             WHEN 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - t."heatLoss_kwh"::numeric / 10
             WHEN 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - t."heatLoss_kwh"::numeric / 10
           END
      INTO v_tie
      FROM "ThermalSolarWindAndGrid" t
      LEFT JOIN "Communication" c ON c."COMM_ID" = t.comm_link
      LEFT JOIN "PowerBattery"  p ON p."PWR_BATT_ID" = t.batt_link
     WHERE COALESCE(c."equipRef", p.equip_ref) = p_equip_code
     LIMIT 1;

    v_lssr := 0.7 * v_ors + 0.3 * v_tie;
    RETURN COALESCE(v_lssr, 0);
EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RETURN 0;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prevent_delete_active_critical()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF OLD."EquipType" = 'Safety'
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "EquipmentType" t
                   WHERE t."EquipType" = OLD."EquipType"
                     AND (t.type_indices->>'safety_idx')::real > 0.75)
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "LightingAndSafety" l
                   WHERE l."equipRef" = OLD."EQUIP_CODE"
                     AND (l."lifeSupportStat" IS NOT NULL OR l."O2SupplyStat" IS NOT NULL))
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "OperationMaintenance" o
                   WHERE o."equipRef" = OLD."EQUIP_CODE"
                     AND o."OPER_status" = 'Active')
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot delete critical equipment % while it is Active', OLD."EQUIP_CODE";
    END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trigger_prevent_delete_active_critical
BEFORE DELETE ON "Equipment"
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_delete_active_critical();

SELECT AVG(FLOOR((TO_DATE(r.event_schedule->>'date_set', 'YYYY/MM/DD')
                  - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25)) AS avg_sprint_winner_age
FROM sprint_results s
JOIN races r   ON r.rak_id = s.matchref
JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = s.unitdrive
WHERE (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1
  AND d.driver_identity->>'birth_date' IS NOT NULL;

SELECT location_metadata->>'name' AS circuit_name,
       (location_metadata->'coordinates'->>'elevation_m')::numeric AS elevation_m
FROM circuits
WHERE (location_metadata->'coordinates'->>'elevation_m')::numeric > 800
ORDER BY elevation_m DESC;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT c.cstr_key,
         c.namelabel,
         COUNT(*) AS total_races_started,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.st_mark IS NULL) AS total_races_finished
  FROM constructor_results cr
  JOIN constructors c ON c.cstr_key = cr.unitnode
  GROUP BY c.cstr_key, c.namelabel
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
)
SELECT namelabel,
       total_races_started,
       total_races_finished,
       total_races_finished::numeric * 100 / total_races_started AS reliability_rate,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_races_finished::numeric / total_races_started DESC) AS reliability_rank
FROM s
ORDER BY reliability_rate DESC, total_races_started DESC;

WITH w AS (
  SELECT matchref, (sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::bigint AS ms
  FROM sprint_results
  WHERE (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1
),
s AS (
  SELECT matchref, (sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::bigint AS ms
  FROM sprint_results
  WHERE (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dominant_sprint_wins
FROM w
JOIN s USING (matchref)
WHERE (s.ms - w.ms) / 1000.0 > 5;

WITH r AS (
  SELECT ra.yr, ra.rnum, cr.matchref AS rak_id, c.namelabel,
         SUM(COALESCE(cr.scoreval,0)) AS pts,
         COUNT(*) AS starts,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.st_mark IS NULL) AS finishes
  FROM constructor_results cr
  JOIN constructors c ON c.cstr_key = cr.unitnode
  JOIN races ra ON ra.rak_id = cr.matchref
  WHERE c.namelabel = 'McLaren'
  GROUP BY ra.yr, ra.rnum, cr.matchref, c.namelabel
)
SELECT yr, rak_id, namelabel,
  SUM(pts) OVER w * (SUM(finishes) OVER w::numeric / SUM(starts) OVER w) AS cumulative_cps
FROM r
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY rnum, rak_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
ORDER BY yr, rnum, rak_id;

WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT wheel_unit, rc_index,
         stddev_pop(msec_val / 1000.0) AS ltc
  FROM lap_times
  GROUP BY wheel_unit, rc_index
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
         'surname',    d.driver_identity->'name'->>'surname',
         'first_name', d.driver_identity->'name'->>'first_name'
       ) AS driver_name,
       AVG(p.ltc) AS avg_consistency_score,
       COUNT(*)   AS races_analyzed
FROM per_race p
JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = p.wheel_unit
GROUP BY d.drv_main, d.driver_identity
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY avg_consistency_score ASC;

WITH ham AS (
  SELECT drv_main, (driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date AS birth_date
  FROM drivers
  WHERE driver_identity->>'reference' = 'hamilton'
), hs AS (
  SELECT ds.rlink AS race_id,
         ds.acc_pt,
         to_date(r.event_schedule->>'date_set', 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS race_date,
         h.birth_date,
         COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY to_date(r.event_schedule->>'date_set', 'YYYY/MM/DD'), ds.rlink) AS races_participated
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN ham h ON h.drv_main = ds.drive_link
  JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = ds.rlink
)
SELECT race_id,
       (acc_pt / races_participated) / FLOOR((race_date - birth_date) / 365.25) AS driver_performance_value
FROM hs
WHERE acc_pt IS NOT NULL AND acc_pt <> 'NaN'
ORDER BY race_date;

WITH x AS (
    SELECT r.yr,
           r.event_schedule->>'event_name' AS event_name,
           (d.driver_identity->'name'->>'first_name') || ' ' || (d.driver_identity->'name'->>'surname') AS driver_name,
           ds.px AS podium_position,
           FLOOR((TO_DATE(r.event_schedule->>'date_set', 'YYYY/MM/DD')
                  - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25)::int AS age_at_race,
           TO_DATE(r.event_schedule->>'date_set', 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS race_date
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r   ON r.rak_id = ds.rlink
    JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = ds.drive_link
    WHERE ds.px BETWEEN 1 AND 3
      AND d.driver_identity->>'birth_date' IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT yr, event_name, driver_name, podium_position, age_at_race
FROM x
WHERE age_at_race >= 35
ORDER BY age_at_race DESC, race_date DESC;

SELECT r.event_schedule->>'event_name' AS event_name,
       s.unitdrive AS driver_id,
       (9 - (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int)
         + COALESCE((s.sprint_performance->>'points')::real, 0) AS sprint_performance_index
FROM sprint_results s
JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = s.matchref
WHERE s.sprint_performance->>'final_position' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sprint_performance_index DESC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(
         (9 - p) +
         CASE p WHEN 1 THEN 8 WHEN 2 THEN 7 WHEN 3 THEN 6 WHEN 4 THEN 5
                WHEN 5 THEN 4 WHEN 6 THEN 3 WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 8 THEN 1 END
       ), 2) AS avg_sprint_performance_index
FROM (
  SELECT (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int AS p
  FROM sprint_results
  WHERE sprint_performance->>'final_position' IS NOT NULL
) s
WHERE p BETWEEN 1 AND 8;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT rbind, pilotrec, px_pos,
    (SELECT min(split_part(v,':',1)::numeric*60 + split_part(v,':',2)::numeric)
     FROM unnest(ARRAY[q1_r,q2_r,q3_r]) v WHERE v ~ '^\d+:\d{2}\.\d+$') AS best
  FROM qualifying
), p AS (
  SELECT rbind, best AS pole FROM t WHERE px_pos = 1 AND best IS NOT NULL
), s AS (
  SELECT t.rbind,
         100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN t.best - p.pole < 0.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pct
  FROM t JOIN p USING (rbind)
  WHERE t.best IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.rbind
)
SELECT round(avg(pct), 2) AS avg_qualifying_specialist_pct
FROM s;

SELECT ROUND(MAX(rel), 2) AS max_reliability_rate
FROM (
    SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st_mark IS NULL) / COUNT(*) AS rel
    FROM constructor_results
    GROUP BY unitnode
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT matchref) >= 5
) t;

SELECT ROUND(MIN(ltc), 2) AS top_lap_time_consistency
FROM (
    SELECT wheel_unit,
           STDDEV_POP(msec_val / 1000.0) AS ltc
    FROM lap_times
    WHERE msec_val IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY wheel_unit
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
) s;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT 'fp1' AS session_name, (event_schedule#>>'{sessions,fp1,date}' IS NULL)::int + (event_schedule#>>'{sessions,fp1,time}' IS NULL)::int AS c FROM races
  UNION ALL SELECT 'fp2', (event_schedule#>>'{sessions,fp2,date}' IS NULL)::int + (event_schedule#>>'{sessions,fp2,time}' IS NULL)::int FROM races
  UNION ALL SELECT 'fp3', (event_schedule#>>'{sessions,fp3,date}' IS NULL)::int + (event_schedule#>>'{sessions,fp3,time}' IS NULL)::int FROM races
  UNION ALL SELECT 'qualifying', (event_schedule#>>'{sessions,qualifying,date}' IS NULL)::int + (event_schedule#>>'{sessions,qualifying,time}' IS NULL)::int FROM races
  UNION ALL SELECT 'sprint', (event_schedule#>>'{sessions,sprint,date}' IS NULL)::int + (event_schedule#>>'{sessions,sprint,time}' IS NULL)::int FROM races
  UNION ALL SELECT 'race', (event_schedule->>'date_set' IS NULL)::int + (event_schedule->>'start_time' IS NULL)::int FROM races
)
SELECT session_name, SUM(c) AS indeterminate_count
FROM s
GROUP BY session_name
ORDER BY indeterminate_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH race_stops AS (
    SELECT matchidx,
           COUNT(*)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) AS avg_stops_per_car
    FROM pit_stops
    GROUP BY matchidx
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS single_stop_race_count
FROM race_stops
WHERE avg_stops_per_car < 1.5;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT rbind, pilotrec, px_pos,
         (SELECT MIN(split_part(x, ':', 1)::numeric * 60 + split_part(x, ':', 2)::numeric)
            FROM unnest(ARRAY[q1_r, q2_r, q3_r]) AS x
           WHERE x ~ '^\d+:\d{2}\.\d{3}$') AS best_s
  FROM qualifying
),
pole AS (
  SELECT rbind, best_s AS pole_s
  FROM t
  WHERE px_pos = 1
),
d AS (
  SELECT t.pilotrec, t.best_s - p.pole_s AS deficit
  FROM t
  JOIN pole p USING (rbind)
  WHERE t.best_s IS NOT NULL AND p.pole_s IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT pilotrec AS driver_id,
       ROUND(AVG(deficit), 3) AS avg_deficit,
       CASE WHEN AVG(deficit) < 0.15 THEN 'Pole Threat'
            WHEN AVG(deficit) < 0.4  THEN 'Mid Gap'
            ELSE 'Backmarker' END AS qualifying_cluster
FROM d
GROUP BY pilotrec
ORDER BY avg_deficit;

       location_metadata->>'name' AS name,

ALTER TABLE races ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS victory_type text;

UPDATE races r
SET victory_type = 'Dominant Victory'
FROM (
  SELECT w.matchref
  FROM sprint_results w
  JOIN sprint_results s ON s.matchref = w.matchref
  WHERE (w.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1
    AND (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 2
    AND ((s.sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::bigint
         - (w.sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::bigint) / 1000.0 > 5
) d
WHERE r.rak_id = d.matchref;

       r.yr,
       ds.px
FROM driver_standings ds
JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = ds.drive_link
JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = ds.rlink

UPDATE qualifying SET is_pole_position = TRUE WHERE px_pos = 1;

SELECT visacls,
       AVG(to_date(decisionday, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - to_date(recvday, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) AS avg_processing_days
FROM cases
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(statustag)) = 'CERTIFIED'
  AND decisionday IS NOT NULL
  AND recvday IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY visacls
ORDER BY avg_processing_days DESC;

WITH emp AS (
  SELECT homefirm, homezip,
         COUNT(*) AS total_apps,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') AS certified_apps
  FROM cases
  GROUP BY homefirm, homezip
), cls AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN total_apps < 5 THEN 'Small-scale'
              WHEN total_apps <= 25 THEN 'Medium-scale'
              ELSE 'Large-scale' END AS employer_size,
         certified_apps * 100.0 / total_apps AS asr
  FROM emp
)
SELECT employer_size,
       COUNT(*) AS employer_count,
       ROUND(AVG(asr), 2) AS avg_success_rate
FROM cls
GROUP BY employer_size
ORDER BY avg_success_rate DESC, employer_count DESC;

SELECT soctitle,
       COUNT(*) AS certified_h1b_cases
FROM cases
WHERE UPPER(statustag) = 'CERTIFIED'
  AND visacls::text = 'H-1B'
GROUP BY soctitle
ORDER BY certified_h1b_cases DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH w AS (
  SELECT
    regexp_replace(wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric AS offered_from,
    NULLIF(wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'to', '')::numeric AS offered_to,
    regexp_replace(wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric AS prevailing
  FROM prevailing_wage
  WHERE wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' = 'IV'
    AND wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' = 'Year'
    AND wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' = 'Year'
)
SELECT AVG(
         ((CASE WHEN offered_to IS NOT NULL AND offered_to > 0
                THEN (offered_from + offered_to) / 2
                ELSE offered_from END) - prevailing) / prevailing * 100
       ) AS avg_wdr
FROM w;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT ca.counselmail,
         COUNT(*) AS total,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') AS cert,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.visacls::text = 'E-3 Australian') AS e3
  FROM case_attorney ca
  JOIN cases c ON c.filekey = ca.docketkey
  GROUP BY ca.counselmail
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS attorney_count
FROM s
WHERE cert * 100.0 / total > 95
  AND e3 * 100.0 / total > 50;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT c.filekey,
           regexp_replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric AS offered_wage,
           regexp_replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric AS prevailing_wage
    FROM cases c
    JOIN employer e
      ON e.corphandle = c.homefirm AND e.zipref = c.homezip
    JOIN case_worksite w
      ON w.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw
      ON pw.trackno = w.wagetrack
    WHERE (e.employer_contact_info->>'naics_code') = '541511'
      AND pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' = 'Year'
      AND pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' = 'Year'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS premium_wage_position_count
FROM base
WHERE prevailing_wage > 0
  AND (offered_wage - prevailing_wage) / prevailing_wage * 100 > 20;

SELECT CASE WHEN h1bdep::text = 'Yes' OR willfulv::text = 'Yes' THEN 'Complex' ELSE 'Standard' END AS complexity_tier,
       COUNT(*) AS application_count,
       ROUND(AVG(TO_DATE(decisionday,'YYYY-MM-DD') - TO_DATE(recvday,'YYYY/MM/DD'))::numeric, 2) AS avg_processing_days
FROM cases
WHERE recvday IS NOT NULL AND decisionday IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_processing_days DESC;

WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.headct,
         regexp_replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from','[^0-9.]','','g')::numeric AS offered,
         regexp_replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value','[^0-9.]','','g')::numeric AS prevailing
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE c.soctitle = 'Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers'
    AND pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' = 'Year'
    AND pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' = 'Year'
), t AS (
  SELECT headct, (offered - prevailing) / NULLIF(prevailing,0) * 100 AS wdr FROM w
)
SELECT CASE WHEN wdr < 0 THEN 'Below-Market'
            WHEN wdr <= 10 THEN 'Market-Competitive'
            ELSE 'Premium' END AS wage_competitiveness_tier,
       SUM(headct) AS total_positions
FROM t
WHERE wdr IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_positions DESC;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM to_date(beginday,'DD/MM/YYYY')) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM to_date(recvday,'YYYY/MM/DD')))*12
       + (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM to_date(beginday,'DD/MM/YYYY')) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM to_date(recvday,'YYYY/MM/DD'))) AS months_before
  FROM cases
  WHERE recvday IS NOT NULL AND beginday IS NOT NULL
), w AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN months_before < 0 THEN 'After Start Date'
           WHEN months_before = 0 THEN 'Same Month'
           WHEN months_before BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1-3 Months Before'
           WHEN months_before BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Optimal Window (4-6 Months)'
           ELSE 'Early Filing'
         END AS filing_window
  FROM m
)
SELECT filing_window,
       COUNT(*) AS application_count,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage
FROM w
GROUP BY filing_window
ORDER BY application_count DESC;

WITH w AS (
  SELECT c.soctitle,
         replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS ow,
         replace(replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS pv
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from' IS NOT NULL
    AND pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value' IS NOT NULL
    AND pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' = pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
)
SELECT soctitle,
       COUNT(*) AS application_count,
       ROUND(AVG((ow - pv) / pv * 100), 2) AS avg_wdr,
       'Skill Shortage Occupation' AS occupation_status
FROM w
WHERE pv > 0
GROUP BY soctitle
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
   AND AVG((ow - pv) / pv * 100) > 10
ORDER BY avg_wdr DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH ind AS (
  SELECT e.employer_contact_info->>'naics_code' AS naics_code,
         COUNT(*) AS total_applications
  FROM cases c
  JOIN employer e ON c.homefirm = e.corphandle AND c.homezip = e.zipref
  GROUP BY 1
), t AS (
  SELECT naics_code,
         total_applications,
         total_applications * 100.0 / SUM(total_applications) OVER () AS pct
  FROM ind
)
SELECT naics_code,
       total_applications,
       ROUND(pct, 2) AS percentage_of_applications
FROM t
WHERE pct > 15
ORDER BY pct DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT ca.counselmail, c.visacls, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM case_attorney ca
  JOIN cases c ON c.filekey = ca.docketkey
  WHERE c.visacls IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ca.counselmail, c.visacls
),
a AS (
  SELECT counselmail, SUM(n) AS total_cases, COUNT(*) AS visa_types, MAX(n) AS main_cases
  FROM t
  GROUP BY counselmail
  HAVING SUM(n) >= 5
),
tv AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visacls) AS total_types FROM cases WHERE visacls IS NOT NULL
),
s AS (
  SELECT a.counselmail,
         1 - a.visa_types::numeric / tv.total_types AS asi,
         100.0 * a.main_cases / a.total_cases AS main_pct,
         a.visa_types
  FROM a CROSS JOIN tv
),
c AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN main_pct > 80 THEN 'Specialist'
              WHEN visa_types BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Hybrid Practitioner'
              ELSE 'Generalist' END AS specialization_category
  FROM s
)
SELECT specialization_category,
       COUNT(*) AS attorney_count,
       ROUND(AVG(asi), 2) AS avg_specialization_index,
       ROUND(AVG(main_pct), 2) AS avg_main_visa_pct
FROM c
GROUP BY specialization_category
ORDER BY attorney_count DESC;

SELECT a.attorney_profile->'address'->>'state' AS state,
       COUNT(*) AS total_cases,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') AS successful_cases,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.statustag) = 'CERTIFIED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate
FROM case_attorney ca
JOIN attorney a ON a.lawmail = ca.counselmail
JOIN cases c ON c.filekey = ca.docketkey
WHERE a.attorney_profile->'address'->>'state' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY success_rate DESC, total_cases DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
       COUNT(*) AS application_count,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage
FROM cases c
JOIN case_worksite w ON w.dockkey = c.filekey
JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = w.wagetrack
WHERE c.visacls = 'H-1B'
  AND pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY application_count DESC;

WITH soc_counts AS (
    SELECT soctitle,
           COUNT(*) AS application_count
    FROM cases
    WHERE soccd IS NOT NULL
      AND soccd <> ''
    GROUP BY soctitle
)
SELECT soctitle,
       application_count,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employer_analytics (
  employer_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  employer_scale_indicator NUMERIC,
  employer_size_category TEXT
);

INSERT INTO employer_analytics (employer_name, employer_scale_indicator, employer_size_category)
WITH emp AS (
  SELECT homefirm, COUNT(*) AS app_cnt
  FROM cases
  GROUP BY homefirm
)
SELECT homefirm,
       app_cnt::numeric / AVG(app_cnt) OVER () AS employer_scale_indicator,
       CASE WHEN app_cnt < 5 THEN 'Small-scale user'
            WHEN app_cnt <= 25 THEN 'Medium-scale user'
            ELSE 'Large-scale user' END AS employer_size_category

WITH w AS (
  SELECT e.employer_contact_info->>'naics_code' AS naics_code,
         ((replace(substring(p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from' from 2), ',', '')::numeric
           - replace(substring(p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value' from 5), ',', '')::numeric)
          / NULLIF(replace(substring(p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value' from 5), ',', '')::numeric, 0)) * 100 AS wdr
  FROM cases c
  JOIN employer e ON e.corphandle = c.homefirm AND e.zipref = c.homezip
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage p ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE e.employer_contact_info->>'naics_code' IS NOT NULL
    AND p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' = p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
)
SELECT naics_code,
       COUNT(*) AS application_count,
       ROUND(AVG(wdr), 2) AS avg_wage_differential
FROM w
GROUP BY naics_code
ORDER BY avg_wage_differential DESC
LIMIT 5;

ALTER TABLE attorney ADD COLUMN specialization_category TEXT;

WITH t AS (
    SELECT ca.counselmail, c.visacls, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM case_attorney ca
    JOIN cases c ON c.filekey = ca.docketkey

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_continuous_filing_employers(p_year integer DEFAULT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::integer)
RETURNS TABLE (employer_name text, total_applications bigint, filing_months bigint, filer_status text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT c.homefirm,
         COUNT(*)::bigint,
         COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.recvday, 'YYYY/MM/DD')))::bigint,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(c.recvday, 'YYYY/MM/DD'))) >= 9
              THEN 'Continuous Filer' ELSE 'Non-Continuous Filer' END
  FROM cases c
  WHERE c.recvday IS NOT NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(c.recvday, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) = p_year
  GROUP BY c.homefirm
  ORDER BY 3 DESC, 2 DESC, 1;
END;
$$;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
         MAX((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min, 0)) AS peak_fmi
  FROM interactions
  GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
)
SELECT f.nick_label, f.user_registry, s.peak_fmi,

FROM s
JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = s.fan_id

WITH m AS (
    SELECT f.nick_label,
           (s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric AS foll,
           (s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric AS fing,
           (r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach')::numeric AS reach
    FROM socialcommunity s
    JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = s.social_engage_pivot
    JOIN membershipandspending ms ON ms.member_reg = e.engage_member_pivot
    JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = ms.member_fan_pivot
    JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retain_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
), c AS (
    SELECT nick_label,
           sqrt(foll * reach) AS community_influence_index,

    FROM m
    WHERE fing > 0
)
SELECT nick_label,
       community_influence_index,
       follower_to_following_ratio,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY community_influence_index DESC) AS influence_rank
FROM c
WHERE follower_to_following_ratio > 2.0
  AND community_influence_index > 10000
ORDER BY influence_rank
LIMIT 20;

WITH fan_flags AS (
  SELECT f.user_registry,
         COALESCE(bool_or(
           ((p.usage_metrics->>'Int_Consist')::numeric + (p.usage_metrics->>'Plat_Stable')::numeric) / 2 < 0.4
           OR r.churn_flag = 'High'), false) AS is_at_risk,
         COALESCE(bool_or(
           COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Supp_Tix')::numeric,0) + COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Bug_Subs')::numeric,0)
           + COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Tech_Issue_Rpt')::numeric,0) > 10), false) AS is_high_maintenance
  FROM fans f
  LEFT JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
  LEFT JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON p.preferences_member_pivot = m.member_reg
  LEFT JOIN supportandfeedback s ON s.support_pref_pivot = p.pref_reg
  LEFT JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_member_pivot = m.member_reg
  LEFT JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retain_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
  GROUP BY f.user_registry
)
SELECT CASE WHEN is_at_risk THEN 'At-Risk' ELSE 'Not At-Risk' END AS risk_status,
       CASE WHEN is_high_maintenance THEN 'High-Maintenance' ELSE 'Low-Maintenance' END AS support_status,
       COUNT(*) AS fan_count
FROM fan_flags
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

WITH fan_fmi AS (
    SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fan,
           SUM((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric) AS total_gift_usd,
           SUM((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric) / NULLIF(SUM(sess_dur_min), 0) AS fmi
    FROM interactions
    GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
),
fan_eps AS (
    SELECT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan,
           SUM(COALESCE((e.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::numeric, 0) * 1
             + COALESCE((e.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::numeric, 0) * 1.5
             + COALESCE((e.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::numeric, 0) * 2) AS eps
    FROM eventsandclub e
    JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = e.events_member_pivot
    GROUP BY m.member_fan_pivot
)
SELECT f.nick_label,
       ff.total_gift_usd,
       fe.eps,
       f.tier_step
FROM fan_fmi ff
JOIN fan_eps fe ON fe.fan = ff.fan
JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = ff.fan
WHERE ff.fmi > 20
  AND fe.eps > 25
ORDER BY ff.total_gift_usd DESC;

WITH collectors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan
  FROM commerceandcollection c
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON c.commerce_member_pivot = m.member_reg
  WHERE (c.dig_own + c.phys_own) > 50 AND c.coll_comp_rate > 75
)
SELECT v.genre_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT col.fan) AS collector_count
FROM collectors col
JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot = col.fan
JOIN virtualidols v ON v.entity_reg = i.interact_idol_pivot
