WITH whale AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT interact_fan_pivot AS fan_id
  FROM interactions
  WHERE (gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min, 0) > 20
),
enthusiast AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan_id
  FROM eventsandclub e
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON e.events_member_pivot = m.member_reg
  WHERE COALESCE((e.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::numeric, 0) * 1
      + COALESCE((e.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::numeric, 0) * 1.5
      + COALESCE((e.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::numeric, 0) * 2 > 25
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT w.fan_id, f.reg_moment::date AS reg_date
  FROM whale w JOIN enthusiast e USING (fan_id)
  JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = w.fan_id
),
daily AS (
  SELECT c.fan_id,
         i.time_mark::date - c.reg_date AS days_since_reg,
         SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric) AS daily_spend
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN interactions i ON i.interact_fan_pivot = c.fan_id
  WHERE i.time_mark::date >= c.reg_date
  GROUP BY c.fan_id, i.time_mark::date - c.reg_date
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT fan_id, days_since_reg,
         SUM(daily_spend) OVER (PARTITION BY fan_id ORDER BY days_since_reg) AS cumulative_spend
  FROM daily
)
SELECT ms.milestone_days, AVG(c.cumulative_spend) AS avg_cumulative_spend
FROM (VALUES (7), (30), (90)) AS ms(milestone_days)
LEFT JOIN cumulative c ON c.days_since_reg <= ms.milestone_days
GROUP BY ms.milestone_days
ORDER BY ms.milestone_days;

WITH fan_mas AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN (s.feedback_data->>'NPS_Val')::int BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promoters'
              WHEN (s.feedback_data->>'NPS_Val')::int BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN 'Detractors' END AS nps_tier,
         c.merch_spend_usd::numeric / NULLIF((m.spending_profile->>'total_spend_usd')::numeric, 0) AS mas
  FROM supportandfeedback s
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_activity_pivot = s.support_interact_pivot
  JOIN commerceandcollection c ON c.commerce_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = c.commerce_member_pivot
)
SELECT nps_tier, ROUND(AVG(mas) * 100, 2) AS avg_merch_spend_pct
FROM fan_mas
WHERE nps_tier IS NOT NULL AND mas IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY nps_tier
ORDER BY nps_tier DESC;

WITH butterflies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ms.member_fan_pivot AS fan_id
  FROM socialcommunity s
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = s.social_engage_pivot
  JOIN membershipandspending ms ON ms.member_reg = e.engage_member_pivot
  WHERE (s.network_stats->>'Soc_Net_Sz')::numeric + (s.network_stats->>'Friend_Con')::numeric * 1.5 > 1000
    AND (s.network_stats->>'Grp_Memb')::int > 5
), gaps AS (
  SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.time_mark - LAG(i.time_mark) OVER (PARTITION BY i.interact_fan_pivot ORDER BY i.time_mark))) / 86400.0 AS gap_days
  FROM interactions i
  JOIN butterflies b ON b.fan_id = i.interact_fan_pivot
)
SELECT f.nick_label, MAX(g.gap_days) AS longest_absence_days
FROM gaps g JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = g.fan_id
GROUP BY f.user_registry, f.nick_label
HAVING MAX(g.gap_days) > 14
ORDER BY longest_absence_days DESC;

WITH social AS (
  SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
         (s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric AS follower_count,
         (s.network_stats->>'Fing_Count')::numeric AS following_count
  FROM socialcommunity s
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = s.social_engage_pivot
  JOIN interactions i ON i.activity_reg = e.engage_activity_pivot
),
reach AS (
  SELECT "Fan_Identifier" AS fan_id, SUM("ViewCount")::numeric AS content_reach
  FROM fan_content_submission_details
  GROUP BY "Fan_Identifier"
),
influencers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT so.fan_id
  FROM social so
  JOIN reach r ON r.fan_id = so.fan_id
  WHERE so.following_count > 0
    AND so.follower_count / so.following_count > 2.0
    AND SQRT(so.follower_count * r.content_reach) > 10000
),
key_interactions AS (
  SELECT i.activity_reg, i.interact_idol_pivot, i.time_mark
  FROM interactions i
  JOIN influencers f ON f.fan_id = i.interact_fan_pivot
),
ripple AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.activity_reg, o.chat_activity->>'Msg_Tone' AS msg_tone
  FROM key_interactions k
  JOIN interactions o
    ON o.interact_idol_pivot = k.interact_idol_pivot
   AND o.time_mark BETWEEN k.time_mark - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND k.time_mark + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  WHERE o.interact_fan_pivot NOT IN (SELECT fan_id FROM influencers)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE msg_tone = 'Positive') AS positive_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE msg_tone = 'Negative') AS negative_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE msg_tone = 'Neutral')  AS neutral_count
FROM ripple;

WITH pss AS (
  SELECT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
         AVG(((p.usage_metrics->>'Int_Consist')::numeric + (p.usage_metrics->>'Plat_Stable')::numeric) / 2) AS pss
  FROM preferencesandsettings p
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = p.preferences_member_pivot
  GROUP BY m.member_fan_pivot
),
inter AS (
  SELECT interact_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
         AVG((gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min, 0)) AS avg_fmi,
         AVG(watch_hrs::numeric / NULLIF(sess_dur_min, 0)) AS avg_cci
  FROM interactions
  GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
),
pss_r AS (
  SELECT fan_id, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pss) AS pss_percentile
  FROM pss WHERE pss IS NOT NULL
),
fmi_r AS (
  SELECT fan_id, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_fmi) AS fmi_percentile
  FROM inter WHERE avg_fmi IS NOT NULL
),
cci_r AS (
  SELECT fan_id, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_cci) AS cci_percentile
  FROM inter WHERE avg_cci IS NOT NULL
),
churn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan_id
  FROM retentionandinfluence r
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = r.retain_engage_pivot
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = e.engage_member_pivot
  WHERE r.churn_flag = 'High'
)
SELECT f.nick_label,
       pr.pss_percentile,
       fr.fmi_percentile,
       cr.cci_percentile
FROM churn c
JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = c.fan_id
LEFT JOIN pss_r pr ON pr.fan_id = c.fan_id
LEFT JOIN fmi_r fr ON fr.fan_id = c.fan_id
LEFT JOIN cci_r cr ON cr.fan_id = c.fan_id
ORDER BY pr.pss_percentile ASC NULLS LAST;

WITH fan_idol_gifts AS (
  SELECT i.interact_idol_pivot AS idol_id,
         i.interact_fan_pivot  AS fan_id,
         SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric) AS total_gift_value
  FROM interactions i
  GROUP BY i.interact_idol_pivot, i.interact_fan_pivot
), ranked AS (
  SELECT g.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.idol_id ORDER BY g.total_gift_value DESC) AS supporter_rank
  FROM fan_idol_gifts g
)
SELECT v.name_tag, f.nick_label, r.total_gift_value, r.supporter_rank
FROM ranked r
JOIN virtualidols v ON v.entity_reg = r.idol_id
JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = r.fan_id
WHERE r.supporter_rank <= 3
ORDER BY v.name_tag, r.supporter_rank;

WITH fan_metrics AS (
  SELECT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
         (m.spending_profile->>'total_spend_usd')::numeric / NULLIF(m.memb_days / 30.44, 0) AS ffv,
         (s.feedback_data->>'Supp_Tix')::int + (s.feedback_data->>'Bug_Subs')::int + (s.feedback_data->>'Tech_Issue_Rpt')::int AS sls
  FROM membershipandspending m
  JOIN preferencesandsettings p ON p.preferences_member_pivot = m.member_reg
  JOIN supportandfeedback s ON s.support_pref_pivot = p.pref_reg
), ranked AS (
  SELECT fan_id,
         NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY ffv DESC) AS ffv_half,
         NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY sls DESC) AS sls_half
  FROM fan_metrics
)
SELECT CASE
         WHEN ffv_half = 1 AND sls_half = 2 THEN 'Ideal Fans'
         WHEN ffv_half = 1 AND sls_half = 1 THEN 'At-Risk VIPs'
         WHEN ffv_half = 2 AND sls_half = 2 THEN 'Quiet Majority'
         ELSE 'Resource Drain'
       END AS fan_segment,
       COUNT(*) AS fan_count
FROM ranked
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY fan_count DESC;

SELECT f.nick_label,
       COUNT(*) AS total_interactions,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.chat_activity->>'Msg_Tone' = 'Negative') AS negative_interactions,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.chat_activity->>'Msg_Tone' = 'Negative') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS negative_percentage
FROM interactions i
JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = i.interact_fan_pivot
WHERE i.chat_activity->>'Msg_Tone' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.user_registry, f.nick_label
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.chat_activity->>'Msg_Tone' = 'Negative') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 70
ORDER BY negative_percentage DESC, negative_interactions DESC;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT f.nick_label,
         (r.infl_impact->>'Viral_Cont')::numeric * (1 + (r.infl_impact->>'Trend_Part')::numeric) AS vps,
         sqrt((s.network_stats->>'Foll_Count')::numeric * (r.infl_impact->>'Cont_Reach')::numeric) AS cii
  FROM retentionandinfluence r
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = r.retain_engage_pivot
  JOIN socialcommunity s ON s.social_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
  JOIN membershipandspending ms ON ms.member_reg = e.engage_member_pivot
  JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = ms.member_fan_pivot
)
SELECT nick_label, vps, cii
FROM m
WHERE vps > 50 AND cii BETWEEN 1000 AND 10000
ORDER BY vps DESC;

WITH hr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_fan_pivot AS fan
  FROM retentionandinfluence r
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = r.retain_engage_pivot
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = e.engage_member_pivot
  WHERE r.churn_flag = 'High'
), gaps AS (
  SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot AS fan,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.time_mark - LAG(i.time_mark) OVER (PARTITION BY i.interact_fan_pivot ORDER BY i.time_mark))) / 86400.0 AS gap_days
  FROM interactions i
  JOIN hr ON hr.fan = i.interact_fan_pivot
)
SELECT f.nick_label, AVG(g.gap_days) AS avg_days_between_interactions
FROM gaps g
JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = g.fan
WHERE g.gap_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.user_registry, f.nick_label
ORDER BY avg_days_between_interactions DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT l.loyalty_snapshot->>'reputation_level' AS reputation_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_registry) AS loyal_achiever_count
FROM loyaltyandachievements l
JOIN engagement e ON e.engage_reg = l.loyalty_engage_pivot
JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.member_reg = e.engage_member_pivot
JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = m.member_fan_pivot

);

         f.nick_label,
         (i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric / i.sess_dur_min AS fmi,

  WHERE i.sess_dur_min > 0

peak AS (

       COALESCE(SUM((chat_activity->>'Chat_Msg')::bigint), 0),

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interactions_archive (LIKE interactions INCLUDING ALL);

BEGIN;

INSERT INTO interactions_archive
SELECT i.*
FROM interactions i
JOIN fans f ON f.user_registry = i.interact_fan_pivot
WHERE i.time_mark < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 years'
  AND f.status_tag = 'Inactive'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM membershipandspending m
        WHERE m.member_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
          AND m.memb_kind <> 'Free');

DELETE FROM interactions i
USING fans f
WHERE f.user_registry = i.interact_fan_pivot
  AND i.time_mark < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 years'
  AND f.status_tag = 'Inactive'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM membershipandspending m
        WHERE m.member_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
          AND m.memb_kind <> 'Free');

COMMIT;

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW Fan_Segment_Analysis AS
WITH ffv AS (
  SELECT m.member_fan_pivot AS user_registry,
         AVG((m.spending_profile->>'total_spend_usd')::numeric / NULLIF(m.memb_days / 30.44, 0)) AS ffv
  FROM membershipandspending m
  GROUP BY m.member_fan_pivot
), sls AS (
  SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot AS user_registry,
         SUM(COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Supp_Tix')::numeric,0)
           + COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Bug_Subs')::numeric,0)
           + COALESCE((s.feedback_data->>'Tech_Issue_Rpt')::numeric,0)) AS sls
  FROM supportandfeedback s
  JOIN interactions i ON i.activity_reg = s.support_interact_pivot
  GROUP BY i.interact_fan_pivot
), ranked AS (
  SELECT f.user_registry, f.ffv, s.sls,
         NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY f.ffv DESC) AS ffv_half,
         NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY s.sls DESC) AS sls_half
  FROM ffv f JOIN sls s ON s.user_registry = f.user_registry
  WHERE f.ffv IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT user_registry, ffv, sls,
       CASE WHEN ffv_half = 1 AND sls_half = 2 THEN 'Ideal Fans'
            WHEN ffv_half = 1 AND sls_half = 1 THEN 'At-Risk VIPs'
            WHEN ffv_half = 2 AND sls_half = 2 THEN 'Quiet Majority'
            ELSE 'Resource Drain' END AS fan_segment
FROM ranked;

REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW Fan_Segment_Analysis;
CREATE INDEX idx_interactions_idol_platform ON interactions (interact_idol_pivot, act_plat);

SELECT ri.immu_recip_registry,
       ri.pra_score,
       ri.dsa_state,
       CASE WHEN ri.pra_score >= 80 AND ri.dsa_state = 'Positive'
            THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Standard Risk' END AS amr_risk_category,
       MAX(TO_TIMESTAMP(tm.match_ts, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI:SS')::timestamp) AS last_match_ts
FROM recipients_immunology ri
LEFT JOIN transplant_matching tm
       ON tm.recip_ref_reg = ri.immu_recip_registry
WHERE ri.cross_result = 'Positive'
GROUP BY ri.immu_recip_registry, ri.pra_score, ri.dsa_state
ORDER BY ri.pra_score DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH pending AS (
  SELECT tm.recip_ref_reg, a.allc_region,
         CASE WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('2','3') THEN 'Status ' || c.med_urgency ELSE c.med_urgency END AS urgency_status,
         cm.hla_mis_count
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN allocation_details a ON a.allc_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  LEFT JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  WHERE tm.org_spec = 'Pancreas' AND tm.match_status = 'Pending'
), scored AS (
  SELECT *, CASE urgency_status WHEN 'Status 1A' THEN 5 WHEN 'Status 1B' THEN 4
                 WHEN 'Status 2' THEN 3 WHEN 'Status 3' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS urgency_value
  FROM pending
)
SELECT recip_ref_reg, allc_region, urgency_status, hla_mis_count,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY allc_region ORDER BY urgency_value DESC, hla_mis_count ASC NULLS LAST) AS regional_rank
FROM scored
ORDER BY allc_region, regional_rank;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT t.match_rec_registry, t.donor_ref_reg, t.recip_ref_reg,
         regexp_replace(c.cost_est, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric / (r.qol_val::numeric * 5) AS cer
  FROM transplant_matching t
  JOIN compatibility_metrics c ON c.match_comp_registry = t.match_rec_registry
  JOIN risk_evaluation r ON r.risk_eval_registry = t.match_rec_registry
  WHERE t.org_spec = 'Lung' AND t.match_status = 'Completed'
    AND c.cost_est IS NOT NULL AND r.qol_val IS NOT NULL AND r.qol_val > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, NTILE(20) OVER (ORDER BY cer DESC) AS grp FROM base
)
SELECT match_rec_registry, donor_ref_reg, recip_ref_reg, ROUND(cer, 2) AS cost_effectiveness_ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE grp IN (1, 20)
ORDER BY cer DESC;

WITH pat AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tm.org_spec, tm.recip_ref_reg AS recip_registry, ri.life_support,
    0.7 * CASE
            WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
            WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
            WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 2','2') THEN 3
            WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 3','3') THEN 2
            ELSE 1 END
    + 0.3 * (split_part(c.wait_time, ' ', 1)::numeric / 365.0) AS urgency_score
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
),
stable AS (
  SELECT org_spec, AVG(urgency_score) AS avg_score
  FROM pat
  WHERE life_support IS NULL OR life_support NOT IN ('ECMO','VAD')
  GROUP BY org_spec
)
SELECT p.org_spec, p.recip_registry, p.life_support,
       ROUND(p.urgency_score, 4) AS urgency_score,
       ROUND(s.avg_score, 4) AS avg_stable_urgency_score
FROM pat p
LEFT JOIN stable s ON s.org_spec = p.org_spec
WHERE p.life_support IN ('ECMO','VAD')
ORDER BY p.org_spec, p.urgency_score DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, ar.tx_cen_code,
         (re.riskmetrics->>'Infect_Risk')::numeric AS infect_risk,
         COALESCE(mh.viralstatinfo->>'Cmv_State' = 'Positive' AND ri.cmv_state = 'Negative', FALSE) AS cmv_mismatch
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON ar.adm_rev_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation re ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  LEFT JOIN medical_history mh ON mh.contrib_med_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status IN ('Completed', 'In Progress')
), center_avg AS (
  SELECT tx_cen_code, ROUND(AVG(infect_risk), 4) AS avg_non_mismatch_infect_risk
  FROM base
  WHERE NOT cmv_mismatch
  GROUP BY tx_cen_code
)
SELECT b.match_rec_registry, b.tx_cen_code, b.infect_risk, c.avg_non_mismatch_infect_risk
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN center_avg c ON c.tx_cen_code = b.tx_cen_code
WHERE b.cmv_mismatch
ORDER BY b.tx_cen_code, b.match_rec_registry;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT l.trans_method,
         substring(cm.exp_isch_time from '^[0-9.]+')::numeric
           + substring(cm.exp_time from '^[0-9.]+')::numeric AS total_isch,
         0.6 * CASE WHEN lower(cm.blood_compat) = 'compatible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + 0.4 * (1 - cm.hla_mis_count / 6.0) AS s_immune,
         substring(d.age_count from '^[0-9]+')::numeric AS donor_age
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN logistics l ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
)
SELECT trans_method,
       ROUND(AVG(total_isch), 2) AS avg_total_ischemia_time,
       ROUND(AVG(1 / (1 + EXP(-(-0.5 + 1.5 * s_immune - 0.02 * donor_age)))), 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM base
GROUP BY trans_method
ORDER BY avg_egs_score DESC, avg_total_ischemia_time ASC;

WITH cond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mh.contrib_med_registry AS donor_id, trim(c) AS condition
  FROM medical_history mh
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(mh.med_history, ',')) AS c
  WHERE mh.med_history IS NOT NULL AND trim(c) <> '' AND lower(trim(c)) <> 'none'
), top5 AS (
  SELECT condition, COUNT(DISTINCT donor_id) AS patient_count
  FROM cond
  GROUP BY condition
  ORDER BY patient_count DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT t.condition,
       t.patient_count,
       ROUND(AVG(re.surg_risk_val)::numeric, 4) AS avg_surgical_risk_score
FROM top5 t
JOIN cond c ON c.condition = t.condition
LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation re ON re.donor_ref_reg = c.donor_id
GROUP BY t.condition, t.patient_count
ORDER BY t.patient_count DESC;

WITH completed AS (
  SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, tm.dss_val, re.egs_val
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN risk_evaluation re ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
    AND tm.dss_val IS NOT NULL
    AND re.egs_val IS NOT NULL
), b AS (
  SELECT *, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY dss_val) AS dss_bucket
  FROM completed
)
SELECT dss_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS transplant_count,
       ROUND(AVG(egs_val)::numeric, 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM b
GROUP BY dss_bucket
ORDER BY dss_bucket;

SELECT a.tx_cen_code,
       COUNT(*) AS total_transplants,
       ROUND(AVG(c.hla_mis_count)::numeric, 4) AS avg_hla_mismatch_score,
       ROUND(STDDEV(c.hla_mis_count)::numeric, 4) AS stddev_hla_mismatch_score
FROM administrative_and_review a
JOIN compatibility_metrics c ON c.match_comp_registry = a.adm_rev_registry
WHERE a.tx_cen_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.tx_cen_code
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY avg_hla_mismatch_score DESC NULLS LAST, a.tx_cen_code
LIMIT 10;

WITH cases AS (
  SELECT a.tx_cen_code,
         substring(c.distance from '([0-9.]+)')::numeric AS dist,
         substring(c.exp_isch_time from '([0-9.]+)')::numeric AS isch,
         r.surg_risk_val::numeric AS surg_risk,
         CASE WHEN cl.comorbid_detail IS NULL OR btrim(cl.comorbid_detail) = '' THEN 0
              ELSE array_length(string_to_array(cl.comorbid_detail, ','), 1) END AS n_comorb
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN administrative_and_review a ON a.adm_rev_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN compatibility_metrics c ON c.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN risk_evaluation r ON r.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  LEFT JOIN clinical cl ON cl.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE a.tx_cen_code IS NOT NULL
), hosp AS (
  SELECT tx_cen_code,
         AVG(dist) AS avg_dist, AVG(isch) AS avg_isch,
         AVG(surg_risk) AS avg_surg, AVG(n_comorb) AS avg_comorb
  FROM cases
  GROUP BY tx_cen_code
), norm AS (
  SELECT tx_cen_code,
    (avg_dist   - MIN(avg_dist)   OVER()) / NULLIF(MAX(avg_dist)   OVER() - MIN(avg_dist)   OVER(), 0) AS nd,
    (avg_isch   - MIN(avg_isch)   OVER()) / NULLIF(MAX(avg_isch)   OVER() - MIN(avg_isch)   OVER(), 0) AS ni,
    (avg_surg   - MIN(avg_surg)   OVER()) / NULLIF(MAX(avg_surg)   OVER() - MIN(avg_surg)   OVER(), 0) AS ns,
    (avg_comorb - MIN(avg_comorb) OVER()) / NULLIF(MAX(avg_comorb) OVER() - MIN(avg_comorb) OVER(), 0) AS nc
  FROM hosp
), scores AS (
  SELECT tx_cen_code,
         (nd + ni) / 2 AS logistical_challenge_score,
         (ns + nc) / 2 AS medical_complexity_score
  FROM norm
)
SELECT tx_cen_code,
       ROUND(logistical_challenge_score, 4) AS logistical_challenge_score,
       ROUND(medical_complexity_score, 4) AS medical_complexity_score,
       ROUND((logistical_challenge_score + medical_complexity_score) / 2, 4) AS workhorse_score
FROM scores
WHERE medical_complexity_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (logistical_challenge_score + medical_complexity_score) / 2 DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT l.trans_method,
         substring(fr.org_isch_time FROM '[0-9.]+')::numeric AS isch_min,
         substring(cm.distance FROM '[0-9.]+')::numeric AS dist
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN logistics l ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN function_and_recovery fr ON fr.recov_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
), r AS (
  SELECT trans_method, isch_min / dist AS ratio
  FROM base
  WHERE dist >= 10 AND isch_min IS NOT NULL AND trans_method IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT trans_method,
       ROUND(AVG(ratio), 4) AS avg_efficiency_ratio,
       ROUND(MIN(ratio), 4) AS best_efficiency_ratio,
       ROUND(MAX(ratio), 4) AS worst_efficiency_ratio
FROM r
GROUP BY trans_method
ORDER BY avg_efficiency_ratio;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT tm.match_rec_registry, tm.donor_ref_reg, tm.recip_ref_reg,
         abs(r.age_count - substring(d.age_count from '^\s*(\d+)')::int) AS age_diff,
         substring(f.don_gfr_val from '([0-9.]+)')::numeric
           - 10.0 * substring(f.don_crtn_val from '([0-9.]+)')::numeric AS renal_score,
         CASE trim(c.med_urgency)
              WHEN 'Status 1A' THEN 5 WHEN 'Status 1B' THEN 4
              WHEN 'Status 2' THEN 3 WHEN '2' THEN 3
              WHEN 'Status 3' THEN 2 WHEN '3' THEN 2
              ELSE 1 END AS status_val,
         substring(c.wait_time from '([0-9.]+)')::numeric AS wait_days
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN demographics d            ON d.contrib_registry     = tm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN recipients_demographics r ON r.recip_registry       = tm.recip_ref_reg
  JOIN function_and_recovery f   ON f.recov_don_registry   = tm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN clinical c                ON c.clin_recip_registry  = tm.recip_ref_reg
)
SELECT donor_ref_reg,
       recip_ref_reg,
       CASE WHEN age_diff > 25 AND renal_score < 40 THEN 'Age Gap and Poor Renal Function'
            WHEN age_diff > 25 THEN 'Age Gap'
            ELSE 'Poor Renal Function' END AS marginal_reason,
       round(0.7 * status_val + 0.3 * (wait_days / 365.0), 4) AS patient_urgency_score
FROM base
WHERE age_diff > 25 OR renal_score < 40
ORDER BY patient_urgency_score DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT tm.recip_ref_reg, ri.pra_score, cm.hla_mis_count,
         split_part(c.wait_time,' ',1)::numeric AS wait_days, re.egs_val,
         CASE WHEN ri.pra_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN 'Low'
              WHEN ri.pra_score BETWEEN 11 AND 79 THEN 'Moderate'
              WHEN ri.pra_score BETWEEN 80 AND 95 THEN 'High'
              WHEN ri.pra_score >= 96 THEN 'Very High' END AS pra_group
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  LEFT JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation re ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
)
SELECT pra_group, COUNT(DISTINCT recip_ref_reg) AS total_patients,
       ROUND(AVG(hla_mis_count)::numeric, 2) AS avg_hla_mismatch,
       ROUND(AVG(wait_days)) AS avg_wait_days,
       ROUND(AVG(egs_val)::numeric, 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM t
GROUP BY pra_group
ORDER BY CASE pra_group WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;

WITH demand AS (
  SELECT ad.allc_region AS region,
         rd.blood_class AS blood_type,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ad.recip_ref_reg) AS patient_count
  FROM allocation_details ad
  JOIN recipients_demographics rd ON rd.recip_registry = ad.recip_ref_reg
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
supply AS (
  SELECT ad.allc_region AS region,
         split_part(d.blood_class, ' ', 1) AS blood_type,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ad.donor_ref_reg) AS donor_count
  FROM allocation_details ad
  JOIN demographics d ON d.contrib_registry = ad.donor_ref_reg
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT COALESCE(dm.region, s.region) AS region,
       COALESCE(dm.blood_type, s.blood_type) AS blood_type,
       COALESCE(dm.patient_count, 0) AS patient_count,
       COALESCE(s.donor_count, 0) AS donor_count,
       ROUND(COALESCE(dm.patient_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.donor_count, 0), 4) AS demand_supply_ratio
FROM demand dm
FULL JOIN supply s ON s.region = dm.region AND s.blood_type = dm.blood_type
ORDER BY demand_supply_ratio DESC NULLS FIRST, patient_count DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN c.med_urgency ~ '^Status' THEN c.med_urgency ELSE 'Status ' || c.med_urgency END AS med_urgency,
         REPLACE(cm.cost_est, 'US$', '')::numeric / (8 * r.qol_val::numeric) AS cer
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN risk_evaluation r ON r.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND r.qol_val IS NOT NULL AND r.qol_val > 0
)
SELECT med_urgency, ROUND(AVG(cer), 2) AS avg_cer
FROM base
GROUP BY med_urgency
ORDER BY CASE med_urgency WHEN 'Status 1A' THEN 1 WHEN 'Status 1B' THEN 2 WHEN 'Status 2' THEN 3 WHEN 'Status 3' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END;

WITH single_mm AS (
  SELECT tm.match_rec_registry,
         h.hla_a_val  <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_A_Val')::real  AS a_mm,
         h.hla_b_val  <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_B_Val')::real  AS b_mm,
         h.hla_dr_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_Dr_Val')::real AS dr_mm
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  JOIN compatibility_metrics cm ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  JOIN hla_info h ON h.immu_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  JOIN recipients_immunology ri ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND cm.hla_mis_count = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a_mm)  AS a_mismatch_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b_mm)  AS b_mismatch_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dr_mm) AS dr_mismatch_count
FROM single_mm;

WITH seq AS (
  SELECT a.tx_cen_code,
         t.match_rec_registry,
         t.created_ts::timestamp AS created_ts,
         t.match_status,
         LAG(t.match_status)    OVER (PARTITION BY a.tx_cen_code ORDER BY t.created_ts::timestamp, t.match_rec_registry) AS prev_status,
         LAG(t.match_status, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY a.tx_cen_code ORDER BY t.created_ts::timestamp, t.match_rec_registry) AS prev2_status
  FROM transplant_matching t
  JOIN administrative_and_review a ON a.adm_rev_registry = t.match_rec_registry
)
SELECT tx_cen_code, match_rec_registry, created_ts
FROM seq
WHERE match_status = 'Failed'
  AND prev_status = 'Failed'
  AND prev2_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Failed'
ORDER BY tx_cen_code, created_ts;

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW v_high_risk_donors AS
SELECT d.contrib_registry,
       substring(d.age_count FROM '^\s*(\d+)')::int AS donor_age,
       CASE
         WHEN m.viralstatinfo->>'Hiv_State' = 'Positive' THEN 'HIV Positive'
         WHEN m.viralstatinfo->>'Hcv_State' = 'Positive' THEN 'Hepatitis C Positive'
         WHEN m.med_history ILIKE '%Cancer%' THEN 'History of Malignancy'
         WHEN m.drug_cond ILIKE 'Current use%' THEN 'High-Risk Drug Use'
       END AS risk_factor
FROM demographics d
JOIN medical_history m ON m.contrib_med_registry = d.contrib_registry
WHERE m.viralstatinfo->>'Hiv_State' = 'Positive'
   OR m.viralstatinfo->>'Hcv_State' = 'Positive'
   OR m.med_history ILIKE '%Cancer%'
   OR m.drug_cond ILIKE 'Current use%';

CREATE VIEW v_anoxia_donor_profile AS
SELECT d.contrib_registry,
       substring(d.age_count FROM '^\d+')::int AS age_count,
       substring(f.don_crtn_val FROM '^[0-9.]+')::numeric AS don_crtn_val,
       substring(f.don_gfr_val FROM '^[0-9.]+')::numeric AS don_gfr_val
FROM demographics d
JOIN function_and_recovery f ON f.recov_don_registry = d.contrib_registry
WHERE f.don_co_desc ILIKE 'Anoxia%';

CREATE TABLE transplant_center_performance (
    center_id text,
    total_transplants integer,
    avg_egs_score real,
    center_performance_score real
);

INSERT INTO transplant_center_performance (center_id, total_transplants, avg_egs_score, center_performance_score)
SELECT a.tx_cen_code,
       COUNT(*),
       AVG(r.egs_val),
       0.7 * COUNT(*) + 0.3 * AVG(r.egs_val)
FROM administrative_and_review a
LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation r ON r.risk_eval_registry = a.adm_rev_registry
WHERE a.tx_cen_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.tx_cen_code;

CREATE VIEW v_pediatric_heart_candidates AS
SELECT r.recip_registry,
       r.age_count,
       c.med_urgency,
       CAST(regexp_replace(c.wait_time, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS numeric) / 365.0 AS wait_time_ratio
FROM recipients_demographics r
JOIN clinical c ON c.clin_recip_registry = r.recip_registry
WHERE r.age_count < 18
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transplant_matching t
              WHERE t.recip_ref_reg = r.recip_registry AND t.org_spec = 'Heart')
ORDER BY CASE
           WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
           WHEN c.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
           WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 2', '2') THEN 3
           WHEN c.med_urgency IN ('Status 3', '3') THEN 2
           ELSE 1
         END DESC,
         wait_time_ratio DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_match_risk_profile(p_match_id TEXT)
RETURNS JSONB AS $$
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'Immun_Risk',   riskmetrics -> 'Immun_Risk',
        'Infect_Risk',  riskmetrics -> 'Infect_Risk',
        'Reject_Risk',  riskmetrics -> 'Reject_Risk',
        'Readmit_Risk', riskmetrics -> 'Readmit_Risk',
        'Mort_Risk',    riskmetrics -> 'Mort_Risk'
    )
    FROM risk_evaluation
    WHERE risk_eval_registry = p_match_id;
$$ LANGUAGE sql;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.pat_ref, e.ab_ref, e.time_mark, f.env_stress,
         AVG(CASE t.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS tes,
         BOOL_OR(t.th_eng = 'Low') AS has_low
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk r ON r.asr_key = e.ab_ref
  JOIN facilities f ON f.fac_key = e.fac_id
  JOIN treatmentbasics t ON t.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  WHERE (r.suic_risk = 'High' OR r.phq9_scr > 15 OR r.gad7_scr > 15)
    AND f.env_stress = 'Severe'
  GROUP BY e.pat_ref, e.ab_ref, e.time_mark, f.env_stress
)
SELECT pat_ref, ab_ref, time_mark, ROUND(tes, 2) AS avg_engagement_score, env_stress
FROM base
WHERE tes < 1.5 AND has_low
ORDER BY time_mark DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH tes AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         AVG(CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS tes
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
),
oc AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tro.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant'))::numeric
           / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS tar,
         AVG(CASE lower(tro.txprogmet->>'Func_Impv')
               WHEN 'significant' THEN 3 WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'minimal' THEN 1 END) AS fis
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes tro ON tro.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
)
SELECT t.fac_id,
       ROUND(t.tes, 2) AS tes,
       ROUND(o.fis * o.tar, 2) AS rti
FROM tes t
JOIN oc o ON o.fac_id = t.fac_id
WHERE t.tes > 2.0
  AND o.fis * o.tar < 0.8
ORDER BY t.fac_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH fac_res AS (
  SELECT fac_key,
         CASE com_res WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3
                      WHEN 'Extensive'     THEN 3
                      WHEN 'Adequate'      THEN 2
                      WHEN 'Limited'       THEN 1 END AS resource_score
  FROM facilities
), fac_tar AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tor.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant'))::numeric
           / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS tar
  FROM treatmentoutcomes tor
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.tx_key = tor.tx_ref
  JOIN encounters e       ON e.enc_key = tb.enc_ref
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
)
SELECT AVG(r.resource_score)        AS overall_frai,
       CORR(r.resource_score, t.tar) AS craa
FROM fac_res r
JOIN fac_tar t ON t.fac_id = r.fac_key
WHERE t.tar IS NOT NULL;

SELECT asd.prim_dx,
       COUNT(DISTINCT e.pat_ref) AS patient_count,
       ROUND(SUM(tb.crisis_int)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.pat_ref), 0), 2) AS cif
FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd
JOIN encounters e ON e.ab_ref = asd.asd_key
JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
GROUP BY asd.prim_dx
ORDER BY cif DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH enc AS (
  SELECT e.enc_key, e.pat_ref, e.time_mark, a.rec_status,
         (CASE a.funcassess->>'Soc_Sup' WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weak' THEN 0 END)
       + (CASE a.funcassess->>'Rel_Qual' WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 WHEN 'Conflicted' THEN 0 END) AS sse
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis a ON a.asd_key = e.ab_ref
),
stable_recovery AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT en.pat_ref
  FROM enc en
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = en.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes t ON t.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
  WHERE en.rec_status = 'Stable'
    AND lower(t.txprogmet->>'Func_Impv') IN ('moderate', 'significant')
),
missed AS (
  SELECT pat_ref, AVG(miss_appt) AS avg_missed_appointments
  FROM encounters
  GROUP BY pat_ref
),
latest_sse AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pat_ref) pat_ref, sse AS latest_sse
  FROM enc
  ORDER BY pat_ref, time_mark DESC, enc_key DESC
)
SELECT s.pat_ref, m.avg_missed_appointments, l.latest_sse
FROM stable_recovery s
JOIN missed m ON m.pat_ref = s.pat_ref
LEFT JOIN latest_sse l ON l.pat_ref = s.pat_ref
WHERE m.avg_missed_appointments > 2 OR l.latest_sse < 3
ORDER BY s.pat_ref;

WITH tx AS (
  SELECT tb.tx_key, e.pat_ref, tb.th_chg, e.time_mark,
         CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END AS eng_score
  FROM treatmentbasics tb
  JOIN encounters e ON e.enc_key = tb.enc_ref
), seq AS (
  SELECT th_chg, eng_score AS after_score,
         LAG(eng_score) OVER (PARTITION BY pat_ref ORDER BY time_mark, tx_key) AS before_score
  FROM tx
)
SELECT th_chg AS therapy_change_type,
       COUNT(*) AS change_count,
       AVG(before_score) AS avg_engagement_before,
       AVG(after_score) AS avg_engagement_after,
       AVG(after_score) - AVG(before_score) AS engagement_change
FROM seq
WHERE th_chg IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY th_chg
ORDER BY change_count DESC;

WITH enc AS (
  SELECT fac_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref) AS n_pat, SUM(miss_appt) AS miss
  FROM encounters
  GROUP BY fac_id
), cr AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id, SUM(tb.crisis_int) AS crisis
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), ta AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tro.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant'))::numeric / COUNT(*) AS tar
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes tro ON tro.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), fm AS (
  SELECT enc.fac_id, ta.tar,
         1.0 / (1 + COALESCE(cr.crisis, 0)::numeric / enc.n_pat + enc.miss::numeric / enc.n_pat) AS psm
  FROM enc
  JOIN ta ON ta.fac_id = enc.fac_id
  LEFT JOIN cr ON cr.fac_id = enc.fac_id
), med AS (
  SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tar) AS med_tar,
         PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY psm) AS med_psm
  FROM fm
)
SELECT fm.fac_id,
       ROUND(fm.tar, 2) AS tar,
       ROUND(fm.psm, 2) AS psm,
       CASE WHEN fm.tar >= med.med_tar AND fm.psm >= med.med_psm THEN 'High Adherence, High Stability'
            WHEN fm.tar >= med.med_tar AND fm.psm <  med.med_psm THEN 'High Adherence, Low Stability'
            WHEN fm.tar <  med.med_tar AND fm.psm >= med.med_psm THEN 'Low Adherence, High Stability'
            ELSE 'Low Adherence, Low Stability' END AS performance_quadrant
FROM fm
CROSS JOIN med
ORDER BY performance_quadrant, fm.fac_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH fs AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         COUNT(asr.asr_key) AS n_assess,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE asr.suic_risk = 'High') AS n_high,
         AVG(CASE LOWER(asd.func_imp) WHEN 'severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'mild' THEN 1 END) AS pfis
  FROM encounters e
  LEFT JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON asr.asr_key = e.ab_ref
  LEFT JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), fr AS (
  SELECT fac_key,
         CASE com_res WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Extensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END::numeric AS frai
  FROM facilities
)
SELECT fs.fac_id, fs.pfis, fr.frai, fs.pfis - fr.frai AS rdd
FROM fs
JOIN fr ON fr.fac_key = fs.fac_id
WHERE fs.n_assess > 0
  AND fs.n_high::numeric / fs.n_assess * 100 > 20
ORDER BY rdd DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

WITH sym AS (
  SELECT p.pat_eth, GROUPING(p.pat_eth) AS g,
         (AVG(s.phq9_scr) + AVG(s.gad7_scr)) / 2.0 AS symptom_severity_index
  FROM patients p
  JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk s ON s.asr_key = e.ab_ref
  GROUP BY ROLLUP (p.pat_eth)
), adh AS (
  SELECT p.pat_eth, GROUPING(p.pat_eth) AS g,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tb.med_adh IN ('High','Medium','Compliant'))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS treatment_adherence_rate
  FROM patients p
  JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  GROUP BY ROLLUP (p.pat_eth)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.g, a.g) = 1 THEN 'All Ethnicities' ELSE COALESCE(s.pat_eth, a.pat_eth) END AS ethnicity,
       s.symptom_severity_index, a.treatment_adherence_rate
FROM sym s FULL JOIN adh a ON s.g = a.g AND s.pat_eth IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.pat_eth
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.g, a.g), ethnicity;

WITH pfis AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         AVG(CASE lower(a.func_imp) WHEN 'severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'mild' THEN 1 END) AS pfis
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis a ON a.asd_key = e.ab_ref
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), frai AS (
  SELECT fac_key AS fac_id,
         CASE WHEN com_res IN ('Comprehensive','Extensive') THEN 3
              WHEN com_res = 'Adequate' THEN 2
              WHEN com_res = 'Limited' THEN 1 END AS frai
  FROM facilities
), tes AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         AVG(CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS tes
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), tar AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant'))::numeric
           / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS tar
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), mar AS (
  SELECT fac_id, SUM(miss_appt)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref), 0) AS mar
  FROM encounters
  GROUP BY fac_id
), m AS (
  SELECT f.fac_id,
         p.pfis - f.frai AS rdd,
         (t.tes + r.tar * 3) / 2 AS eas,
         mr.mar
  FROM frai f
  JOIN pfis p USING (fac_id)
  JOIN tes t USING (fac_id)
  JOIN tar r USING (fac_id)
  JOIN mar mr USING (fac_id)
)
SELECT fac_id, rdd
FROM m
WHERE rdd > 1.0 AND eas < 1.5 AND mar > 2.5
ORDER BY rdd DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH fac AS (
  SELECT f.fac_key,
         CASE f.com_res
              WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3
              WHEN 'Extensive'     THEN 3
              WHEN 'Adequate'      THEN 2
              WHEN 'Limited'       THEN 1
         END AS resource_score,
         AVG(CASE WHEN o.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS tar
  FROM facilities f
  JOIN encounters e         ON e.fac_id  = f.fac_key
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb   ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o  ON o.tx_ref  = tb.tx_key
  GROUP BY f.fac_key, f.com_res
)
SELECT CORR(resource_score, tar) AS craa
FROM fac;

WITH pat_risk AS (
  SELECT ab.ab_key,
         asd.prev_hosp::numeric / NULLIF(asd.dx_dur_m::numeric / 12, 0) AS ahr,
         split_part(ab.therapy_exp_intensity, ' ', 1)::numeric AS therapy_hours
  FROM assessmentbasics ab
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = ab.ab_key
  WHERE ab.pat_owner_ref = 'P871358'
),
flag AS (
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pat_risk WHERE ahr > 1.5 AND therapy_hours < 8) AS is_flagged
),
last_fac AS (
  SELECT fac_id FROM encounters WHERE pat_ref = 'P871358'
  ORDER BY time_mark DESC LIMIT 1
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT c.clin_key, c.fac_connect
  FROM clinicians c JOIN last_fac lf ON c.fac_connect = lf.fac_id
  WHERE c.clin_conf = 'High' AND c.nxt_rev_dt > DATE '2024-06-30'
)
SELECT clin_key::text AS result, fac_connect AS facility
FROM candidates, flag WHERE flag.is_flagged
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Patient does not meet criteria for Intensive Care Coordination', NULL
FROM flag WHERE NOT flag.is_flagged;

WITH crisis AS (
  SELECT e.pat_ref, SUM(t.crisis_int) AS total_crisis_interventions
  FROM treatmentbasics t
  JOIN encounters e ON e.enc_key = t.enc_ref
  GROUP BY e.pat_ref
), support AS (
  SELECT e.pat_ref,
         AVG( CASE a.funcassess->>'Soc_Sup' WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weak' THEN 0 END
            + CASE a.funcassess->>'Rel_Qual' WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 WHEN 'Conflicted' THEN 0 END
         ) AS sse_score,
         MAX(TO_DATE(a.last_hosp_dt, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) AS last_hospitalization_date
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis a ON a.asd_key = e.ab_ref
  GROUP BY e.pat_ref
), next_appt AS (
  SELECT pat_ref, MAX(TO_DATE(nx_appt_dt, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) AS next_appointment_date
  FROM encounters
  GROUP BY pat_ref
)
SELECT p.pat_key, p.pat_age, c.total_crisis_interventions, s.sse_score,
       s.last_hospitalization_date, n.next_appointment_date
FROM patients p
JOIN crisis c ON c.pat_ref = p.pat_key
JOIN support s ON s.pat_ref = p.pat_key
LEFT JOIN next_appt n ON n.pat_ref = p.pat_key
WHERE c.total_crisis_interventions > 2
  AND s.sse_score < 3
ORDER BY c.total_crisis_interventions DESC, p.pat_key;

SELECT pat_owner_ref,
       (split_part(therapy_exp_intensity, ' ', 1)::numeric >= 5) AS meets_therapy_target,
       0.0509 * 1200 AS projected_annual_qol_gain,
       (0.0509 * 1200 > 50) AS is_good_value
FROM assessmentbasics
WHERE pat_owner_ref = 'P883117';

SELECT (6000.0 / 1.25) / 100      AS affordable_therapy_hours,
       (29.86 >= 30)              AS meets_intensive_therapy_standard,
       0.1197 * 6000              AS projected_annual_qol_gain,
       (0.1197 * 6000 > 650)      AS exceeds_good_value_benchmark;

SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN s.prim_dx = 'PTSD'
           THEN split_part(ab.recovery_goal_vel, ' ', 1)::numeric * 12 END) AS ptsd_avg_annual_goals,
  AVG(CASE WHEN s.prim_dx = 'Anxiety'
           THEN split_part(ab.recovery_goal_vel, ' ', 1)::numeric * 12 END) AS anxiety_avg_annual_goals
FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis s
JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.ab_key = s.asd_key
WHERE s.prim_dx IN ('PTSD', 'Anxiety');

SELECT ab.pat_owner_ref AS patient_id,
       s.dx_dur_m,
       s.prev_hosp,
       (split_part(ab.therapy_exp_intensity, ' ', 1)::numeric >= 15) AS meets_therapy_standard
FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis s
JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.ab_key = s.asd_key
WHERE s.prim_dx = 'Bipolar'
ORDER BY ab.pat_owner_ref;

SELECT ab.pat_owner_ref,
       split_part(ab.med_side_eff_density, ' ', 1)::numeric AS med_side_eff_density,
       split_part(ab.med_side_eff_density, ' ', 1)::numeric * 2 * 12 AS annualized_side_effect_score,
       (split_part(ab.med_side_eff_density, ' ', 1)::numeric * 2 * 12) > 0.1 AS exceeds_safety_limit
FROM assessmentbasics ab
JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = ab.ab_key
JOIN encounters e ON e.ab_ref = ab.ab_key
WHERE e.fac_id = 'F533'
  AND asd.prim_dx = 'Anxiety'
  AND asd.dx_dur_m > 12
ORDER BY annualized_side_effect_score DESC;

DELETE FROM treatmentoutcomes o
USING treatmentbasics b, encounters e
WHERE o.tx_ref = b.tx_key
  AND b.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  AND o.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' = 'Non-compliant'
  AND b.med_adh = 'Non-compliant'
  AND e.time_mark < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '60 days';

UPDATE clinicians c
SET care_coord = 'Intensive'
FROM patients p
WHERE p.clin_lead_ref = c.clin_key
  AND p.pat_key = 'P515871'
  AND (SELECT asr.suic_risk
       FROM assessmentbasics ab
       JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON asr.asr_key = ab.ab_key
       LEFT JOIN encounters e ON e.ab_ref = ab.ab_key
       WHERE ab.pat_owner_ref = p.pat_key
       ORDER BY e.time_mark DESC NULLS LAST
       LIMIT 1) = 'High';

ALTER TABLE patients ADD COLUMN needs_case_review BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT ab.pat_owner_ref,
         CAST(split_part(ab.hosp_risk_density, ' ', 1) AS NUMERIC) AS hosp_risk,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ab.pat_owner_ref ORDER BY e.time_mark DESC, e.enc_key DESC) AS rn
  FROM assessmentbasics ab
  JOIN encounters e ON e.ab_ref = ab.ab_key
)
UPDATE patients p
SET needs_case_review = TRUE
FROM latest l
WHERE l.pat_owner_ref = p.pat_key
  AND l.rn = 1
  AND l.hosp_risk > 1.5;

UPDATE assessmentbasics
SET support_util_rate = '0.75 support-level/contact'
WHERE ab_key = 'A981114'
  AND pat_owner_ref = 'P883117';

CREATE TABLE vulnerable_patient_watchlist (
  watchlist_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  patient_id TEXT,
  clinician_id TEXT,
  total_crisis_count INTEGER,
  support_score NUMERIC,
  next_appointment_date DATE,
  insertion_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE
);

INSERT INTO vulnerable_patient_watchlist (patient_id, clinician_id, total_crisis_count, support_score, next_appointment_date)
WITH crisis AS (
  SELECT e.pat_ref, SUM(t.crisis_int) AS total_crisis
  FROM treatmentbasics t
  JOIN encounters e ON e.enc_key = t.enc_ref
  GROUP BY e.pat_ref
), support AS (
  SELECT ab.pat_owner_ref AS pat_ref,
         AVG( CASE s.funcassess->>'Soc_Sup' WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE s.funcassess->>'Rel_Qual' WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS sse
  FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis s
  JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.ab_key = s.asd_key
  GROUP BY ab.pat_owner_ref
), last_visit AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pat_ref) pat_ref, TO_DATE(nx_appt_dt, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS next_appt
  FROM encounters
  ORDER BY pat_ref, time_mark DESC, TO_DATE(nx_appt_dt, 'DD/MM/YYYY') DESC
)
SELECT p.pat_key, p.clin_lead_ref, c.total_crisis::int, s.sse, lv.next_appt
FROM patients p
JOIN crisis c ON c.pat_ref = p.pat_key
JOIN support s ON s.pat_ref = p.pat_key
LEFT JOIN last_visit lv ON lv.pat_ref = p.pat_key
WHERE c.total_crisis > 2 AND s.sse < 3;

SELECT r.casenum,
 ROUND(( (r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric), 2) AS total_return_cost
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management f ON f.casetag = r.casenum
ORDER BY total_return_cost DESC;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT (f.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value')::numeric AS rv,
         (r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::numeric
       + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::numeric
       + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::numeric
       + (f.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::numeric
       + (f.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric AS trc
  FROM returns r
  JOIN financial_management f ON f.casetag = r.casenum
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(rv - trc), 2) AS total_rpi,
       ROUND(SUM(rv), 2)       AS total_recovery_value,
       ROUND(SUM(trc), 2)      AS total_return_cost
FROM c;

UPDATE financial_management
SET cost_breakdown = jsonb_set(cost_breakdown, '{refund,status}', '"Pending"'::jsonb)
WHERE cost_breakdown->'refund'->>'method' = 'Store Credit'
  AND (cost_breakdown->'refund'->>'refund_amount')::numeric = 0
RETURNING creditref, cost_breakdown->'refund'->>'status' AS refund_status;

SELECT r.casenum,
       ROUND(((f.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value')::numeric / NULLIF(r.dayslapsed, 0)), 2) AS recovery_rate_per_day,
       ROUND((f.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value')::numeric, 2) AS recovery_value,
       r.dayslapsed
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management f ON f.casetag = r.casenum
ORDER BY recovery_rate_per_day DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(
  (r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric
 + 0.5 * (f.cost_breakdown->'sustainability'->>'carbon_footprint')::numeric
 - (f.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value')::numeric
), 2) AS avg_sal
FROM financial_management f
JOIN returns r ON r.casenum = f.casetag;

SELECT casenum,
       (return_details->'fraud'->>'fraud_flags')::int AS fraud_flags,
       CASE return_details->'fraud'->>'risk_level'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 END AS risk_weight,
       (return_details->'fraud'->>'fraud_flags')::int *
       CASE return_details->'fraud'->>'risk_level'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 END AS fraud_severity_score
FROM returns
ORDER BY fraud_severity_score DESC NULLS LAST, casenum;

SELECT SUM(0.2*((r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::numeric
 + (f.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric)) AS total_regulatory_penalty
FROM returns r
JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
JOIN financial_management f ON f.casetag = r.casenum
WHERE p.product_traceability->'compliance'->>'regulatory_compliance' = 'Non-compliant';

SELECT casenum,
       return_channel,
       ROUND(
         (return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::numeric
         / NULLIF(AVG((return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::numeric)
                  OVER (PARTITION BY return_channel), 0)
       , 2) AS rcci
FROM returns
ORDER BY revdate::date DESC, casenum DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.itemcategory,
       ROUND(AVG((f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::numeric), 2) AS avg_relabeling_cost
FROM financial_management f
JOIN returns r ON r.casenum = f.casetag
JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
GROUP BY p.itemcategory
ORDER BY avg_relabeling_cost DESC;

UPDATE customers c
SET seg_category = 'Suspended'
FROM (
  SELECT o.buyerlink AS profilenum
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
  GROUP BY o.buyerlink
  HAVING SUM(COALESCE((r.return_details->'fraud'->>'fraud_flags')::int, 0) *
             CASE r.return_details->'fraud'->>'risk_level'
               WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) >= 9
) f
WHERE c.profilenum = f.profilenum
RETURNING c.profilenum, c.seg_category;

SELECT cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_method' AS disposal_method,
       SUM((cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::numeric) AS total_disposal_cost
FROM financial_management
GROUP BY cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_method'
ORDER BY total_disposal_cost DESC;

SELECT r.casenum,
       (r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::numeric
     + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::numeric
     + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::numeric
     + (f.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::numeric
     + (f.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric AS total_return_cost
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management f ON f.casetag = r.casenum
ORDER BY total_return_cost DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

UPDATE financial_management f
SET cost_breakdown = jsonb_set(
      f.cost_breakdown,
      '{repair_costs,repair_estimate}',
      to_jsonb((f.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric * 1.15))
FROM returns r
WHERE r.casenum = f.casetag
  AND r.dayslapsed > 60
RETURNING r.casenum,
          ROUND((f.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric, 2) AS new_repair_estimate;

SELECT r.return_channel,
       ROUND(AVG((f.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value')::numeric), 2) AS avg_recovery_value
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management f ON f.casetag = r.casenum
GROUP BY r.return_channel
ORDER BY r.return_channel;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(return_details->'fraud'->>'risk_level') = 'high') / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_risk_pct
FROM returns;

UPDATE case_management

RETURNING casetie;

SELECT cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_method' AS disposal_method,
       ROUND(SUM((cost_breakdown->'sustainability'->>'carbon_footprint')::numeric), 2) AS total_carbon_footprint_kg
FROM financial_management

SELECT return_details->'authorization'->>'warranty_status' AS warranty_status,
       return_channel,

UPDATE products

UPDATE case_management

WITH c AS (
  SELECT f.cost_breakdown->'refund'->>'method' AS refund_method,
         (f.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'recovery_value')::numeric AS recovery_value,
         (r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::numeric
       + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee')::numeric
       + (f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost')::numeric
       + (f.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost')::numeric
       + (f.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate')::numeric AS trc
  FROM financial_management f
  JOIN returns r ON r.casenum = f.casetag
)
SELECT refund_method,
       AVG(recovery_value - trc) AS avg_rpi,
       AVG(recovery_value) AS avg_recovery_value,
       AVG(trc) AS avg_trc
FROM c
GROUP BY refund_method
ORDER BY avg_rpi DESC;

WITH ch AS (
  SELECT return_channel,
         AVG((return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::numeric) AS avg_fee
  FROM returns
  GROUP BY return_channel
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG((r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee')::numeric / ch.avg_fee), 2) AS avg_rcci
FROM returns r
JOIN ch ON ch.return_channel = r.return_channel
WHERE r.return_channel = 'Courier'
  AND r.return_details->'fraud'->>'risk_level' = 'High';

WITH old AS (
  SELECT loccode, apprlevel AS old_level
  FROM return_processing
  WHERE procprio = 'Express' AND apprlevel = 'Automatic'
)

FROM old

RETURNING rp.loccode, old.old_level, rp.apprlevel AS new_level;

SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id,
       m.faultpredscore,
       m.rulhours / 24.0 AS rul_days
FROM maintenance_and_fault m
JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = m.upkeepactuation
WHERE m.faultpredscore > 0.7
  AND m.rulhours / 24.0 >= 7
  AND m.rulhours / 24.0 < 14
ORDER BY rul_days;

SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id,
       o.apptypeval,
       a.poserrmmval / rd.reachmmval AS relative_positional_error,
       CASE ps.calibstateval
            WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Success'
            WHEN '0' THEN 'Failed'
            WHEN 'N' THEN 'Pending'
       END AS calibration_state
FROM actuation_data a
JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = a.actoperref
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref
LEFT JOIN performance_and_safety ps ON ps.effectivenessactuation = a.actreg
WHERE o.apptypeval IN ('Assembly', 'Electronics-Handling', 'Inspection', 'Dispensing', 'Laser Cutting')
  AND a.poserrmmval / NULLIF(rd.reachmmval, 0) > 0.0001
ORDER BY relative_positional_error DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.actrecref AS botcode,
         rd.modelseriesval,
         (1000.0 / (m.rulhours + 1)) + (m.faultpredscore * 10) AS pmu,
         (SELECT avg((j.joint_health->k->>'temperature_C')::numeric) FROM unnest(ARRAY['J1','J2','J3','J4','J5','J6']) k) AS avg_temp,
         (SELECT max((j.joint_health->k->>'temperature_C')::numeric) FROM unnest(ARRAY['J1','J2','J3','J4','J5','J6']) k) AS max_temp,
         (SELECT min((j.joint_health->k->>'temperature_C')::numeric) FROM unnest(ARRAY['J1','J2','J3','J4','J5','J6']) k) AS min_temp
  FROM maintenance_and_fault m
  JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = m.upkeepactuation
  JOIN joint_condition j ON j.jcondoperref = m.upkeepoperation
  LEFT JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref
  WHERE (m.rulhours / 24.0 < 7 OR m.upkeepduedays <= 0)
)
SELECT botcode, modelseriesval, pmu, max_temp
FROM base
WHERE avg_temp > 75 OR (max_temp - min_temp) > 15
ORDER BY pmu DESC NULLS LAST, max_temp DESC;

WITH h AS (
  SELECT rd.botdetreg,
         lower(rd.mfgnameval) AS mfgnameval,
         (1.0 - ps.conditionindexval) / NULLIF(CURRENT_DATE - rd.instdateval, 0) AS hdr
  FROM performance_and_safety ps
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
)
SELECT mfgnameval,
       COUNT(DISTINCT botdetreg) AS degrading_robot_count,
       AVG(hdr) AS avg_hdr
FROM h
WHERE hdr > 0
GROUP BY mfgnameval
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT botdetreg) >= 2
ORDER BY avg_hdr DESC;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT ad.actrecref AS robot_id,
         LOWER(rd.modelseriesval) AS model_series,
         (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2.0 AS stress_score,
         rd.modelseriesval AS ms
  FROM system_controller sc
  JOIN actuation_data ad ON ad.actreg = sc.systemoverseeractuation
  JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = ad.actrecref
), a AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(stress_score) OVER (PARTITION BY ms) AS model_avg_stress
  FROM s
)
SELECT robot_id, model_series, stress_score, model_avg_stress
FROM a
WHERE stress_score > 1.2 * model_avg_stress
ORDER BY stress_score DESC;

SELECT o.operrecref AS robot_id,
       rd.mfgnameval,
       rd.modelseriesval,
       ROUND((3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval)::numeric, 2) AS cycles_per_hour
FROM operation o
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref
WHERE o.cycletimesecval IS NOT NULL
  AND o.cycletimesecval > 0
  AND 3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval < 180
ORDER BY 3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ROUND(AVG((j.value->>'vibration_mmps')::numeric), 2) AS avg_joint_vibration
FROM joint_condition jc, jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) j;

WITH stress AS (
  SELECT a.actrecref AS botdetreg, r.mfgnameval, r.modelseriesval, s.systemoverseeroperation,
         (s.overseerloadvalue + s.memuseval) / 2.0 AS controller_stress_score
  FROM system_controller s
  JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = s.systemoverseeractuation
  JOIN robot_details r ON r.botdetreg = a.actrecref
), stress_avg AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(controller_stress_score) OVER (PARTITION BY modelseriesval) AS model_avg_stress
  FROM stress
), wear AS (
  SELECT j.jcondoperref, j.jcdetref,
         0.6 * AVG((e.value->>'vibration_mmps')::numeric) + 0.4 * AVG((e.value->>'backlash_deg')::numeric) AS mechanical_wear_score
  FROM joint_condition j CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(j.joint_health) e
  GROUP BY j.jcondid, j.jcondoperref, j.jcdetref
)
SELECT sa.botdetreg, sa.mfgnameval, LOWER(sa.modelseriesval) AS modelseriesval,
       sa.controller_stress_score, w.mechanical_wear_score
FROM stress_avg sa
JOIN wear w ON w.jcondoperref = sa.systemoverseeroperation AND w.jcdetref = sa.botdetreg
WHERE sa.controller_stress_score > 1.2 * sa.model_avg_stress
  AND w.mechanical_wear_score >= 0.5
ORDER BY sa.mfgnameval, sa.controller_stress_score DESC;

CREATE VIEW vw_high_risk_robots AS
WITH robot_safety AS (
  SELECT ps.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
         SUM(ps.collisioncount) AS total_collisions,
         SUM(COALESCE(ps.collisioncount,0) + COALESCE(ps.zoneviolnum,0) + COALESCE(ps.speedviolnum,0))
             FILTER (WHERE o.totopshrval IS NOT NULL) AS rated_incidents,
         SUM(o.totopshrval) AS total_ops_hours
  FROM performance_and_safety ps
  JOIN actuation_data ad ON ad.actreg = ps.effectivenessactuation
  LEFT JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = ad.actoperref
  GROUP BY ps.effectivenessrobot
), scored AS (
  SELECT robot_id, total_collisions,
         rated_incidents * 1000.0 / NULLIF(total_ops_hours, 0) AS safety_incident_rate
  FROM robot_safety
)
SELECT s.robot_id, rd.mfgnameval, rd.modelseriesval, s.total_collisions, s.safety_incident_rate
FROM scored s
JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = s.robot_id
WHERE s.total_collisions > 5 OR s.safety_incident_rate > 2.0;

WITH o AS (
  SELECT calendaryear, fundperf - categoryperf AS outperformance
  FROM annual_returns
  WHERE portfolioref = 'AADR' AND fundperf IS NOT NULL AND categoryperf IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT calendaryear,
       outperformance,
       LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS previous_year_outperformance,
       outperformance - LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS yoy_change
FROM o
ORDER BY calendaryear;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT tickersym, shortlabel, productclass, duration,
         AVG(duration) OVER (PARTITION BY productclass) AS category_avg_duration
  FROM funds
  WHERE duration IS NOT NULL AND productclass IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT tickersym, shortlabel, productclass, duration, category_avg_duration,
       category_avg_duration - duration AS duration_advantage
FROM c
WHERE category_avg_duration - duration >= 1.5
ORDER BY duration_advantage DESC;

WITH b AS (
 SELECT a.fundlink,
        SUM(a.allocationpct) FILTER (WHERE r.credit_scoringmark IN ('us_government','aaa','aa')) AS hq_alloc,
        SUM(a.allocationpct) AS total_alloc
 FROM bond_allocations a JOIN bond_ratings r ON r.ratekey = a.ratinglink
 GROUP BY a.fundlink),
p AS (
 SELECT f.tickersym, f.shortlabel,
        (f.yieldrate / f.expensenet) * b.hq_alloc AS secure_income_efficiency_score
 FROM funds f JOIN b ON b.fundlink = f.tickersym
 WHERE f.expensenet > 0
   AND f.yieldrate / f.expensenet > 15
   AND b.total_alloc > 0
   AND b.hq_alloc / b.total_alloc > 0.6)
SELECT tickersym, shortlabel,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY secure_income_efficiency_score DESC) AS premier_rank,
       secure_income_efficiency_score
FROM p
ORDER BY secure_income_efficiency_score DESC;

SELECT tickersym,
       networth,
       turnoverratio,
       networth::numeric * turnoverratio::numeric / (vol3m::numeric * 252) AS liquidity_pressure
FROM funds
WHERE networth IS NOT NULL
  AND turnoverratio IS NOT NULL
  AND vol3m > 0
ORDER BY liquidity_pressure DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH o AS (
  SELECT portfolioref, categoryperf, fundperf - categoryperf AS outp
  FROM annual_returns
  WHERE fundperf IS NOT NULL AND categoryperf IS NOT NULL
), a AS (
  SELECT portfolioref,
    AVG(outp) FILTER (WHERE categoryperf > 0)  AS avg_upside_outperformance,
    AVG(outp) FILTER (WHERE categoryperf <= 0) AS avg_downside_outperformance,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE categoryperf > 0)  AS nu,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE categoryperf <= 0) AS nd
  FROM o
  GROUP BY portfolioref
)
SELECT portfolioref AS tickersym,
       avg_upside_outperformance,
       avg_downside_outperformance,
       avg_upside_outperformance - avg_downside_outperformance AS capture_differential
FROM a
WHERE nu >= 3 AND nd >= 3
  AND avg_upside_outperformance > 0
  AND avg_downside_outperformance > 0
ORDER BY capture_differential DESC;

SELECT investmentref AS ticker,
       beta3y - beta10y AS beta_drift,
       rsquared3y - rsquared10y AS rsquared_drift,
       CASE WHEN ABS(beta3y - beta10y) > 0.15 OR ABS(rsquared3y - rsquared10y) > 10
            THEN 'Style Drift' ELSE 'Stable' END AS style_classification
FROM risk_metrics
WHERE beta3y IS NOT NULL AND beta10y IS NOT NULL
  AND rsquared3y IS NOT NULL AND rsquared10y IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(beta3y - beta10y) DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT f.tickersym,
       f.shortlabel,
       ((p.low52w + p.lowdelta) - p.low52w) / NULLIF(p.high52w - p.low52w, 0) * 100 AS price_position
FROM funds f
JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
WHERE f.turnoverratio < 0.3
  AND (f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp) < 0
  AND ((p.low52w + p.lowdelta) - p.low52w) / NULLIF(p.high52w - p.low52w, 0) * 100 < 25
ORDER BY price_position ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT CASE WHEN f.pe_ratio IS NOT NULL AND f.pb_ratio IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'Transparent' ELSE 'Opaque' END AS valuation_data_availability,
       COUNT(*) AS fund_count,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.r1y) AS median_1y_return
FROM funds f
LEFT JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT f.tickersym, f.shortlabel, f.productclass,
           r.alpha5y, r.sharperatio3y, f.expensenet
    FROM funds f
    JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
    WHERE f.productclass IS NOT NULL
      AND r.alpha5y IS NOT NULL
      AND r.sharperatio3y IS NOT NULL
      AND f.expensenet IS NOT NULL
      AND f.expensenet <> 0
), sc AS (
    SELECT *,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY productclass) AS cnt,
           ( PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY productclass ORDER BY alpha5y)
           + PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY productclass ORDER BY sharperatio3y)
           + PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY productclass ORDER BY 1.0 / expensenet)
           ) / 3.0 AS composite_score
    FROM base
), rk AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY productclass ORDER BY composite_score DESC, tickersym) AS rn
    FROM sc
    WHERE cnt >= 10
)
SELECT productclass, tickersym, shortlabel, composite_score
FROM rk
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.investmentref) AS focused_alpha_leader_count
FROM risk_metrics r
JOIN (
    SELECT productlink, MAX(weightpct) AS max_weight
    FROM sector_allocations
    GROUP BY productlink
) s ON s.productlink = r.investmentref
WHERE r.alpha5y > 0
  AND s.max_weight > 0.08;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.tickersym,
         NULLIF(p.r3y, 'NaN'::real)       AS r3y,
         NULLIF(p.benchr3y, 'NaN'::real)  AS b3y,
         NULLIF(NULLIF(r.volatility3y, 'NaN'::real), 0) AS vol,
         NULLIF(f.expensenet, 'NaN'::real)   AS en,
         NULLIF(f.benchmarkexp, 'NaN'::real) AS be
  FROM funds f
  JOIN performance p  ON p.productref = f.tickersym
  JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
), scored AS (
  SELECT tickersym,
         (r3y - b3y) / vol - (en - be) * 10 AS active_manager_value
  FROM base
  WHERE r3y IS NOT NULL AND b3y IS NOT NULL AND vol IS NOT NULL
    AND en IS NOT NULL AND be IS NOT NULL
), pct AS (
  SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE active_manager_value > 0) / COUNT(*) AS pct_positive_value
  FROM scored
)
SELECT s.tickersym, s.active_manager_value, p.pct_positive_value
FROM scored s
CROSS JOIN pct p
ORDER BY s.active_manager_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.tickersym) AS true_active_differentiator_count
FROM funds f
JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
WHERE f.turnoverratio > 0
  AND r.rsquared3y IS NOT NULL AND r.rsquared3y <> 'NaN' AND r.rsquared3y < 100
  AND r.volatility3y > 0 AND r.alpha3y <> 'NaN'
  AND (1 - r.rsquared3y / 100.0) / f.turnoverratio > 0.5
  AND r.alpha3y / (r.volatility3y * SQRT(1 - r.rsquared3y / 100.0)) > 0.2
  AND p.topweight > 0.08 AND p.topweight <> 'NaN';

SELECT listingvenue, SUM(vol3m::numeric * ma200::numeric) AS total_value_traded
FROM funds
WHERE listingvenue IS NOT NULL AND vol3m IS NOT NULL AND ma200 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY listingvenue
ORDER BY total_value_traded DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS contrarian_value_play_count
FROM funds f
JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
WHERE (p.high52w + p.highdelta - p.low52w) / NULLIF(p.high52w - p.low52w, 0) * 100 < 25
  AND f.turnoverratio < 0.3
  AND (f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp) < 0;

SELECT ROUND(SUM((f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp) * f.networth)::numeric, 2) AS total_wasted_fee_amount
FROM funds f
JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
WHERE r.rsquared3y > 90
  AND (f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp) > 0;

       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.sharperatio3y) AS median_sharpe_3y,

       NOW() AS last_refreshed

);

SELECT d.distregistry, d.haztype, d.affectedarea,
  ROUND(LEAST((s.foodtons * 1000) / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::numeric * 2, 0),
              s.water_liters / NULLIF((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected')::numeric * 3, 0))::numeric, 2) AS supply_sufficiency_days,
  ROUND(GREATEST(0, (d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric - s.shelter_units)::numeric, 2) AS shelter_gap
FROM disasterevents d
LEFT JOIN supplies s ON s.supply_dist_ref = d.distregistry
ORDER BY d.distregistry;

SELECT d.distregistry, d.affectedarea
FROM disasterevents d
LEFT JOIN humanresources h ON h.hrdistref = d.distregistry
WHERE (COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric,0)
     + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric,0)) > 100
   OR (h.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical')::numeric
      / NULLIF(COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric,0)
             + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric,0),0) < 0.01
ORDER BY d.distregistry;

WITH dsi AS (
  SELECT distregistry, affectedarea,
         0.6 * ( 10 * COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric, 0)
               +  3 * COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0)
               +  2 * COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::numeric, 0)
               +  1 * COALESCE((impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric, 0) )
       + 0.4 * ( ( COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::numeric, 0)
                 + COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::numeric, 0)
                 + COALESCE((impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::numeric, 0) ) / 3 ) AS dsi
  FROM disasterevents
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.coordopsref AS opsregistry, d.affectedarea, ROUND(d.dsi, 2) AS dsi
FROM coordinationandevaluation c
JOIN dsi d ON d.distregistry = c.coord_dist_ref
WHERE d.dsi > 15000
ORDER BY dsi DESC, opsregistry;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.fin_ops_ref, f.funding_state,
         REPLACE(REPLACE(f.budgetallotusd,'$',''),',','')::numeric AS budget,
         (COALESCE(f.ops_costs_usd,0) + COALESCE(f.transportcostsusd,0) + COALESCE(f.storage_costs_usd,0) + COALESCE(f.personnelcostsusd,0))::numeric AS total_cost,
         (CURRENT_DATE - o.ops_start_date) AS days_elapsed
  FROM financials f
  JOIN operations o ON o.opsregistry = f.fin_ops_ref
), r AS (
  SELECT fin_ops_ref, funding_state,
         (budget - total_cost) / NULLIF(total_cost / NULLIF(days_elapsed,0), 0) AS runway
  FROM f
)
SELECT fin_ops_ref AS opsregistry, funding_state, ROUND(runway, 1) AS budget_runway_days
FROM r
WHERE funding_state = 'Critical' AND runway < 7
ORDER BY runway;

WITH dsi AS (
  SELECT d.distregistry,
         0.6 * ( 10 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::numeric, 0)
               + 3 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::numeric, 0)
               + 2 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'missing')::numeric, 0)
               + 1 * COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'displaced')::numeric, 0))
       + 0.4 * ( (COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'infra_damage_pct')::numeric, 0)
                + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'power_outage_pct')::numeric, 0)
                + COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'infrastructure_damage'->>'water_damage_pct')::numeric, 0)) / 3 ) AS dsi
  FROM disasterevents d
),
hub_dsi AS (
  SELECT t.transport_hub_ref AS hubregistry, AVG(s.dsi) AS avg_dsi_served
  FROM transportation t
  JOIN dsi s ON s.distregistry = t.transportdistref
  GROUP BY t.transport_hub_ref
),
hsi AS (
  SELECT h.hubregistry,
         0.5 * ((h.hubutilpct::numeric / 100) + (h.stockturnrate::numeric / 10)) + 0.5 * hd.avg_dsi_served AS hsi
  FROM distributionhubs h
  JOIN hub_dsi hd ON hd.hubregistry = h.hubregistry
)
SELECT hubregistry,
       ROUND(hsi, 2) AS hub_strain_index,
       CASE WHEN hsi > 1000000 THEN 'Overwhelmed' ELSE 'Normal' END AS hub_status
FROM hsi
ORDER BY hsi DESC;

SELECT o.opsregistry, d.affectedarea,
ROUND((((10 - CASE lower(o.priority_rank::text) WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 END) * 0.5)
 + ((COALESCE((h.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'total')::numeric,0) + COALESCE((h.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'volunteers')::numeric,0)) * 0.2)
 + (CASE lower(d.impact_summary->'communication_and_transport'->>'transport_access') WHEN 'minimal' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'limited' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END * 30))::numeric, 2) AS gridlock_severity_index
FROM operations o
JOIN humanresources h ON h.hr_ops_ref = o.opsregistry
JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = h.hrdistref
WHERE lower(o.supply_flow_state) = 'disrupted'
  AND lower(d.impact_summary->'communication_and_transport'->>'transport_access') = 'minimal'
ORDER BY gridlock_severity_index DESC;

WITH scored AS (
    SELECT o.opsregistry,
           0.4 * (t.delivery_metrics->'delivery_performance'->>'success_rate')::numeric
         + 0.3 * b.bene_feedbackscore * 10
         + 0.3 * b.distequityidx * 100 AS res,
           (c.report_compliance + c.stakeholder_satisf * 20 + c.dataqualityvalue * 20) / 3.0 AS cqi
    FROM operations o

    JOIN coordinationandevaluation c ON c.coordopsref = o.opsregistry

    JOIN transportation t ON t.transportdistref = b.bene_dist_ref
)
SELECT opsregistry, res, cqi
FROM scored
WHERE res > 75 AND cqi > 75
ORDER BY res DESC, cqi DESC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG((t.delivery_metrics->'vehicle_metrics'->>'break_rate')::numeric), 1) AS avg_breakdown_rate_pct
FROM transportation t
JOIN disasterevents d ON t.transportdistref = d.distregistry

SELECT lower(d.region_tag) AS region,
       ROUND(AVG((c.report_compliance + c.stakeholder_satisf * 20 + c.dataqualityvalue * 20) / 3.0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_cqi,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.distregistry) AS disaster_count
FROM disasterevents d

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION check_financial_red_flags()
RETURNS TABLE (opsregistry varchar, alert_type text, alert_message text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH op_fin AS (
    SELECT o.opsregistry AS ops_id,
           f.funding_state,
           REPLACE(REPLACE(f.budgetallotusd, '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric AS budget,
           (COALESCE(f.ops_costs_usd, 0) + COALESCE(f.transportcostsusd, 0)
            + COALESCE(f.storage_costs_usd, 0) + COALESCE(f.personnelcostsusd, 0))::numeric AS total_costs,
           (CURRENT_DATE - o.ops_start_date) AS days_elapsed
    FROM operations o
    JOIN financials f ON f.fin_ops_ref = o.opsregistry
    WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Active'
  ),
  metrics AS (
    SELECT ops_id, funding_state, budget, total_costs,
           total_costs / NULLIF(days_elapsed, 0) AS burn_rate          -- Financial Burn Rate
    FROM op_fin
  ),
  runway AS (
    SELECT m.*,
           (m.budget - m.total_costs) / NULLIF(m.burn_rate, 0) AS runway_days   -- Budget Runway
    FROM metrics m
  )
  SELECT r.ops_id, 'High Burn Rate'::text,
         format('Spent %s of %s USD (%s%% of budget)', r.total_costs, r.budget,
                ROUND(r.total_costs / NULLIF(r.budget, 0) * 100, 2))
  FROM runway r
  WHERE r.total_costs > 0.2 * r.budget
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.ops_id, 'Funding Crisis'::text,
         format('Funding state Critical; budget runway %s days', ROUND(r.runway_days, 2))
  FROM runway r
  WHERE r.funding_state = 'Critical' AND r.runway_days < 7;
END;
$$;

WITH h AS (
  SELECT h.housenum,
         initcap(regexp_replace(trim(h.locregion),'\s+',' ','g')) AS region,
         CASE WHEN lower(trim(st.socsupport)) = 'yes'

  FROM households
), best AS (

  FROM h

SELECT DISTINCT h.housenum
FROM households h
JOIN service_types st ON st.serviceref = h.serviceplan
JOIN transportation_assets ta ON ta.housetag = h.housenum

ORDER BY housenum

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.loczone = 1)

FROM households h
JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
WHERE (p.dwelling_specs->>'Room_Count')::numeric > 0

SELECT ROUND(AVG((ta.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count')::numeric
              + (ta.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Bike_Count')::numeric
              + (ta.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Motor_Count')::numeric), 2) AS avg_vehicle_ownership

JOIN transportation_assets ta ON ta.housetag = h.housenum

WITH house_scores AS (
  SELECT initcap(regexp_replace(lower(trim(h.locregion)), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS region,
         ( CASE WHEN lower(trim(i.wateraccess)) LIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN lower(i.roadsurface) ~ 'asphalt|concrete' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN regexp_replace(lower(trim(i.parkavail)), '\s+', ' ', 'g') = 'available' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
         ) / 3.0 AS infra_score
  FROM households h
  JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
  JOIN infrastructure i ON i.infraref = p.infralink
), region_avg AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(infra_score) AS avg_score
  FROM house_scores
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT (SELECT region FROM region_avg ORDER BY avg_score DESC, region LIMIT 1)
       || ' | ' ||
       (SELECT region FROM region_avg ORDER BY avg_score ASC, region LIMIT 1) AS result;

WITH hs AS (
  SELECT initcap(lower(regexp_replace(trim(h.locregion), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) AS region,
         ( CASE WHEN lower(regexp_replace(trim(i.wateraccess), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) LIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN lower(i.roadsurface) LIKE '%asphalt%' OR lower(i.roadsurface) LIKE '%concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN lower(regexp_replace(trim(i.parkavail), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) = 'available' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END
         ) / 3.0 AS infra_score
  FROM households h
  JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
  JOIN infrastructure i ON i.infraref = p.infralink
), reg AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(infra_score) AS avg_score FROM hs GROUP BY region
)
SELECT (SELECT region FROM reg ORDER BY avg_score DESC, region LIMIT 1)
       || ' | ' ||
       (SELECT region FROM reg ORDER BY avg_score ASC, region LIMIT 1) AS result;

WITH high_tech_mobile AS (
