         initcap(regexp_replace(lower(trim(h.locregion)),'\s+',' ','g')) AS region
  FROM households h
  JOIN transportation_assets t ON t.housetag = h.housenum
  JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
  JOIN amenities a ON a.houseid = h.housenum
  WHERE COALESCE((t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count')::int,0)
      + COALESCE((t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Bike_Count')::int,0)
      + COALESCE((t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Motor_Count')::int,0) > 2
    AND regexp_replace(lower(trim(t.vehicleinventory->>'Newest_Year')),'\s+',' ','g') IN
        ('05-09','10-13','2005-2009','2005 to 2009','2010-2013','2010 to 2013',
         '2014+','2014 and newer','2014 or newer','after 2014')
    AND regexp_replace(lower(trim(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')),'\s+',' ','g') IN
        ('brickwork house','brick house','apartment','apt','condominium','condo')
    AND regexp_replace(lower(trim(a.cablestatus)),'\s+',' ','g') IN ('avail','available','yes','y','have')
)
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS family_count
FROM high_tech_mobile
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY family_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT h.housenum,
    CASE lower(regexp_replace(trim(h.socioeconomic->>'Income_Bracket'), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))
      WHEN 'has no income' THEN 1
      WHEN 'r$ 440 or less' THEN 2
      WHEN 'more than r$ 440 and less than r$ 880' THEN 3
      WHEN 'more than r$ 880 and less than r$ 1,760' THEN 4
      WHEN 'more than r$ 1,760 and less than r$ 2,640' THEN 5
      WHEN 'more than r$ 2,640 and less than r$ 4,400' THEN 6
      WHEN 'more than r$ 4,400 and less than r$ 8,800' THEN 7
      WHEN 'more than r$ 8,800 and less than r$ 13,200' THEN 8
      WHEN 'more than r$ 13,200 and less than r$ 17,600' THEN 9
      WHEN 'more than r$ 17,600 and less than r$ 22,000' THEN 10
      WHEN 'more than r$ 22,000 and less than r$ 26,400' THEN 11
      WHEN 'more than r$ 26,400' THEN 12
    END AS income_score,
    (h.socioeconomic->>'Expend_Coeff')::numeric AS expend_coeff,
    CASE WHEN lower(trim(h.socioeconomic->>'Tenure_Type')) IN ('owned', 'own') THEN 3
         WHEN lower(trim(h.socioeconomic->>'Tenure_Type')) IN ('rented', 'rent') THEN 2
         ELSE 1 END AS tenure_score
  FROM households h
),
scored AS (
  SELECT housenum,
         0.4 * income_score + 0.3 * tenure_score - 0.3 * (expend_coeff / income_score) AS socioeconomic_index
  FROM base
  WHERE income_score IS NOT NULL AND expend_coeff IS NOT NULL
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT housenum FROM scored ORDER BY socioeconomic_index DESC, housenum LIMIT 10
),
garage AS (
  SELECT t.housenum,
         COALESCE(bool_or(lower(regexp_replace(trim(i.parkavail), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) = 'available'), false) AS has_garage
  FROM top10 t
  LEFT JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = t.housenum
  LEFT JOIN infrastructure i ON i.infraref = p.infralink
  GROUP BY t.housenum
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_garage) / COUNT(*), 2) AS garage_percentage
FROM garage;

WITH r AS (
  SELECT lower(regexp_replace(trim(h.locregion), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS region_key,
         trim(h.locregion) AS region_raw,
         CASE WHEN trim(s.socsupport) = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported
  FROM households h
  LEFT JOIN service_types s ON s.serviceref = h.serviceplan
)
SELECT mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY region_raw) AS region,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(supported) / COUNT(*), 2) AS support_percentage
FROM r
GROUP BY region_key
ORDER BY support_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT h.housenum,
         (h.socioeconomic->>'Expend_Coeff')::numeric AS expend_coeff,
         CASE lower(regexp_replace(trim(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class'),'\s+',' ','g'))
              WHEN 'apt' THEN 'apartment'
              WHEN 'brick house' THEN 'brickwork house'
              ELSE lower(regexp_replace(trim(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class'),'\s+',' ','g')) END AS dwelling_type,
         COALESCE((t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count')::int,0)
       + COALESCE((t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Bike_Count')::int,0)
       + COALESCE((t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Motor_Count')::int,0) AS vehicles
  FROM households h
  JOIN service_types s ON s.serviceref = h.serviceplan
  JOIN transportation_assets t ON t.housetag = h.housenum
  JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
  WHERE lower(regexp_replace(trim(s.socsupport),'\s+',' ','g')) = 'no'
    AND lower(regexp_replace(trim(s.domestichelp),'\s+',' ','g')) = 'no domestic workers'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE vehicles > 1
),
top_type AS (
  SELECT dwelling_type
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY dwelling_type
  ORDER BY AVG(expend_coeff) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT f.dwelling_type, SUM(f.vehicles) AS total_vehicles
FROM filtered f
JOIN top_type tt USING (dwelling_type)
GROUP BY f.dwelling_type;

WITH h AS (
  SELECT initcap(regexp_replace(lower(trim(h.locregion)), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS region,
         CASE WHEN trim(st.socsupport) = 'Yes'
               AND h.residentcount::numeric / NULLIF((p.dwelling_specs->>'Room_Count')::numeric, 0) > 4
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS at_risk
  FROM households h
  LEFT JOIN service_types st ON st.serviceref = h.serviceplan
  LEFT JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
), r AS (
  SELECT region, 100.0 * SUM(at_risk) / COUNT(*) AS at_risk_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT region
FROM r
ORDER BY at_risk_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT h.housenum,
         (h.socioeconomic->>'Expend_Coeff')::numeric AS expend_coeff,
         (p.dwelling_specs->>'Bath_Count')::numeric / NULLIF(h.residentcount, 0) AS bathroom_ratio,
         CASE
           WHEN regexp_replace(lower(trim(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')), '\s+', ' ', 'g') IN ('brickwork house', 'brick house') THEN 4
           WHEN regexp_replace(lower(trim(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')), '\s+', ' ', 'g') IN ('apartment', 'apt') THEN 3
           ELSE 1
         END AS dwelling_score,
         ( (CASE WHEN lower(trim(i.wateraccess)) LIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END)
         + (CASE WHEN lower(i.roadsurface) LIKE '%asphalt%' OR lower(i.roadsurface) LIKE '%concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END)
         + (CASE WHEN regexp_replace(lower(trim(i.parkavail)), '\s+', ' ', 'g') = 'available' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END)
         ) / 3.0 AS infra_score
  FROM households h
  JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
  JOIN infrastructure i ON i.infraref = p.infralink
),
comfortable AS (
  SELECT housenum, expend_coeff
  FROM base
  WHERE 0.5 * dwelling_score + 0.5 * infra_score > 3
    AND bathroom_ratio > 0.5
)
SELECT housenum
FROM comfortable
ORDER BY expend_coeff DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS affluent_household_count
FROM households
WHERE locregion = 'Taguatinga'
  AND socioeconomic->>'Tenure_Type' = 'OWNED'
  AND socioeconomic->>'Income_Bracket' IN ('High Income', 'Very High Income');

SELECT h.housenum,
       (t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count')::int AS auto_count
FROM households h

WHERE h.loczone = 1

SELECT h.housenum

WHERE lower(regexp_replace(trim(h.locregion), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) = 'guará'

  AND lower(regexp_replace(trim(a.cablestatus), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) IN ('avail', 'available', 'yes')

WITH norm AS (
  SELECT h.housenum, h.serviceplan, h.locregion,
         LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(h.locregion), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS region_key
  FROM households h
), names AS (

SELECT nm.region, COUNT(*) AS supported_households
FROM norm n
JOIN service_types s ON n.serviceplan = s.serviceref
JOIN names nm ON nm.region_key = n.region_key

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.socioeconomic->>'Income_Bracket' IS NULL)::numeric * 100
         / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct
  FROM transportation_assets t
  JOIN households h ON h.housenum = t.housetag
), del AS (
  DELETE FROM transportation_assets t
  USING households h, stats s
  WHERE h.housenum = t.housetag
    AND h.socioeconomic->>'Income_Bracket' IS NULL
    AND s.pct < 5

SELECT COUNT(*) AS deleted_count FROM del;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT a.amenityref
  FROM amenities a
  JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = a.houseid
  WHERE lower(trim(regexp_replace(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class','\s+',' ','g')))
          IN ('brickwork house','brick house','apartment','apt')
    AND lower(trim(regexp_replace(a.cablestatus,'\s+',' ','g')))
          NOT IN ('avail','available','yes','y','have')
),
budget AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n, count(*) * 75 AS cost FROM eligible
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE amenities a
  SET cablestatus = 'Subscribed'
  FROM eligible e, budget b
  WHERE a.amenityref = e.amenityref

  RETURNING a.amenityref

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) AS homes_upgraded;

SELECT ROUND(AVG((pp.massjup * 317.83) / POWER(pp.radjup * 11.209, 2))::numeric, 2) AS avg_surface_gravity
FROM planets p

WITH premium AS (

  JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
  JOIN infrastructure i ON i.infraref = p.infralink
  WHERE lower(trim(h.socioeconomic->>'Tenure_Type')) IN ('own','owned')
    AND lower(regexp_replace(trim(h.socioeconomic->>'Income_Bracket'),'\s+',' ','g')) IN (
        'more than r$ 8,800 and less than r$ 13,200',
        'more than r$ 13,200 and less than r$ 17,600',
        'more than r$ 17,600 and less than r$ 22,000',
        'more than r$ 22,000 and less than r$ 26,400',
        'more than r$ 26,400')
    AND lower(regexp_replace(trim(i.wateraccess),'\s+',' ','g')) LIKE 'yes, available%'
    AND lower(regexp_replace(trim(i.roadsurface),'\s+',' ','g')) LIKE 'asphalt%'
    AND (p.dwelling_specs->>'Room_Count')::numeric > 0
    AND h.residentcount / (p.dwelling_specs->>'Room_Count')::numeric <= 2
)
SELECT 'Cost: $' || (COUNT(*) * 150) || ', Budget Status: ' ||
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) * 150 <= 5000 THEN 'Within Budget' ELSE 'Over Budget' END AS summary
FROM premium;

SELECT hostplname
FROM stars
WHERE stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value' IS NOT NULL
  AND (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric > 0
ORDER BY ((stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric * 1.98847E30)
         / ((4.0/3.0) * pi()::numeric * power((stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric * 6.957E8, 3)) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH outer_p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.stellarref) s.stellarref, s.hostplname,
         (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::real AS official_mass,
         o.semimajor, o.period
  FROM stars s
  JOIN planets p ON p.hostlink = s.stellarref
  JOIN orbital_characteristics o ON o.bodylink = p.planetref
  WHERE s.compcount > 1 AND o.semimajor IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY s.stellarref, o.semimajor DESC
)
SELECT hostplname, official_mass,
       power(semimajor, 3) / power(period / 365.25, 2) AS calculated_mass
FROM outer_p
WHERE period IS NOT NULL AND period > 0
ORDER BY abs(power(semimajor, 3) / power(period / 365.25, 2) - official_mass) NULLS LAST;

SELECT s.hostplname || ' ' || p.completter AS planet_name,
       o.period,
       o.inclination,
       SQRT(6.674e-11 * (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric * 1.989e30
            / (o.semimajor * 1.496e11)) / 1000 AS orbital_velocity_km_s
FROM planets p
JOIN orbital_characteristics o ON o.bodylink = p.planetref
JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
WHERE pp.massjup > 0.1
  AND o.period < 10
  AND o.inclination > 90
  AND s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value' IS NOT NULL
  AND o.semimajor IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY orbital_velocity_km_s DESC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(
         (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value')::float
         * SQRT( ((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::float * 6.957E8)
                 / (2 * oc.semimajor * 1.496E11) )
       )::numeric, 0) AS avg_equilibrium_temperature_k
FROM planets p
JOIN planet_instrument_observations o ON o.subjectlink = p.planetref
JOIN instruments_surveys i ON i.instrumentref = o.facilitylink
JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
JOIN orbital_characteristics oc ON oc.bodylink = p.planetref
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
WHERE LOWER(i.facilityname) = 'k2'
  AND pp.massjup > 0.1
  AND (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value')::float > 0
  AND (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::float > 0
  AND oc.semimajor > 0;

SELECT
    ROUND((100 * POWER(
        (pp.radjup * 11.209) /
        ((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric * 109.2), 2))::numeric, 4) AS max_transit_depth_pct,
    s.hostplname || ' ' || p.completter AS planet_name,
    s.hostplname AS star_name
FROM planets p
JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
WHERE LOWER(p.discmethod) IN ('radvel', 'rv', 'rv method', 'radial velocity', 'doppler')
  AND pp.radjup IS NOT NULL
  AND (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric > 0
ORDER BY max_transit_depth_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.hostplname || ' ' || p.completter AS planet_name,
       s.hostplname AS star_name,
       o.eccentricity,
       ROUND(((ph.massjup * 1.898E27) /
              ((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric * 1.98847E30))::numeric, 5) AS planet_star_mass_ratio
FROM planets p
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
JOIN orbital_characteristics o ON o.bodylink = p.planetref
JOIN physical_properties ph ON ph.objectlink = p.planetref
JOIN data_quality_tracking d ON d.targetlink = p.planetref
WHERE o.eccentricity > 0.25
  AND d.masssource ILIKE '%msini%'
  AND ph.massjup IS NOT NULL
  AND (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric > 0
ORDER BY planet_star_mass_ratio;

WITH se AS (
  SELECT p.planetref,
         pp.massjup * 317.83 AS mass_earth,
         pp.radjup * 11.209 AS rad_earth,
         (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric AS star_mass
  FROM planets p
  JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
  JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
  WHERE pp.massjup IS NOT NULL AND pp.radjup IS NOT NULL AND pp.densvalue IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.densvalue > 3
    AND pp.massjup * 317.83 BETWEEN 1 AND 10
), top AS (
  SELECT * FROM se
  ORDER BY mass_earth / power(rad_earth, 2) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT planetref,
       to_char(mass_earth / (star_mass * 332946), '9.999999EEEE') AS planet_star_mass_ratio
FROM top
WHERE star_mass IS NOT NULL AND star_mass > 0;

WITH pp AS (
  SELECT s.stellarref, s.hostplname, o.period,
         LAG(o.period) OVER (PARTITION BY s.stellarref ORDER BY o.period) AS prev_period,
         MIN(o.period) OVER (PARTITION BY s.stellarref) AS min_period
  FROM stars s
  JOIN planets p ON p.hostlink = s.stellarref
  JOIN orbital_characteristics o ON o.bodylink = p.planetref
  WHERE o.period IS NOT NULL AND s.compcount > 1
), r AS (
  SELECT stellarref, hostplname, min_period, period / prev_period AS ratio
  FROM pp
  WHERE prev_period IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT hostplname,
       ROUND(EXP(AVG(LN(ratio)))::numeric, 3) AS avg_period_ratio
FROM r
GROUP BY stellarref, hostplname, min_period
HAVING MAX(ratio) < 3 AND min_period < 10
ORDER BY avg_period_ratio DESC;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.stellarref, s.stellardist
  FROM planets p
  JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
  JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
  JOIN data_quality_tracking d ON d.targetlink = p.planetref
  WHERE pp.massjup > 0.1
    AND pp.densvalue < 0.5
    AND (d.limitflags->'stellar_limits'->>'Dist_Lim')::int = 0
    AND (s.stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Mag_Blend')::int = 0
    AND s.stellardist IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(stellardist * 3.26156)::numeric, 2) AS avg_distance_ly
FROM s;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.hostlink)
FROM planets p
JOIN planet_instrument_observations o ON o.subjectlink = p.planetref
JOIN instruments_surveys i ON i.instrumentref = o.facilitylink
WHERE LOWER(i.facilityname) = 'ttv';

SELECT ROUND(sqrt(2*6.674e-11*(massjup*317.83*5.972e24)/(radjup*11.209*6.371e6))/1000) AS escape_velocity_km_s
FROM physical_properties
WHERE massjup IS NOT NULL AND radjup IS NOT NULL AND radjup <> 0 AND massjup <> 'NaN' AND radjup <> 'NaN'
ORDER BY (massjup*317.83)/(radjup*11.209) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CASE
         WHEN lower(stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Photo_Band') IN ('v (johnson)','johnson','v','johnson v','v-band') THEN 'v-band'
         WHEN lower(stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Photo_Band') IN ('kepler-band','kepler','kep-b','kep') THEN 'kepler-band'
       END AS filter_band,
       count(DISTINCT stellarref) AS star_count
FROM stars
WHERE lower(stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Photo_Band') IN ('v (johnson)','johnson','v','johnson v','v-band','kepler-band','kepler','kep-b','kep')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY star_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.planetref) AS kepler_planets_blended_temp
FROM planets p
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
JOIN planet_instrument_observations o ON o.subjectlink = p.planetref
JOIN instruments_surveys i ON i.instrumentref = o.facilitylink
WHERE i.facilityname = 'kep'
  AND (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Blend')::numeric = 1;

SELECT
    (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value')::numeric AS temperature,
    ROUND(
        (POWER((stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric, 2)
         * POWER((stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value')::numeric / 5778, 4))::numeric,
        3
    ) AS luminosity
FROM stars
WHERE LOWER(hostplname) = LOWER('55 cnc');

WITH pl AS (
  SELECT p.hostlink, pp.massjup, pp.densvalue
  FROM planets p
  JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
  WHERE pp.densvalue IS NOT NULL OR pp.massjup IS NOT NULL
),
st AS (
  SELECT hostlink
  FROM pl
  GROUP BY hostlink
  HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE densvalue > 3)
     AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE massjup > 0.1) = 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(
         POWER((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric, 2) *
         POWER((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value')::numeric / 5778, 4)
       ), 4) AS avg_luminosity
FROM st
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = st.hostlink
WHERE s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value' IS NOT NULL
  AND s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value' IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.completter,
       s.hostplname,
       ROUND(((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value')::numeric
              * SQRT(((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric * 6.957E8)
                     / (2 * oc.semimajor::numeric * 1.496E11)))) AS equilibrium_temp_k
FROM planets p
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
JOIN orbital_characteristics oc ON oc.bodylink = p.planetref
LEFT JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
WHERE s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value' IS NOT NULL
  AND s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value' IS NOT NULL
  AND oc.semimajor IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (COALESCE(pp.massjup > 0.1, FALSE) AND COALESCE(oc.period < 10, FALSE))
ORDER BY equilibrium_temp_k DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT stellarref,
       trim(to_char(6.67430E-11 * (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric * 1.98847E30, '9.99EEEE')) AS gravitational_parameter
FROM stars
WHERE stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Opt_Mag' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Opt_Mag')::numeric ASC
LIMIT 1;

CREATE VIEW v_discovery_method_summary AS
SELECT
    planetref,
    discmethod,
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(discmethod) IN ('radvel', 'rv', 'rv method', 'radial velocity', 'doppler') THEN 'Radial Velocity'
        WHEN LOWER(discmethod) IN ('transit', 'tr', 'transit method', 'photometry', 'photometric') THEN 'Transit'
        WHEN LOWER(discmethod) IN ('direct imaging', 'di', 'imaging', 'img', 'direct') THEN 'Imaging'
        WHEN LOWER(discmethod) IN ('ttv', 'transit timing variations', 'transit timing', 'ttv method', 'timing var') THEN 'TTV'
        WHEN LOWER(discmethod) IN ('microlensing', 'ml', 'μlens', 'lensing', 'gravitational') THEN 'Microlensing'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS standardized_method
FROM planets;

CREATE VIEW v_system_overview AS
SELECT s.hostplname,
       (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::real AS stellar_radius,
       (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value')::real AS stellar_temperature,
       COUNT(p.planetref) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(p.discmethod) IN ('radvel','rv','rv method','radial velocity','doppler')) AS rv_planet_count,
       COUNT(p.planetref) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(p.discmethod) IN ('transit','tr','transit method','photometry','photometric')) AS transit_planet_count
FROM stars s
LEFT JOIN planets p ON p.hostlink = s.stellarref
GROUP BY s.stellarref, s.hostplname, s.stellarprops;

CREATE TABLE star_classifications (
    stellarref bigint REFERENCES stars(stellarref),
    mass_class text
);

INSERT INTO star_classifications (stellarref, mass_class)
SELECT stellarref,
       CASE WHEN (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::real > 3   THEN 'massive'
            WHEN (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::real > 1.5 THEN 'intermediate'
            WHEN (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::real >= 0.8 THEN 'sun-like'
            ELSE 'low-mass' END
FROM stars
WHERE stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value' IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE planet_types (
  planetref bigint,
  planet_type text
);

INSERT INTO planet_types (planetref, planet_type)
SELECT p.planetref,
       CASE
         WHEN pp.massjup > 0.1 AND oc.period < 10 THEN 'hot jupiter'
         WHEN pp.densvalue > 3 AND pp.massjup * 317.83 BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'super-earth'
         WHEN pp.densvalue > 3 THEN 'rocky'
         WHEN pp.massjup > 0.1 THEN 'gas giant'
         ELSE 'unknown'
       END
FROM planets p
LEFT JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
LEFT JOIN orbital_characteristics oc ON oc.bodylink = p.planetref;

CREATE TABLE high_precision_params (
  planetlink bigint REFERENCES planets(planetref),
  high_precision_mass boolean,
  high_precision_radius boolean,
  high_precision_period boolean
);

INSERT INTO high_precision_params (planetlink, high_precision_mass, high_precision_radius, high_precision_period)
SELECT p.planetref,
  COALESCE(((q.masserr1 - q.masserr2) / 2.0) / NULLIF(pp.massjup, 0) * 100 < 5, false),
  COALESCE(((q.raderr1 - q.raderr2) / 2.0) / NULLIF(pp.radjup, 0) * 100 < 5, false),
  COALESCE(((q.perioderr1 - q.perioderr2) / 2.0) / NULLIF(oc.period, 0) * 100 < 5, false)
FROM planets p
JOIN data_quality_tracking q ON q.targetlink = p.planetref
LEFT JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
LEFT JOIN orbital_characteristics oc ON oc.bodylink = p.planetref
WHERE (q.masserr1 IS NOT NULL AND q.masserr2 IS NOT NULL AND pp.massjup IS NOT NULL AND pp.massjup <> 0)
   OR (q.raderr1 IS NOT NULL AND q.raderr2 IS NOT NULL AND pp.radjup IS NOT NULL AND pp.radjup <> 0)
   OR (q.perioderr1 IS NOT NULL AND q.perioderr2 IS NOT NULL AND oc.period IS NOT NULL AND oc.period <> 0);

CREATE VIEW v_uncertain_measurements AS
SELECT s.hostplname || ' ' || p.completter AS planet_name,
       s.hostplname AS host_star,
       CASE WHEN (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Blend')::numeric = 1 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS mass_blended,
       CASE WHEN (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Rad_Blend')::numeric = 1 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS radius_blended,
       CASE WHEN (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Blend')::numeric = 1 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS temp_blended
FROM planets p
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
WHERE (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Blend')::numeric = 1
   OR (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Rad_Blend')::numeric = 1
   OR (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Blend')::numeric = 1;

CREATE TABLE system_period_ratios AS
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT s.stellarref,
         o.period,
         LEAD(o.period) OVER (PARTITION BY s.stellarref ORDER BY o.period, p.planetref) AS next_period
  FROM stars s
  JOIN planets p ON p.hostlink = s.stellarref
  JOIN orbital_characteristics o ON o.bodylink = p.planetref
  WHERE s.compcount > 1
    AND o.period IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT stellarref,
       period AS inner_period,
       next_period AS outer_period,
       next_period / period AS period_ratio
FROM ordered
WHERE next_period IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c."ARTregID",
       c.art_title,
       r.risk_level,
       ar."HIST_sign",
       (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int AS cultural_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" c
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ar."ART_link" = c."ARTregID"
JOIN "RiskAssessments" r ON r.art_concern = c."ARTregID"
WHERE ar."HIST_sign" > 8
  AND (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int > 20
  AND r.risk_level IN ('High', 'Medium');

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW v_discovery_stats AS
WITH pcs AS (
  SELECT planet_ref, MAX("LAST_UPDATED") AS last_updated
  FROM "PlanetCharacterizationSummary"
  GROUP BY planet_ref
)
SELECT LOWER(TRIM(p.discmethod)) AS discovery_method,
       COUNT(p.planetref) AS planet_count,
       ROUND(AVG(s.stellardist * 3.26156) FILTER (WHERE s.stellardist IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 2) AS avg_distance_ly,
       MAX(pcs.last_updated) AS last_updated
FROM planets p
LEFT JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
LEFT JOIN pcs ON pcs.planet_ref = p.planetref
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(p.discmethod));

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS art_id, k.key AS sensitivity, k.value AS rating
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') k
),
erf AS (
  SELECT art_id,
         AVG(CASE rating WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf,
         string_agg(CASE WHEN rating = 'High' THEN sensitivity END, ', ' ORDER BY sensitivity) AS high_sensitivities
  FROM sens
  GROUP BY art_id
)
SELECT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, e.erf, e.high_sensitivities
FROM erf e
JOIN "ArtifactsCore" a ON a."ARTregID" = e.art_id
WHERE e.erf > 4
ORDER BY e.erf DESC;

WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT c."ARTregID", c.art_title, c."DYNASTY",
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE c.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                                         WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" c
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = c."ARTregID"
  WHERE c."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming', 'Qing')
)
SELECT "ARTregID", art_title, "DYNASTY", cpi_score,
       CASE WHEN cpi_score > 7 THEN 'High Priority'
            WHEN cpi_score > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority'
            ELSE 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level
FROM cpi
ORDER BY cpi_score DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT DISTINCT case_link
FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
WHERE "tempVar24" > 1 OR "RHvar" > 3
ORDER BY case_link;

SELECT a."ARTregID", a."DYNASTY",
  ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
   * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi,
  cm.budget_alloc,
  CASE WHEN cm.budget_alloc = 'Adequate' THEN 'Sufficient' ELSE 'Insufficient' END AS budget_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm ON cm.monitor_link = l.env_link
ORDER BY a."DYNASTY", cpi DESC;

WITH latest_env AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ca.art_exam) ca.art_exam, e."TEMPc", e."RH"
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" ca
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = ca.case_exam
  ORDER BY ca.art_exam, e."readTS" DESC
),
sens AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link",
         AVG(CASE v.val WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.val = 'High') AS high_cnt
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS v(k, val)
  GROUP BY s."ART_link"
)
SELECT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, le."TEMPc" AS current_temp, le."RH" AS current_humidity,
       COALESCE(se.high_cnt, 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
       CASE WHEN a."ageYears" * se.erf * power(le."RH" - 50, 2) * le."TEMPc" / 100000.0 > 5
             AND COALESCE(se.high_cnt, 0) >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
LEFT JOIN latest_env le ON le.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN sens se ON se."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
ORDER BY a."ARTregID";

SELECT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, a."MatKind",
       s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' AS humidity_sensitivity,
       CASE WHEN (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'High'   AND e."RH" > 55)
              OR (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'Medium' AND e."RH" > 60)
            THEN 'Over Exposure' ELSE 'Within Limits' END AS exposure_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" c ON c.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = c.case_exam
WHERE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' IN ('Medium','High')
ORDER BY a."ARTregID";

SELECT DISTINCT sc."caseID"
FROM "Showcases" sc
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = sc."caseID"
WHERE 10 - ((NULLIF(e."tempVar24", 'NaN')::numeric + e."RHvar"::numeric / 5
       + (sc.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric) / 3) < 5
   OR ( CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) >= 3
ORDER BY sc."caseID";

WITH r AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::int AS year, "TEMPc"
  FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS") IN (2023, 2024, 2025)
    AND "TEMPc" IS NOT NULL
), a AS (
  SELECT year, AVG("TEMPc") AS avg_temp
  FROM r
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT a.year,
       a.avg_temp,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(r."TEMPc" - a.avg_temp) > 0
                          AND ABS(r."TEMPc" - a.avg_temp) <= 4) AS anomaly_days
FROM a
JOIN r ON r.year = a.year
GROUP BY a.year, a.avg_temp
ORDER BY a.year;

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS art,
         (SELECT AVG(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS x(k, v)) AS erf,
         CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS light_w
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
), scores AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID",
         se.erf
         + (l.lux * se.light_w * l."visLxh") / 1000.0
         + 2 * (a."ageYears" * se.erf * power(e."RH" - 50, 2) * e."TEMPc") / 100000.0 AS tetl
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN sens se ON se.art = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
)
SELECT s."ARTregID", s.tetl
FROM scores s
JOIN "RiskAssessments" r ON r.art_concern = s."ARTregID"
WHERE r.risk_level = 'Medium'
ORDER BY s.tetl DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH case_temp AS (
  SELECT s."caseID", s.hall_ref, AVG(e."TEMPc") AS avg_temp
  FROM "Showcases" s
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = s."caseID"
  GROUP BY s."caseID", s.hall_ref
), cmp AS (
  SELECT c."caseID", c.hall_ref, c.avg_temp,
         (SELECT AVG(o.avg_temp)
          FROM case_temp o
          WHERE o.hall_ref = c.hall_ref AND o."caseID" <> c."caseID") AS hall_avg
  FROM case_temp c
)
SELECT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, a."MatKind",
       cmp.avg_temp AS showcase_temp,
       cmp.hall_avg AS hall_avg_temp,
       ABS(cmp.avg_temp - cmp.hall_avg) AS temp_deviation
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN cmp ON cmp."caseID" = ca.case_exam
WHERE (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric > 80
  AND ABS(cmp.avg_temp - cmp.hall_avg) > 1
ORDER BY temp_deviation DESC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID",
         a.art_title,
         a."MatKind",
         u."displayMonths",
         CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS light_w,
         CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS temp_w,
         CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS hum_w,
         lr.lux,
         lr."visLxh",
         r."HIST_sign",
         (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric AS research_score,
         (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric AS cultural_score,
         CASE a.conserve_status
              WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
              WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END AS status_val
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" lr ON lr.rad_id = ca.light_link
  JOIN "UsageRecords" u ON u.env_link = lr.env_link
  JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE u.rotate_sched = 'Resting'
), calc AS (
  SELECT *,
         36.0 * (10 - light_w) * (10 - temp_w) * (10 - hum_w) / 1000 AS dsd,
         lux * light_w * "visLxh" / 1000.0 AS ler,
         ("HIST_sign" + research_score + cultural_score) * (10 - status_val) / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM base
), scored AS (
  SELECT *, (dsd - "displayMonths") * (ler + 1) * (cpi + 1) / 100 AS erps
  FROM calc
)
SELECT "ARTregID",
       art_title,
       "MatKind",
       "displayMonths",
       dsd AS display_safety_duration,
       erps AS exhibition_rotation_priority_score,
       CASE WHEN erps < 0 THEN 'Immediate Rotation' ELSE 'Monitor' END AS rotation_recommendation
FROM scored
ORDER BY erps;

SELECT a."ARTregID",
       a.art_title,
       ((r."HIST_sign"
         + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric
         + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
        * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status
                  WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                  WHEN 'Good'      THEN 3
                  WHEN 'Fair'      THEN 5
                  WHEN 'Poor'      THEN 7
                  WHEN 'Critical'  THEN 10
                END)) / 30.0 AS cpi
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
ORDER BY cpi DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH r AS (
  SELECT c."ARTregID", c."DYNASTY", r."HIST_sign" AS hist_sig,
         (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric AS cultural_score
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" c
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = c."ARTregID"
), t AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY hist_sig) AS h90,
         percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cultural_score) AS c90
  FROM r
)
SELECT r."DYNASTY",
       COUNT(*) AS valuable_artifact_count,
       AVG(r.cultural_score) AS avg_cultural_score
FROM r CROSS JOIN t
WHERE r.hist_sig >= t.h90
  AND r.cultural_score >= t.c90
GROUP BY r."DYNASTY"
ORDER BY valuable_artifact_count DESC;

WITH erf AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS artregid, s."ENVsense",
         AVG(CASE e.val WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants')) e(val)
  GROUP BY s."ART_link", s."ENVsense"
)
SELECT a."MatKind",
       CASE WHEN a."MatKind" IN ('Wood','Textile','Paper') AND r."ENVsense" = 'High'
            THEN 'Organic Material Vulnerability' ELSE 'Not Vulnerable' END AS vulnerability_status,
       AVG(r.erf) AS avg_erf,
       COUNT(*) AS artifact_count
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN erf r ON r.artregid = a."ARTregID"
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY avg_erf DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT a.art_title, a."MatKind", sc."caseID", e.key AS sensitivity_type, e.value AS sensitivity_level, sd."ENVsense" AS showcase_env_profile
FROM "SensitivityData" sd
JOIN "ArtifactsCore" a ON a."ARTregID" = sd."ART_link"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "Showcases" sc ON sc."caseID" = ca.case_exam
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment') e
WHERE e.value = 'Medium' AND sd."ENVsense" = 'Medium';

SELECT a.art_title,
       a."DYNASTY",
       s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light' AS light_sensitivity,
       l.lux,
       l."visLxh"
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" c ON c.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = c.light_link
WHERE a.conserve_status IN ('Good', 'Excellent')
  AND s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light' = 'High'
  AND l."visLxh" > 70000
ORDER BY l."visLxh" DESC;

WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT r."ART_link",
         ((r."HIST_sign"
           + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric
           + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status
                    WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                    WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM "ArtifactRatings" r
  JOIN "ArtifactsCore" a ON a."ARTregID" = r."ART_link"
),
erf AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link",
         AVG(CASE j.v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS j(k, v)
  GROUP BY sd."ART_link"
)
SELECT MAX(c.cpi * e.erf) AS max_avs
FROM cpi c
JOIN erf e ON e."ART_link" = c."ART_link"
WHERE c.cpi IS NOT NULL AND e.erf IS NOT NULL;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT sc."caseID",
         10 - ((er."tempVar24" + er."RHvar" / 5.0
               + (sc.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric) / 3) AS sesr,
         (CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_indicators
  FROM "Showcases" sc
  LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" er ON er.case_link = sc."caseID"
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "caseID") AS at_risk_showcase_count
FROM s
WHERE sesr < 4 OR critical_indicators >= 3;

UPDATE "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm
SET "maintLog" = COALESCE(cm."maintLog" || E'\n', '')
                 || '[' || to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || '] '
                 || 'Alert (Conservation Emergency): Immediate action recommended'
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" ca
  JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" lr ON lr.rad_id = ca.light_link
  JOIN "ArtifactsCore" ac ON ac."ARTregID" = ca.art_exam
  WHERE lr.env_link = cm.monitor_link
);

WITH erf AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link" AS art_id,
         (SELECT AVG(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
          FROM unnest(ARRAY[sd."ENVsense",
                            sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light',
                            sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature',
                            sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity']) AS v) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
),
sesr AS (
  SELECT s."caseID" AS case_id,
         10 - ((AVG(e."tempVar24") + AVG(e."RHvar")/5.0
                + (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric) / 3) AS sesr
  FROM "Showcases" s
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = s."caseID"
  GROUP BY s."caseID", s.case_environment_profile
)
SELECT AVG(10 - ABS(erf.erf - sesr.sesr)) AS avg_aec
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN erf ON erf.art_id = a."ARTregID"
JOIN sesr ON sesr.case_id = ca.case_exam
WHERE a."DYNASTY" = 'Ming';

ALTER TABLE "ArtifactRatings"
ADD CONSTRAINT chk_hist_sign_range CHECK ("HIST_sign" BETWEEN 1 AND 10) NOT VALID;

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS art_id,
         (SELECT avg(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
          FROM unnest(ARRAY[
            s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light',
            s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature',
            s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity',
            s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration',
            s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants']) AS v) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
),
eci AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID",
         10 - (abs(e."TEMPc" - 20) + abs(e."RH" - 50) / 5.0 + se.erf / 2.0) AS eci
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN sens se ON se.art_id = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "ConditionAssessments" c ON c.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = c.light_link
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
  WHERE a."MatKind" = 'Textile'
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT "ARTregID") AS poor_compliance_textiles
FROM eci
WHERE eci <= 4;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.art_title, a."MatKind",
         CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS lw,
         CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS tw,
         CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS hw,
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
           * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi,
         l.lux, l."visLxh", u."displayMonths"
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
  JOIN "UsageRecords" u ON u.env_link = l.env_link
), scored AS (
  SELECT art_title, "MatKind",
         ((36.0 * (10 - lw) * (10 - tw) * (10 - hw) / 1000.0) - "displayMonths")
         * ((lux * lw * "visLxh" / 1000.0) + 1) * (cpi + 1) / 100.0 AS erps
  FROM base
)
SELECT art_title,
       erps * CASE WHEN "MatKind" IN ('Textile','Wood','Paper') THEN 1.2 ELSE 1 END AS adjusted_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY adjusted_score ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s."caseID", s.hall_ref,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sd."ART_link") AS high_sensitivity_artifact_count
FROM "Showcases" s
LEFT JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.case_exam = s."caseID"
LEFT JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON sd."ART_link" = ca.art_exam AND sd."ENVsense" = 'High'
WHERE s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now'
  AND s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now'
  AND s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue'
GROUP BY s."caseID", s.hall_ref
ORDER BY high_sensitivity_artifact_count DESC, s."caseID";

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID", a."ageYears",
         (SELECT AVG(CASE v WHEN 'High' THEN 10 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') x(k, v)) AS erf,
         CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'
              WHEN 'High' THEN 10 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END AS light_w,
         e."TEMPc", e."RH", l.lux, l."visLxh"
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "ConditionAssessments" c ON c.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = c.case_exam
  LEFT JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = c.light_link
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming', 'Han', 'Tang')
    AND (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric > 8
), calc AS (
  SELECT *,
         ("ageYears" * erf * power("RH" - 50, 2) * "TEMPc") / 100000.0 AS mdr,
         COALESCE(lux * light_w * "visLxh" / 1000.0, 0) AS ler
  FROM base
), m AS (
  SELECT *, mdr * (1 + (erf + ler + mdr * 2) / 20.0) AS map
  FROM calc
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ARTregID") AS dynasty_artifacts_at_risk
FROM m
WHERE map > 3;

SELECT acct_node,
       ROUND(SQRT(POWER("FollGrow", 2) + POWER("FingGrow", 2))::numeric, 3) AS ngv
FROM network_metrics
ORDER BY ngv DESC;

WITH overdue AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, a."MatKind",
         r.rating_profile->>'treatment_complexity' AS complexity,
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                                         WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi,
         (CURRENT_DATE - m."lastClean") - m."cleanDays" AS backlog_days
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "ConditionAssessments" c ON c.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = c.case_exam
  JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" m ON m.monitor_link = e.monitor_code
  WHERE m."nextClean" < CURRENT_DATE
),
scored AS (
  SELECT art_title,
         ROUND(cpi * backlog_days / 100.0, 2) AS risk_score,
         (CASE "MatKind" WHEN 'Bronze' THEN 4000 WHEN 'Textile' THEN 3500 WHEN 'Paper' THEN 3500
                         WHEN 'Wood' THEN 3000 WHEN 'Jade' THEN 2500 WHEN 'Ceramic' THEN 2000
                         WHEN 'Stone' THEN 1500 ELSE 2000 END)
         * (CASE complexity WHEN 'Complex' THEN 2.0 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 1.5 ELSE 1.0 END) AS estimated_cost
  FROM overdue
  WHERE cpi IS NOT NULL AND backlog_days IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(estimated_cost) OVER (ORDER BY risk_score DESC, art_title) AS running_cost
  FROM scored
)
SELECT art_title, risk_score, estimated_cost
FROM ranked
WHERE running_cost <= 25000
ORDER BY risk_score DESC;

SELECT a.acct_ref,
       ROUND((MAX((s.session_telemetry->'session_stats'->>'session_count')::numeric) / a."AGE_D")::numeric, 3) AS aaf
FROM accounts a
JOIN security_sessions s ON s.acct_gate = a.acct_ref
WHERE a."AGE_D" IS NOT NULL AND a."AGE_D" > 0
GROUP BY a.acct_ref, a."AGE_D"
HAVING MAX((s.session_telemetry->'session_stats'->>'session_count')::numeric) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY aaf DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH tei AS (
  SELECT acct_gate AS acct_ref,
         0.4 * REPLACE(session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct', '%', '')::numeric
       + 0.3 * COALESCE((session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric, 0) / 10
       + 0.3 * (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20 AS tei
  FROM security_sessions
)
SELECT acct_ref, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY tei) AS tei_quartile
FROM tei
ORDER BY tei_quartile, acct_ref;

WITH b AS (
  SELECT r.acct_risk,
    (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::numeric AS rv,
    (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score')::numeric AS tv,
    (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::numeric AS iv,
    (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric AS cc
  FROM risk_and_moderation r
  JOIN security_sessions s ON s.acct_gate = r.acct_risk
)
SELECT acct_risk,
       ROUND((0.4*rv + 0.3*(1-tv) + 0.3*iv) * (1 + 0.2*cc), 3) AS cpri
FROM b
WHERE rv IS NOT NULL AND tv IS NOT NULL AND iv IS NOT NULL AND cc IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (0.4*rv + 0.3*(1-tv) + 0.3*iv) * (1 + 0.2*cc) DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH tei AS (
  SELECT acct_gate,
         0.4 * REPLACE(session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct','%','')::numeric
       + 0.3 * (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10
       + 0.3 * (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20 AS tei
  FROM security_sessions
), q AS (
  SELECT acct_gate, tei, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY tei) AS tei_quartile
  FROM tei
  WHERE tei IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CASE tei_quartile WHEN 1 THEN 'Low Risk'
                         WHEN 2 THEN 'Moderate Risk'
                         WHEN 3 THEN 'High Risk'
                         ELSE 'Very High Risk' END AS tei_risk_category,
       COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM q
GROUP BY tei_quartile
ORDER BY tei_quartile;

WITH bbi AS (
  SELECT a.acct_ref,
         0.4 * (b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'bot_likelihood')::numeric
       + 0.3 * (b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'automated_behavior')::numeric
       + 0.3 * (1 - i."ConvNat"::numeric) AS bbi
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN behavioral_scores b ON b.acct_beh = a.acct_ref
  JOIN interaction_metrics i ON i.acct_dm = a.acct_ref
)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(bbi), 3) AS max_bbi FROM bbi;

SELECT acct_risk,
       ROUND((0.4 * (risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::numeric
            + 0.3 * (1 - (risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score')::numeric)
            + 0.3 * (risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::numeric), 3) AS srs,
       risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'threat_level' AS threat_level
FROM risk_and_moderation
WHERE risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'threat_level' = 'Critical'
  AND (0.4 * (risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::numeric
     + 0.3 * (1 - (risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score')::numeric)
     + 0.3 * (risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::numeric) > 0.7
ORDER BY srs DESC;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT acct_gate,
         (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::bigint AS country_count,
         0.4 * replace(session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct', '%', '')::numeric
       + 0.3 * (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10
       + 0.3 * (session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20 AS tei
  FROM security_sessions
)
SELECT acct_gate, country_count
FROM t
WHERE tei > 0.8
  AND country_count >= 3
ORDER BY country_count DESC;

SELECT p."PLT_KIND",
       ROUND(AVG(0.3 * (rm.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'authenticity_score')::numeric
               + 0.3 * (ca.content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness')::numeric
               + 0.4 * im."ConvNat"::numeric), 3) AS avg_cas
FROM accounts a
JOIN platforms p ON p."PLT_CODE" = a.plt_key
JOIN risk_and_moderation rm ON rm.acct_risk = a.acct_ref
JOIN content_activity ca ON ca.acct_slot = a.acct_ref
JOIN interaction_metrics im ON im.acct_dm = a.acct_ref
GROUP BY p."PLT_KIND"
ORDER BY avg_cas DESC;

SELECT acct_slot,
       (content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day')::numeric AS posts_per_day
FROM content_activity
WHERE (content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day')::numeric > 50
  AND 0.4 * (1 - (content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness')::numeric)
    + 0.3 * (content_metrics->'link_media'->>'media_reuse_rate')::numeric
    + 0.3 * (1 - (content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness')::numeric) > 0.7
ORDER BY posts_per_day DESC;

SELECT ca.acct_slot AS acct_ref,
  ROUND((0.4 * (1 - (ca.content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness')::numeric)
       + 0.3 * (ca.content_metrics->'link_media'->>'media_reuse_rate')::numeric
       + 0.3 * (1 - im."TxtUniq"::numeric)), 3) AS cms
FROM content_activity ca
JOIN interaction_metrics im ON im.acct_dm = ca.acct_slot
WHERE ca.content_metrics->'link_media'->>'media_reuse_rate' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cms DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH b AS (
 SELECT bs.acct_beh AS acct_ref,
  0.4*(bs.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'bot_likelihood')::numeric
 +0.3*(bs.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'automated_behavior')::numeric
 +0.3*(1-im."ConvNat") AS bbi
 FROM behavioral_scores bs
 JOIN interaction_metrics im ON im.acct_dm = bs.acct_beh),
c AS (
 SELECT ac.acct_bridge AS acct_ref, ca."ClusterQty" AS cluster_size,
  0.5*ca."CoordScore"
  + 0.3*(0.4*nm."ConnQual" + 0.3*ca."NetInfl" + 0.3*nm."IntDiv")
  + 0.2*ca."ClusterQty" AS cas
 FROM account_clusters ac
 JOIN cluster_analysis ca ON ca."CLSTR_PIN" = ac.clu_ref
 JOIN network_metrics nm ON nm.acct_node = ac.acct_bridge)
SELECT c.acct_ref,
       ROUND((b.bbi * c.cas * c.cluster_size)::numeric, 3) AS cbr
FROM c
JOIN b USING (acct_ref)
WHERE b.bbi * c.cas * c.cluster_size > 0.8
ORDER BY cbr DESC;

INSERT INTO monitoring ("RecKey", snap_ts, acct_mon, "DetectSrc", "MonPrio", "InvestState")
SELECT 'MON_' || s.acct_gate || '_' || to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),
       now(), s.acct_gate, 'Automated Scan', 'Low', 'Active'
FROM security_sessions s
WHERE 0.4 * replace(s.session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct', '%', '')::numeric
    + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10
    + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20 > 0.8
  AND (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric >= 3
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM monitoring m
        WHERE m.acct_mon = s.acct_gate
          AND m."InvestState" = 'Active'
  );

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.acct_ref,
    0.3*(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'credibility_score')::numeric
      + 0.3*(r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score')::numeric
      + 0.4*a."ProfileScore"::numeric AS pci,
    sqrt(power(n."FollGrow"::numeric,2) + power(n."FingGrow"::numeric,2)) AS ngv,
    0.4*(b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'bot_likelihood')::numeric
      + 0.3*(b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'automated_behavior')::numeric
      + 0.3*(1 - i."ConvNat"::numeric) AS bbi,
    n."ConnQual"::numeric AS connqual, n."IntDiv"::numeric AS intdiv
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN risk_and_moderation r ON r.acct_risk = a.acct_ref
  JOIN network_metrics n ON n.acct_node = a.acct_ref
  JOIN behavioral_scores b ON b.acct_beh = a.acct_ref
  JOIN interaction_metrics i ON i.acct_dm = a.acct_ref
),
pair AS (
  SELECT b.acct_ref, b.pci, b.ngv, b.bbi, c."ClusterQty" AS qty,
    0.5*c."CoordScore"::numeric
      + 0.3*(0.4*b.connqual + 0.3*c."NetInfl"::numeric + 0.3*b.intdiv)
      + 0.2*c."ClusterQty" AS cas
  FROM base b
  JOIN account_clusters ac ON ac.acct_bridge = b.acct_ref
  JOIN cluster_analysis c ON c."CLSTR_PIN" = ac.clu_ref
),
acct_nts AS (
  SELECT acct_ref, AVG(pci*(1-ngv)*(1-bbi*cas*qty)) AS nts
  FROM pair GROUP BY acct_ref
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(nts), 3) AS avg_network_trust_score FROM acct_nts;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.acct_risk_ref)
       r.acct_risk_ref AS acct_ref,
       (b.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'bot_likelihood')::real AS latest_bot_likelihood
FROM risk_event_history r
JOIN behavioral_scores b ON b.acct_beh = r.acct_risk_ref
ORDER BY r.acct_risk_ref, r."eventTs" DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.acct_ref,
    0.4 * replace(s.session_telemetry->>'vpn_usage_pct','%','')::numeric
    + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'proxy_hits')::numeric / 10
    + 0.3 * (s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'country_count')::numeric / 20 AS tei,
    0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'credibility_score')::numeric
    + 0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score')::numeric
    + 0.4 * a."ProfileScore"::numeric AS pci,
    0.4 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::numeric
    + 0.3 * (1 - (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'trust_score')::numeric)
    + 0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::numeric AS srs
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN security_sessions s ON s.acct_gate = a.acct_ref
  JOIN risk_and_moderation r ON r.acct_risk = a.acct_ref
), ars AS (
  SELECT acct_ref, ROUND(0.5*tei + 0.3*(1-pci) + 0.2*srs, 3) AS ars FROM base
)
SELECT acct_ref, ars FROM ars WHERE ars > 0.7 ORDER BY ars DESC;

WITH nic AS (
    SELECT n.acct_node,
           MAX(0.4 * n."ConnQual" + 0.3 * c."NetInfl" + 0.3 * n."IntDiv") AS nic
    FROM network_metrics n
    JOIN account_clusters ac ON ac.acct_bridge = n.acct_node
    JOIN cluster_analysis c ON c."CLSTR_PIN" = ac.clu_ref
    GROUP BY n.acct_node
)
SELECT nic.acct_node,
       nic.nic,
       (ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day')::numeric AS posts_per_day
FROM nic
JOIN content_activity ca ON ca.acct_slot = nic.acct_node
WHERE nic.nic > 0.8
  AND (ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day')::numeric > 30
ORDER BY nic.nic DESC;

WITH members AS (
  SELECT c."CLSTR_PIN",
         c."ClusterQty",
         c."CoordScore",
         ac.acct_bridge,
         0.4 * nm."ConnQual" + 0.3 * c."NetInfl" + 0.3 * nm."IntDiv" AS nic,
         0.4 * (1 - (ca.content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness')::numeric)
       + 0.3 * (ca.content_metrics->'link_media'->>'media_reuse_rate')::numeric
       + 0.3 * (1 - im."TxtUniq") AS cms
  FROM cluster_analysis c
  JOIN account_clusters ac      ON ac.clu_ref = c."CLSTR_PIN"
  LEFT JOIN network_metrics nm  ON nm.acct_node = ac.acct_bridge
  LEFT JOIN content_activity ca ON ca.acct_slot = ac.acct_bridge
  LEFT JOIN interaction_metrics im ON im.acct_dm = ac.acct_bridge
  WHERE c."CluRole" = 'SocialGroup'
), agg AS (
  SELECT "CLSTR_PIN",
         COUNT(DISTINCT acct_bridge) AS member_count,
         MAX("CoordScore")           AS max_coordination_score,
         AVG(nic)                    AS nic,
         (COUNT(DISTINCT acct_bridge) > 5
          AND 0.5 * MAX("CoordScore") + 0.3 * AVG(nic) + 0.2 * MAX("ClusterQty") > 0.8
          AND BOOL_AND(cms > 0.7))   AS is_content_manipulation_ring
  FROM members
  GROUP BY "CLSTR_PIN"
)
SELECT "CLSTR_PIN",
       member_count,
       max_coordination_score,
       nic,
       (CAST(NULL AS boolean) AND is_content_manipulation_ring) AS is_coordinated_influence_operation
FROM agg
ORDER BY "CLSTR_PIN";

SELECT acct_beh,
       ROUND((behavioral_anomaly_scores->'pattern_scores'->>'temporal_pattern')::numeric, 3) AS tpds
FROM behavioral_scores
WHERE (behavioral_anomaly_scores->'pattern_scores'->>'temporal_pattern')::numeric > 0.7
ORDER BY tpds DESC;

SELECT p."PLT_KIND",
       ROUND(AVG(n."EngAuth")::numeric, 3) AS avg_eng_auth
FROM accounts a
JOIN platforms p ON a.plt_key = p."PLT_CODE"
JOIN network_metrics n ON n.acct_node = a.acct_ref
GROUP BY p."PLT_KIND"
ORDER BY avg_eng_auth DESC;

SELECT a.acct_ref,
       (c.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day')::numeric AS posts_per_day
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN security_sessions s ON s.acct_gate = a.acct_ref
LEFT JOIN content_activity c ON c.acct_slot = a.acct_ref
WHERE (s.session_telemetry->'session_stats'->>'session_count')::numeric > 1000
   OR (c.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day')::numeric > 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dormant_bot_count
FROM accounts
WHERE "StateFlag" = 'Dormant'
  AND acct_form = 'Bot';

UPDATE monitoring m
SET "MonPrio" = 'Review_Inactive_Trusted'
WHERE m.acct_mon IN (
  SELECT a.acct_ref
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN risk_and_moderation r ON r.acct_risk = a.acct_ref
  WHERE 0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'credibility_score')::numeric
      + 0.3 * (r.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score')::numeric
      + 0.4 * a."ProfileScore" > 0.8
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM monitoring m2
      WHERE m2.acct_mon = a.acct_ref
        AND m2.snap_ts >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days')
    AND (SELECT MAX(m3.snap_ts) FROM monitoring m3 WHERE m3.acct_mon = a.acct_ref)
        < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
);

WITH snaps AS (
  SELECT l.acct_ref, m.account_age_at_event_days AS t, m."CaseFile_CODE" AS c,
         m.user_reputation_score_snapshot::numeric AS rep
  FROM moderation_case_files m
  JOIN account_audit_logs l ON l."Audit_CODE" = m.audit_log_ref
  WHERE m.user_reputation_score_snapshot IS NOT NULL
    AND m.user_reputation_score_snapshot <> 'NaN'
    AND m.account_age_at_event_days IS NOT NULL
), agg AS (
  SELECT acct_ref, STDDEV_SAMP(rep) AS sd, AVG(rep) AS mu,
         (ARRAY_AGG(rep ORDER BY t, c))[1] AS first_rep,
         (ARRAY_AGG(rep ORDER BY t DESC, c DESC))[1] AS last_rep
  FROM snaps GROUP BY acct_ref HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT acct_ref,
       ROUND(sd / NULLIF(mu, 0) * ABS(last_rep - first_rep) / NULLIF(ABS(first_rep), 0), 3) AS rvi
FROM agg
ORDER BY rvi DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW high_credibility_accounts AS
SELECT *
FROM risk_and_moderation
WHERE (risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'credibility_score')::real > 0.9;
